2025-09.daily_overview: On the first day of Yu Xiaowen's official transfer to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, she felt both anticipation and slight unease as she familiarized herself with the new environment and procedures under the guidance of the department director and supervising instructor. While organizing her workstation, she integrated her father's rehabilitation notes with professional books, feeling the connection between her personal experience and this new professional starting point.

events.name: Reporting and onboarding conversation.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowen arrived early at the doctor's office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital according to the notice from the personnel department, and knocked on the door slightly nervously. Department director Fang Mingyuan, chief physician, warmly received her, arranged a brief onboarding conversation, introduced in detail the department's basic situation, team division of labor, and the multidisciplinary collaboration characteristics of rehabilitation medicine, and designated senior therapist Li Zhigang as her mentoring instructor, responsible for leading her to systematically familiarize herself with the rehabilitation assessment process. Director Fang emphasized that 'rehabilitation begins with assessment,' which filled her with a sense of mission for the new stage.

events.name: Department visit and preliminary observation
events.description: From 9:00 to 11:30 AM, under the guidance of therapist Li Zhigang, Yu Xiaowen visited the rehabilitation assessment room, physical therapy area, and occupational therapy area in turn. She observed limb motor function assessment, activities of daily living assessment, and other procedures, and learned the key points of writing assessment reports. Li Zhigang explained the assessment approach using two typical cases: shoulder subluxation and foot drop. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and actively asked about details of the Modified Ashworth Scale for spasticity assessment. Teacher Li praised her, saying "You ask very precise questions," which boosted her confidence.

events.name: Set up the workstation and take in father's rehabilitation notes.
events.description: From 12:00 to 13:00, Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to return to her assigned workstation — a desk in the corner of the doctors' office in the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine. She placed her father Yu Jianguo's rehabilitation notes and several professional books on rehabilitation medicine side by side on the bookshelf, organized the computer, stationery, and other office supplies, and put a small green plant on the desk, creating a cozy work corner. She especially looked through her father's notes. The concepts circled in red pen, such as "early intervention" and "active participation," deepened her resonance with the humanistic care of rehabilitation medicine.

events.name: Sat in on case discussions and ward rounds
events.description: From 13:30 to 17:00, under the arrangement of her supervising teacher Li Zhigang, Yu Xiaowen sat in on the afternoon case discussion meeting of the rehabilitation medicine department. At the meeting, the rehabilitation goals and plans of several newly admitted patients sparked lively discussion, and she listened carefully as the department director analyzed the issues from the perspective of functional prognosis. Afterwards, she accompanied Wang Min, the attending physician of the department, on ward rounds and gained a preliminary understanding of the patient distribution and handover procedures. She took the initiative to briefly greet two patients with spinal cord injury, felt their longing to return to life, and gained a more direct appreciation of the humanistic care atmosphere in rehabilitation medicine.

events.name: Summarize gains and plan the next day
events.description: From 17:00 to 17:30, Yu Xiaowen reviewed what she had learned on her first day at her workstation, organized the assessment key points she had observed and the case discussion content into electronic notes, and archived them in the department's shared folder. She also briefly communicated with her clinical instructor, Li Zhigang, about the next day's arrangement, confirming that she would continue to observe various hands-on assessment practices in depth the next morning and start learning to use the rehabilitation treatment record system in the afternoon. After completing these tasks, she packed her belongings and left the hospital at 17:30 to walk home, feeling fulfilled yet a little tired. Along the way, she couldn't help sending her mother a WeChat message to share her first experience in the new department.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Expectant with a hint of nervousness

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly tired

2025-09.daily_overview: On payday, Yu Xiaowen handled her personal finances in the gaps of a busy workday. She transferred the medical reserve fund to her parents on time, confirmed that the regular fund investment was running normally, kept up her bookkeeping habit, and shared screenshots with her father, maintaining the family’s financial bond and emotional care.

events.name: Received salary and checked it.
events.description: On the morning of September 2, 2025, while Yu Xiaowen was organizing medical records in the doctor's office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, a notification from China Merchants Bank popped up on her phone, showing that her after-tax salary of 10,000.37 yuan had been credited. She immediately checked the payslip details in mobile banking, and after confirming that the basic salary and performance allowance were correct, she mentally calculated this month's disposable balance to prepare for the upcoming forced savings.

events.name: Check account and holdings
events.description: During a break at work, Yu Xiaowen used the mobile banking app to log in with her fingerprint and entered the account overview page. She checked her current balance and confirmed that her daily emergency cash was sufficient. Then she opened the fund section and reviewed the holdings' returns and recent fluctuations of a conservative hybrid fund. She found that although there had been a slight pullback last month, it was overall stable, which made her feel at ease.

events.name: Transfer parents' medical reserve fund
events.description: She selected the transfer function, entered the dedicated medical reserve fund account for her parents (bank of deposit: Bank of China Luoyang Branch; account name: Yu Jianguo), entered the amount 2,500 yuan, and wrote the remark 'September medical reserve fund' in the note. After entering the SMS verification code and confirming, the transfer was completed instantly. She took a screenshot of the successful transaction screen and planned to send it to her father in the evening.

events.name: Confirmed the fund auto-investment deduction.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen tapped into the fund automatic investment plan page and confirmed that this month's automatic deduction had been executed on September 1, with an amount of 2,000 yuan, and the investment portfolio was still a prudent hybrid fund. She compared last month's returns; although the gain was modest, she was satisfied with the cost-averaging effect of the systematic investment. She closed the app and decided to talk with her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan at the end of the month.

events.name: Bookkeeping and family communication
events.description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen took out the paper ledger she carried with her and neatly recorded the month's income and expenses: salary income, transfer-out of medical reserve funds, and monthly fund investment deductions, and updated the family financial summary sheet. She confirmed that this month's savings goal had been achieved and the family finances were stable. After returning home in the evening, she sent a screenshot of the transfer to her father, Yu Jianguo, via WeChat with the message, 'Dad, this month's medical reserve fund has been transferred; just say the word if you need it.' Her father quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji, which warmed her heart.

events.name: Brief communication with a financial advisor
events.description: After the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen thought of the recent market fluctuations and sent a WeChat message to her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan: "Mingyuan, mixed funds have pulled back a bit recently. Do we need to adjust the dollar-cost averaging structure?" Wang Mingyuan quickly replied by voice: "Dr. Yu, the current strategy is still quite stable. I suggest holding and observing. I'll do a review at the end of the month. Also, the payment reminders for your parents' medical insurance have been set up." She felt much more reassured after hearing it.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Calm and orderly

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: The peace of mind that comes from having financial arrangements properly made.

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, she hurriedly dealt with the rent payment and utility records, then rushed to the hospital. When she suddenly received the paper revision notice, anxiety surged; in the evening, she contacted her academic partner and finalized a remote collaboration plan, preparing for full commitment the next day.

events.name: Paid rent and property management fees.
events.description: At 7 a.m. on September 3, just after getting up, Yu Xiaowen received a payment QR code from her landlord Song Yumei via WeChat for September's rent and property management fee, with the message: 'Xiaoxiao, this month's rent and property fee is 2350 yuan. Transfer it to me whenever convenient.' She quickly verified the amount was correct (rent 2200 yuan + property fee 150 yuan), confirmed on her phone that utilities were not included, then scanned the QR code in WeChat, entered 2350 yuan, and completed the transfer. After the transfer succeeded, she sent the payment screenshot to the landlord, and Aunt Song replied, 'Received. As long as you live comfortably, that's what matters,' along with a small flower emoji.

events.name: Record the water and electricity meter readings and file them.
events.description: After completing the payment, Yu Xiaowen habitually walked to the kitchen and bathroom to check the water meter and electricity meter respectively. She compared the current readings with the numbers recorded in her phone memo last month and found that both water and electricity usage had increased slightly. Considering that summer had just ended, it was within a reasonable range, and there were no signs of abnormal leakage, so she felt relieved. She saved the WeChat payment bill details screenshot and the water and electricity meter reading photos to the 'Family Finance' folder on her phone for use in bookkeeping at the end of the month.

events.name: Received an email requesting revisions to the paper
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen had just arrived at the department. While checking email on the office computer, she found a revision request from the editorial office of Henan Medical Research, asking her to add a forest plot for the multivariate regression analysis and correct the description of the statistical methods, with a note "Important, please return by September 10." Her heart tightened. She carefully read the reviewer comments and revision requirements, marked the key parts to revise with a red highlighter, and had a feeling that the coming evenings would be a tough battle.

events.name: Contact Zhou Haoran and Wang Jianguo for remote assistance
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned home in Jinshui District. After a simple dinner, she turned on her computer and contacted her college classmate Zhou Haoran (now doing medical research at the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases) and Wang Jianguo from the hospital's statistics office via WeChat calls. After she explained the revision requirements, both agreed to help. Zhou Haoran comforted her, 'Don't worry, I have a template for the standard description of multivariate regression. I'll share my screen tomorrow and help you go through it,' while Wang Jianguo said, 'I'll download the data tonight and generate the forest plot directly with SPSS tomorrow.' The three agreed to work remotely via Tencent Meeting at 9 a.m. the next day. Only after hanging up did Yu Xiaowen feel somewhat relieved.

events.name: Check account balance.
events.description: After paying the rent, Yu Xiaowen subconsciously opened mobile banking and found that her current account balance was low, with only over 8,000 yuan left. She frowned, realizing that last month's purchases of her father's rehabilitation supplies and the home exercise bike had used up quite a bit. She decided to control discretionary spending more strictly starting this month and planned to discuss splitting the costs with her brother over the weekend.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Busy but orderly morning

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Anxious about the paper revision, but arrangements have been made to resolve it

2025-09.daily_overview: Took a day off and devoted myself entirely to revising the paper. With remote assistance from Zhou Haoran and Wang Jianguo, I worked intensively from morning to night on the statistical methods description and forest plot creation, and finally completed the revised draft. The intense focus brought a great sense of accomplishment, but I also felt extremely exhausted.

events.name: Remote collaborative thesis revision
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on September 4, 2025, Yu Xiaowen connected remotely with Zhou Haoran and Wang Jianguo at home via Tencent Meeting. The three shared screens and handled the revision comments one by one. Zhou Haoran guided her in rewriting the 'univariate and multivariate analysis' section in the Methods into a more standard professional expression, and emphasized the explanation of adjusting for confounding variables. Wang Jianguo, using the shared SPSS software window, demonstrated importing the data, creating a clear forest plot, and exporting it as a 300 dpi high-resolution TIFF image. Yu Xiaowen integrated the revisions into the Word document of the paper in real time, repeatedly checking variable names and statistical values. At noon, she made do with a fruit salad from the fridge.

events.name: Final check and save.
events.description: After 17:00 in the afternoon, Zhou and Wang came offline, and Yu Xiaowen did a full read-through alone. She found an error in a table number, corrected it promptly, and renamed all figures and tables according to standard conventions. After confirming that all revision points corresponded to the reviewers' comments, she generated a version with revision marks and a final clean version, saving them on the desktop and in the cloud drive. When she finished, it was already dark outside; only then did she feel sore all over, but a weight had been lifted from her heart.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Focused and tense

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Relieved, extremely exhausted

state.daily_exercise: Morning simple stretching for 5 minutes (not the full Baduanjin), midday neck and shoulder relaxation exercises, evening got up and moved for 10 minutes; prolonged sitting made my whole body stiff.

2025-09.daily_overview: After submitting the revised paper in the early morning, she slept only a few hours before getting up for work and felt a bit groggy during the day. After work, in the cafeteria, she unexpectedly learned from Liu Qiang about Wang Fang's true feelings. Deeply moved, she resolved to use the pottery gift to mend the friendship, bringing a turning point to the relationship that was on the verge of breaking.

events.name: Submit the revised manuscript in the early morning
events.description: At 2 a.m., Yu Xiaowen did a final check of the revised manuscript, and in the online submission system of "Henan Medical Research" uploaded the revised manuscript, the forest plot attachment, and a response document addressing each reviewer comment. After clicking the submit button, the system indicated success. She let out a long sigh of relief, took a screenshot of the submission page, and then, exhausted, did a quick wash-up and went to bed.

events.name: Ran into Liu Qiang in the cafeteria and learned Wang Fang's true thoughts.
events.description: At about 17:30 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen finished her day's work and went to the hospital staff cafeteria for dinner. In the food pickup area, she ran into Liu Qiang, a resident physician from the same department. Liu Qiang carried his tray and sat down across from her. After exchanging a few pleasantries, Liu Qiang lowered his voice and said, "Wang Fang made a scene with you last time. Actually, she told me privately that it wasn't for any other reason. She just felt that you were going to be transferred to another department and would no longer rotate together, and she was afraid of becoming distant from you. That's why she said those harsh words in the heat of the moment. She really regrets it." Hearing this, Yu Xiaowen's chopsticks stopped in midair, and her emotions surged. She thought back to the ceramic cup and small bowl she had spent two weeks hand-shaping in the pottery studio after the conflict with Wang Fang in August, engraved with "WF," which she had never given to her out of spite. All sorts of feelings welled up inside her.

events.name: Made up her mind to give a gift to repair the friendship
events.description: After a moment of thought, Yu Xiaowen said to Liu Qiang, 'Thank you for telling me this. I understand.' She had already made up her mind: she would deliver the gift in person before Wang Fang's wedding, even if it was still awkward to meet, she had to take this step. She wrote 'Gift Delivery Action' in her phone memo and planned to put the final touches on the gift and wrap it over the weekend. This thought loosened the gloom that had been weighing on her in recent days.

events.name: Daytime work status
events.description: During the day, due to lack of sleep, Yu Xiaowen couldn't help yawning twice during the morning ward rounds, but she forced herself to stay alert and record patients' treatment responses. After a 20-minute nap at her desk at noon, she recovered in the afternoon and efficiently organized several progress notes. Her supervising teacher Li Zhigang noticed her fatigue and thoughtfully let her go to dinner earlier.

events.name: Preparing gifts in the evening.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen took the wrapped pottery cup and small bowl from the back of the cabinet, carefully wiped them with a soft cloth, and checked that the glaze was intact. She also painted a small double happiness pattern on the bottom of the cup, thinking: "I hope she is happy, no matter how far apart we are."

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Tired but relieved to have finished the task.

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Relief from feeling conflicted but determined about Wang Fang's matter.

state.daily_exercise: Did no dedicated exercise due to fatigue; did neck-shoulder relaxation exercises at noon, cervical spine health exercises in the morning and evening, and meditated before bed (fell asleep quickly because of drowsiness). Steps about 5,000.

2025-09.daily_overview: Early Saturday morning, I drove to a pottery studio to attend a two-day masterclass in underglaze painting and incised carving. Under the careful guidance of a teacher from Jingdezhen, I threw myself into learning traditional techniques and began creating a vase with a zodiac rooster motif, achieving a qualitative breakthrough in my pottery skills and tremendous spiritual fulfillment.

events.name: Attend the underglaze painting theory class
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen drove to the Between the Clay pottery studio in Guancheng District, Zhengzhou, where her teacher Zheng Guodong warmly welcomed her. Jingdezhen ceramic artist Chen Zhiming explained the history of underglaze painting, pigment mixing principles, and brushwork techniques, and demonstrated traditional techniques such as blue-and-white water separation and multicolor outlining on site. Yu Xiaowen carefully noted the key points: the blue-and-white pigment must be ground fine, and the brush tip must contain the right amount of water during water separation. She also proactively asked, 'How can I prevent brushstrokes from drying too quickly on bisque?' Master Chen praised her for her careful observation.

events.name: Underglaze painting practice and a draft of the zodiac rooster
events.description: From 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowen received a blank vase body and began practicing. She first practiced lines on a waste blank, then conceived a design around the theme of the Year of the Rooster — a rooster raising its head and crowing, symbolizing her own zodiac sign and enterprising spirit. She first made a light pencil sketch, then used a chicken-head brush dipped in blue-and-white pigment to outline, and tried using underglaze red to accent the rooster's comb. After many revisions, the draft was approved by Chen Zhiming and Zheng Guodong; the two teachers suggested she strengthen the layering of the feathers during carving the next day. Excitedly, she took a photo of the blank with her phone, planning to send it to Su Ya in the evening to share.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Excited and full of enthusiasm for learning

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: The joy and fulfillment brought by creative work.

state.daily_exercise: Pottery making involves a lot of upper-limb activity, so it can be regarded as light manual exercise. Do some simple stretching before bed at night.

2025-09.daily_overview: Continued to study carving and glazing in depth, completed the creation of a Chinese zodiac rooster vase blank, and received praise in peer review among classmates. The two days of intensive learning improved her skills and further strengthened her professional inspiration to combine pottery with rehabilitation.

events.name: Learn carving techniques and fine engraving
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 12 p.m., Chen Zhiming systematically explained the types of carving knives and knife techniques. Yu Xiaowen chose the vase blank she had painted the day before and, holding her breath, used a beveled carving knife to carefully carve along the outline. She focused especially on the texture of the rooster's comb and tail feathers. Zheng Guodong helped adjust the depth of the wing area. When she accidentally carved too deep in one place, she was a bit annoyed, but Master Chen comforted her, saying, "Flaws are also the warmth of handcraft," and guided her in repairing it. In the end, the three-dimensional effect of the pattern was significantly enhanced.

events.name: Glazing and mutual critique of works
events.description: From 1 pm to 4 pm, under the guidance of Chen Zhiming, Yu Xiaowen applied transparent glaze to her work and learned about the heating curves for biscuit firing and glaze firing. Before the class ended, Zheng Guodong organized the students to review one another's works. Yu Xiaowen presented a vase with a zodiac rooster pattern, which earned praise from the teacher and classmates. Su Ya (a classmate in the pottery class) even praised it as 'full of spirit.' She carefully wrapped the greenware and placed it in the studio's to-be-fired area, planning to pick up the finished piece next month. On the way home, the idea of using pottery as art therapy for the rehabilitation department flashed through her mind, and she decided to look up relevant literature the next day.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Focused and engaged

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Satisfied and slightly tired, with a lingering desire to keep creating.

state.daily_exercise: Standing work, regarded as light physical activity; neck relaxation in the evening.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Monday morning she unexpectedly received a reminder that her residence permit was about to expire. She hurriedly completed the endorsement before work, gaining a sense of security in city life. She worked normally during the day, but when she got home in the evening she found that her mother had reorganized her exam-preparation mistake cards, which made them hard to find and irritated her. After confiding in a close friend, she felt somewhat better.

events.name: Handle residence permit renewal.
events.description: At 7 a.m. on Monday, just as Yu Xiaowen was about to leave for work, her phone received a reminder text from the Jinshui District neighborhood committee about her residence permit endorsement. She immediately checked the permit and found it would expire the next day, breaking into a cold sweat. She quickly found her ID card and rental contract and decided to leave half an hour earlier. She walked to the Jinshui District police station, took a number and waited in line in the lobby, then submitted her materials at the counter. After reviewing the materials, the staff updated the endorsement on the spot. It took only fifteen minutes to complete, and the new endorsement was valid through September 2026. Holding her permit as she walked out of the police station, she felt a more solid sense of belonging in this city and thought, "Finally settled."

events.name: Work during the day
events.description: After completing the endorsement procedure, Yu Xiaowen hurried to the hospital at a jog and arrived at the department as early as 8 a.m. In the morning, she followed Li Zhigang in the rehabilitation assessment of two newly admitted patients and gradually became familiar with the assessment process. In the afternoon, she helped organize the rehabilitation documents of discharged patients. Although the work was tedious, she completed it methodically.

events.name: Discovered her mother organizing mistake cards and confided in her
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Jinshui District and found that her mother, Li Xiuying, had come over that afternoon from her place on Huayuan Road to bring dumplings and had cleaned the room for her. She sat down at her desk, only to find that all the wrong-question review cards, which had originally been arranged in her review order, had been moved to the right side and rearranged by date. The neurology summary card she urgently needed was nowhere to be found, and she immediately became irritated. Her mother, Li Xiuying, poked her head out of the kitchen and said, 'I saw your desk was messy, so I rearranged it for you.' Yu Xiaowen suppressed her irritation and said, 'Mom, I had that order planned out!' She went back to her room in a gloomy mood and sent a voice message on WeChat to her best friend Zhang Jing: 'My mom really means well, but she's making things worse—now I can't find anything at all.' Zhang Jing replied with a hug emoji and comforted her, saying, 'Auntie just wanted to help. Talk to her calmly tomorrow.' Only then did she calm down a little.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Acted immediately after being reminded, somewhat in a hurry

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Felt upset because the flashcard had been moved, but calmed down a bit after talking about it.

2025-09.daily_overview: At breakfast, her mother handed her the hand-copied error notes, which deeply touched Yu Xiaowen and led to a warm reconciliation between mother and daughter. During the day, she went to work as usual and used work breaks to study intensively, making final preparations for her first independent rehabilitation assessment the next day, feeling both anxious and confident.

events.name: Mother-daughter reconciliation
events.description: During breakfast on September 9, Yu Xiaowen was eating halfway through when her mother, Li Xiuying, quietly handed her a handwritten note. On it, written neatly, were the words: 'Mom was afraid you couldn't find the old copy, so I copied it out again for you. Take a look and see if it's right.' Yu Xiaowen took it and saw that her mother had not only sorted out the blurry mistake cards but also copied out the neurology summary word by word. Some of the handwriting was a little stiff, but every stroke was especially careful. Her nose tingled and tears almost fell; she stood up and hugged her mother. 'Mom, thank you... I'm sorry I had a bad tone yesterday.' Her mother patted her back and said, 'Silly child, I understand you're under a lot of pressure.' The mother and daughter smiled at each other, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Drove to work and refueled the car.
events.description: After the reconciliation, Yu Xiaowen, feeling relaxed, packed her belongings, got into her car, and drove from her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Passing a gas station on the way, she stopped to fill the tank, preparing for the journey ahead. The morning sunlight streamed onto the car windows, and she felt the new day was full of goodwill.

events.name: Exam preparation review during work breaks
events.description: In the afternoon, when the department was fairly quiet, Yu Xiaowen used gaps in her work to look through the department's Rehabilitation Assessment Guide and textbooks, focusing on reviewing muscle strength grading (Lovett method), joint range of motion measurement methods, as well as the Berg Scale for balance function and the Barthel Index for activities of daily living. She wrote the scoring criteria from memory on blank paper and mentally simulated the next day's assessment process, feeling both nervous and excited. Her colleague Wang Fang sent a WeChat message asking "Good luck with tomorrow's assessment," and she replied with a cheering gesture. Most of yesterday's unhappiness had already dissipated.

start_state.mood: From last night's irritability to morning emotion

2025-09.daily_overview: An important milestone in my career — under the supervision of my clinical instructor, I independently completed a full rehabilitation assessment for a hemiplegic patient and wrote the report for the first time, and it was recognized. From being unfamiliar to gradually getting into the flow, I was immersed in clinical professional output all day; I felt exhausted but gained a great deal.

events.name: Assessment preparation and patient communication
events.description: At 8:00 AM on September 10, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the rehabilitation treatment room early, inventoried and inspected the required assessment tools: goniometer, dynamometer, grip dynamometer, balance board, stopwatch, and various assessment forms. After confirming the tools were in good condition, she pushed the equipment cart to the bedside of Zhao Zhiqiang, a stroke patient with hemiplegia, and softly explained the assessment purpose to calm his slightly anxious mood.

events.name: Muscle strength and joint range-of-motion assessment
events.description: From 9:00 to 10:30 a.m., under the supervision of the teaching instructor Li Wei, Yu Xiaowen assessed Zhao Zhiqiang (left-sided hemiplegia) for muscle strength (Lovett grading method) and joint range of motion (universal goniometer). In the order of shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle, she first measured the right healthy limb and then the left affected limb, measuring both active and passive range of motion for each joint. Li Wei recorded alongside, occasionally nodding, and pointed out that 'the fulcrum position of the goniometer must be precise when measuring ulnar deviation of the wrist joint.' Yu Xiaowen was nervous but her technique gradually became steady.

events.name: Balance and activities of daily living assessment
events.description: From 10:30 to 11:30, Yu Xiaowen continued to evaluate Zhao Zhiqiang's balance function (Berg Scale, including sit-to-stand, turning, standing with eyes closed, etc.) and activities of daily living (Barthel Index, asking about dressing, toileting, etc.). She noticed that the patient swayed when standing from a sitting position, immediately reached out to support him, and encouraged him softly. During the assessment, Li Wei reminded her to observe the patient's facial expressions and give him rest at appropriate times. Finally, she combined the scales and arrived at a preliminary score.

events.name: Write the first rehabilitation assessment report
events.description: From 15:00 to 17:00 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen started writing the first complete rehabilitation assessment report of her career in the doctor's office, based on the detailed records from the morning. She strictly followed the medical record writing standards, writing out each item from basic patient information and medical history summary to the various assessment results, problem analysis, and preliminary rehabilitation recommendations. When she encountered uncertain terminology, she consulted the textbook "Rehabilitation Medicine" to confirm, weighing every word. After finally signing her handwritten name, she took a deep breath.

events.name: Report review and revision.
events.description: From 17:00 to 17:30 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen handed her report to her supervising teacher Li Wei for review. After reading it, Teacher Li noted, 'The data are complete, but the unit for range of motion should be uniformly marked in degrees,' and 'The activities of daily living section could describe the patient's current practical difficulties more specifically.' Yu Xiaowen immediately revised it with a red pen. Li Wei signed the report to confirm and encouraged her, 'For a first report, this quality is quite good.' She felt a great sense of achievement and thanked Teacher Li.

events.name: Shared achievements with family
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen could not wait to show her father and mother the signed report via video call. Her father said approvingly, 'Our Xiaowen is increasingly looking like an expert.' Her mother urged her to rest. This support made her tired body feel a bit lighter.

start_state.location: At home
start_state.mood: Nervous but motivated, like taking a major exam.

end_state.location: At home

She wore a heart rate wristband and kept the intensity in the fat-burning zone of 130–150 beats per minute, reducing smashes and focusing mainly on steady clears and drops. During breaks, Lin Wei shared some funny stories from her recent teaching, and Yu Xiaowen talked about what she had learned after one week of rotation. Lin Wei encouraged her: 'You adapt quickly, so you'll definitely be fine.' They played until 16:20 and went home fully satisfied.

That evening she went to bed early, planning to conserve her energy.

2025-09.daily_overview: A day full of warmth and inspiration: In the morning, I saw my father make progress in his rehabilitation assessment, successfully walking 15 meters independently, and the whole family was overjoyed; in the afternoon, I went to the nursing home to lead a pottery experience, felt the potential of art therapy, and planted seeds for my future career.

events.name: Breakthrough in Father's Rehabilitation Assessment
events.description: At 9 a.m., after previously communicating with her supervising teacher Li Zhigang, Yu Xiaowen arranged a quarterly rehabilitation assessment for her father in the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She accompanied her father Yu Jianguo to the rehabilitation evaluation room, where therapist Dr. Wang used professional scales to test his lower limb muscle strength and balance ability. Encouraged, her father slowly stood up and stepped forward tremblingly, actually walking 15 meters independently! Yu Xiaowen excitedly took out her phone to record this crucial moment. Her father waved at the camera with a bright smile. The assessment showed that lower limb muscle strength had reached grade 4, and balance ability had improved significantly.

events.name: Sharing joy and communicating with family
events.description: After the evaluation, Yu Xiaowen immediately sent the video to the family group chat and also sent it separately to her cousin and her Luoyang friend Chen Siyu. Relatives and friends quickly replied with congratulations; her cousin sent three applauding emojis in a row. When she got home at noon, her mother Li Xiuying happily cooked a few nice dishes. The family sat around the table eating. Yu Xiaowen showed the evaluation report and analyzed the reasons for the progress. Her father confidently said he would continue working hard to get rid of the cane as soon as possible.

events.name: Volunteer pottery service at the nursing home.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowen brought simple pottery clay and tools and drove to the Jinshui District nursing home. She set up the activity area and patiently demonstrated hand-shaping techniques, teaching several elderly residents hand by hand to make small clay bowls. At first, the old people's hands trembled slightly, but with her encouragement they gradually finished. Grandma Wang held up her crooked bowl and said, "This is a work of art I made," making everyone laugh. The activity lasted two hours. After cleaning up the tools, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to the elderly residents and received a great deal of gratitude.

events.name: Evening notes and sorting through inspirations.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen sorted through the event photos and described in detail in her journal the elderly participants' positive reactions and the creative process. She thought of the occupational therapy in the rehabilitation department, and an idea became increasingly clear: to explore pottery as a rehabilitation intervention through research. She wrote down "The Feasibility of Art Therapy in Geriatric Rehabilitation" in a document and listed a preliminary literature search plan, feeling a renewed sense of purpose.

She helped her father adjust his knee pads and encouraged him, saying, "Try walking a few more steps today." Her father walked slowly but steadily, while Yu Xiaowen counted steps on her phone and kept cheering him on. In the end, her father successfully walked about 50 meters. When he stopped, his forehead was sweaty but he looked proud. Yu Xiaowen helped him sit on a bench, handed him warm water, and showed him the recorded data. The father and daughter happily discussed next week's goals.

events.name: Family dinner and precious time together
events.description: After training, she returned home, where her mother had already made braised noodles. The whole family sat around the table. Yu Xiaowen praised her father's progress that day, and her mother mentioned that Aunt Zhao from their hometown was getting better. After dinner, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother clear the dishes while her father sat on the sofa watching the news and occasionally joined in the conversation. Such ordinary evening moments made her feel the stability of home and the value of her work.

After comparing the progress with yesterday, she made a progressive training plan for the following week. She then browsed the medical English course (planning to complete the mock presentation on September 25) and briefly reviewed the questions she had gotten wrong in the attending physician exam preparation. Engrossed in planning, she didn't realize it was almost midnight. She moved her Baduanjin practice from the balcony to the living room to adapt to the cool autumn nights. She still insisted on meditation before bed, but her bedtime was delayed until the early morning.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday, resumed badminton to release stress. In the evening, my brother called to discuss support for rehabilitation costs. I hesitated about whether to borrow for the investment but finally chose to be conservative.

events.name: Went to Jinyu Badminton Hall to play badminton with Lin Wei.
events.description: In the evening, as agreed, Yu Xiaowen went to the Jinyu Badminton Hall near her workplace and practiced doubles with her badminton partner Lin Wei for about an hour. This was her first regular exercise after the interruption caused by her father's illness. During the exercise, she felt relaxed both physically and mentally, and sweating relieved her accumulated stress. Lin Wei also taught her some stretching moves to ease shoulder and neck soreness. After playing, the two bought mung bean smoothies from a roadside stall. Because she had indulged in the cold drink, Yu Xiaowen felt a slight discomfort in her stomach.

events.name: Received a call from older brother Yu Xiaofeng to discuss rehabilitation costs.
events.description: After exercising and returning home, Yu Xiaowen received a call from her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen. After asking about their father's rehabilitation progress, he proactively offered to transfer rehabilitation expenses every month. Yu Xiaowen, understanding her brother's pressure of repaying the loan, suggested transferring 2,000 yuan per month, but her brother insisted that because of his promotion and salary increase he could transfer 5,000, explaining that his monthly mortgage payment in Shenzhen was high so he could not do more. The two finally agreed to transfer 5,000 yuan per month.

events.name: Modifying the bookkeeping app and updating the budget
events.description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk and opened the expense-tracking app on her phone, raising her monthly income to reflect her brother's 5,000 yuan transfer. She rechecked the month's income, expenses, and savings goals, and confirmed that her demand deposits could cover three months of expenses.

events.name: Considered applying for a consumer loan but ultimately gave up.
events.description: After revising the ledger, Yu Xiaowen caught a glimpse of her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan's WeChat profile picture. Thinking that there might be a short-term funding gap recently, she opened the chat to ask about consumer loans. But after repeatedly weighing the interest costs and repayment pressure, she took a deep breath, closed the chat, and decided to rely on her savings and her brother's transfer to get by through cutting expenses.

events.name: Shared with Mother over video the decision that Brother supported
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her mother Li Xiuying, telling her about the decision for her brother to transfer 5,000 yuan each month. Her mother declined, saying that much wasn't necessary, but Xiaowen explained that it was a shared gesture from both siblings. Moved, her mother told them to take care of themselves as well.

During the meal, Yu Xiaowen confided in Sun Yue about the self-doubt triggered by a clerical error during a night shift a few days earlier, as well as her budding idea of transferring to the rehabilitation department. Sun Yue, drawing on her own experience in the high-pressure work of pediatrics, counseled her, encouraged her to focus on her physical and mental health first, and introduced a rehabilitation physician she knew well for her to consult. The two also agreed to attend a Wutong Tree Reading Club event together next month. The deep conversation lasted nearly two hours, and Yu Xiaowen felt understood, with her anxiety noticeably eased.

Yu Xiaowen drove back to her home in Jinshui District, listening to her European classical music playlist on the way. After arriving home, she washed up briefly, smiled at herself in the mirror, and tried to give herself positive affirmations. But after lying down, her thoughts still lingered on career choices, and she tossed and turned until the early morning before finally falling into a dazed sleep.

2025-06.daily_overview: Father made a breakthrough in rehabilitation—he used a walker to walk for the first time, and the whole family was thrilled. After work, Yu Xiaowen completed her monthly financial management operations, and her confidence greatly increased.

events.name: Yu Jianguo used a four-legged walker to walk for the first time in the rehabilitation department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen's father, Yu Jianguo, with the assistance of rehabilitation therapist Dr. Zhang, performed short-distance walking training for the first time using a four-legged walker in the corridor of the rehabilitation department ward at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Her father took more than ten steps slowly but steadily, maintaining good posture, while her mother, Li Xiuying, accompanied him throughout and recorded it on her phone.

events.name: Mother sent a video of Father walking
events.description: After her father's walking training ended, her mother, Li Xiuying, sent the full video she took via WeChat to Yu Xiaowen and shared the good news of his rehabilitation in the family group chat. In the video, her father's steps were slow but steady, and her mother kept encouraging him from the side.

events.name: After work, I repeatedly watched the video, extremely excited.
events.description: After the afternoon shift, Yu Xiaowen took out her phone at her home in Zhengzhou and saw a video her mother had sent of her father walking during rehabilitation. Deeply moved by her father's progress, she watched it three times, her eyes moist, and immediately forwarded it to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen.

events.name: Celebrated with her brother in the family WeChat group
events.description: After Yu Xiaowen forwarded the video to the family group chat, she sent three cheering emojis in a row to express her joy at her father's recovery and her gratitude for the family's care. Her brother then replied with a like and cheers, and the whole family celebrated together from afar.

events.name: Evening video call with parents to give direct encouragement
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen video-called her parents, directly congratulated and encouraged her father. He was in good spirits and said he felt more confident. The family shared the feeling that the hard caregiving had finally paid off, and they were greatly encouraged.

events.name: Execute monthly fund auto-investment and short-term wealth management.
events.description: After the video call, Yu Xiaowen sat in the study and opened the mobile banking app. Following the earlier advice of financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, she set up automatic investment of 1,000 yuan in each of two hybrid funds, for a total of 2,000 yuan; she also transferred 5,000 yuan from her current account into a 30-day short-term wealth management product with a 7-day annualized yield of 3.2%. After confirming payment, the system showed that interest would begin accruing the next day.

events.name: Updated the monthly asset allocation record in the notebook
events.description: After completing the transactions, Yu Xiaowen took out her dedicated personal finance notebook, recalculated and recorded the current month's demand deposits, short-term wealth management products, the market value of two funds, and the total monthly fixed investment, confirming that the overall allocation matched her conservative yet moderately steady style, and noted that next month she needed to pay attention to increasing the medical reserve fund.

start_state.mood: Normal daily state, hopeful for her father's recovery

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Excited and grateful, with a strong sense of hope for the family

2025-06.daily_overview: On the day shift, she made a small mistake due to lack of sleep and was reminded of it. She resolved to improve her sleep, downloaded a meditation app, and set short-term goals. After work, she was exhausted.

events.name: Was reminded by the supervising teacher for being inattentive while writing medical orders.
events.description: During the day shift, because of decreased concentration due to long-term sleep deprivation, Yu Xiaowen wrote the wrong number after the decimal point when adjusting the antihypertensive dose for a patient. Her supervising teacher, Li Wei, noticed it in time during review and gently reminded her to be more careful. This mistake made her deeply realize the serious impact of sleep problems on her work.

events.name: Created a bedtime meditation plan and downloaded the app.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen searched for mindfulness meditation apps on her phone, downloaded a highly rated app, and set herself a small goal: starting from that evening, do 10 minutes of basic meditation practice every night before going to bed to improve her difficulty falling asleep.

events.name: Asking Head Nurse Wu Min for relaxation tips in the department lounge area.
events.description: Before leaving work, Yu Xiaowen met head nurse Wu Min in the rest area and briefly mentioned that she had been sleeping poorly. Wu Min shared a breathing technique she had used (slow deep breaths in and out, counting silently in her mind) and suggested she try it when she could not fall asleep, encouraging her not to be so tense.

events.name: In the evening, seriously practiced 10 minutes of mindful breathing
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen washed up and sat on the bed, opened the meditation app for a 10-minute mindful breathing exercise. This time she tried hard to follow the guidance, and although her mind still wandered a bit, she improved compared with last time. After finishing, she lay down, and although she still fell asleep slowly, her anxiety had eased somewhat.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Slightly sleepy, body heavy

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Determined to change, feeling a bit relieved.

2025-06.daily_overview: During the night shift, due to days of sleep deprivation, she made another mistake. Fortunately, the head nurse Wu Min corrected it in time, and her fear and self-blame reached a peak.

events.name: During the late-night shift, she made another mistake while writing medical orders, which was caught by Wu Min.
events.description: Late at night, while on duty at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen, exhausted from days of caring for her family and severely lacking sleep, mistakenly wrote the wrong dose (twice the adult dose) when prescribing a common antibiotic for a patient. Wu Min, the head nurse on duty, immediately noticed while checking the medical order, gently tapped her on the shoulder to remind her, and helped correct it, avoiding a potential medical risk. Yu Xiaowen instantly became alert, and cold sweat ran down her back.

events.name: Brief solitary reflection in the on-call room in the early morning.
events.description: After the clerical error incident, Yu Xiaowen returned to the duty room and sat for a while, filled with self-blame and lingering fear. She opened the notes app on her phone and wrote: 'I almost made a serious mistake. I can't go on like this anymore.' She decided to talk honestly with her supervising teacher the next day.

2025-06.daily_overview: After catching up on sleep following her night shift, she was comforted by Head Nurse Wu Min's warm sharing and began to rebuild her professional belief. In the afternoon, she sorted out her thoughts and called her mother. In the evening, she found a mouth ulcer.

events.name: After the duty handover, she went home and caught up on sleep until the afternoon.
events.description: After finishing the shift handover at 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowen drove home, ate two slices of bread, and went straight to sleep. She slept until 1 p.m. When she woke up, she still felt heavy but her headache was not as bad.

events.name: Wu Min shared her personal experience in the rest area and offered encouragement.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to the hospital to deal with unfinished matters. Head nurse Wu Min deliberately pulled her into the department break room and shared an experience from when she first started working, when a family crisis nearly led to a medical error. She warmly encouraged her, ‘Don't keep yourself stretched to the breaking point; only by taking care of yourself can you take care of your patients.’ This conversation made Yu Xiaowen feel deeply understood, and the tears she had been suppressing finally fell.

events.name: Proactively arranged to talk with Teacher Li Wei next week to consult about applying for a department transfer.
events.description: After the conversation with Wu Min, Yu Xiaowen mustered her courage and sent a message to her supervising teacher Li Wei via WeChat, expressing that she wanted to consult him about her career direction. Li Wei quickly replied and arranged to discuss it in detail next Wednesday afternoon.

events.name: In the evening, talked with mother on the phone to report that she was safe and received comforting words.
events.description: In the evening at home, Yu Xiaowen called her mother Li Xiuying. She briefly mentioned being a bit tired from work but did not mention the writing slip incident. Her mother talked about how their father took a few more steps today and told her to eat well and not skimp on money. The casual conversation made Yu Xiaowen feel warm.

events.name: Discovered a mouth ulcer and took medication on her own.
events.description: After dinner, looking in the mirror, Yu Xiaowen found a white ulcer on the inside of her lower lip that hurt when touched. Thinking of her recent internal heat and stress, she found some watermelon frost spray to treat it and increased her water intake. She realized her body was sending a warning.

start_state.mood: Tired, in low spirits

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Being understood, warmth, and determination interwoven

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday, exercise and reading served as dual therapy. After finishing Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance, she wrote in-depth reflections. Her mother's suggestion to change her hairstyle triggered some thinking, and she formally restarted her bedtime meditation plan.

events.name: In the evening, she went to Jinyu Badminton Hall for a match against Lin Wei.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen went to Jinyu Badminton Hall as agreed to meet Lin Wei for their weekly badminton session. The two did about an hour of practice matches. Her stamina gradually recovered, but because she was still in the early stage of recovery, she felt slightly out of breath after half an hour of continuous singles. The next day she had mild muscle soreness in her thighs. After exercising she felt relaxed in both body and mind. Lin Wei patiently guided her again through shoulder and neck stretches, jokingly calling it the 'physician-exclusive package.'

events.name: Finished reading the final chapter of Better at home
events.description: After exercising and showering, Yu Xiaowen sat on the living room sofa and flipped through Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance, which she had been reading intermittently for several months, and finally finished the last chapter. In her reading notebook, she wrote: 'Excellence is not just in technique, but in the caution and humility of every daily choice.' This served as a deep reflection on the night-shift writing error, and she silently resolved to make caution a habit.

events.name: During a video call with my mother, I was advised to change my hairstyle.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her mother, Li Xiuying. Her mother noticed that she looked tired and had her hair loosely tied up, and casually suggested she try a new hairstyle, saying, 'Change your look, change your luck.' Yu Xiaowen was thoughtful after hearing this, looked at her slightly thin reflection in the mirror, and began seriously considering a change of image.

events.name: Formally restarting the mindfulness meditation plan before bed
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen opened the meditation app and did a 10-minute mindful breathing and body scan exercise, and made this her fixed pre-sleep ritual to improve sleep quality and anxiety. She felt more focused this time than before, and after finishing, she lay down and fell asleep a little more quickly.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

2025-06.daily_overview: Got up early and went to her parents' home to spend Father's Day with her father, combining English learning with rehabilitation training. After celebrating in the evening, she returned to her own place. Late at night, she confided her self-doubt to her best friend, with anxiety and emotion intertwined.

events.name: Went to her parents' new home on Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, early in the morning
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, after a simple breakfast, Yu Xiaowen drove 15 minutes to her parents' new rented place on Huayuan Road. On the way, she listened to a medical English podcast to review the week's vocabulary, arriving around 6:50. Her parents were already up, and her father was sitting in a wheelchair waiting.

events.name: Completed the medical English course at my parents' home
events.description: During a break in accompanying her father in the morning, Yu Xiaowen opened the Medical English app in the study of her father's residence, learned the day's new chapter—vocabulary and phrases related to rehabilitation medicine—took the unit quiz and got all answers right. She found that these words could be exactly used to analyze her father's rehabilitation literature.

events.name: Reading English papers and incorporating them into her father's rehabilitation training.
events.description: After studying, Yu Xiaowen took out a printed English paper titled "The Impact of Family-Involved Rehabilitation Training on Functional Recovery in Stroke Patients" from her folder, carefully read the abstract and methods sections, and marked the mirror training and task-oriented exercise steps with a highlighter. In the afternoon, during her father's training session, she explained the principles of mirror training to him and guided him to try using his healthy side to drive the affected side in simple hand movements. Her father found it novel and actively cooperated. She also recorded the training process with her phone, preparing for later optimization of the plan. During this period, she supported her father in walking practice, and felt obvious exertion in her own arms and lower back.

events.name: Ordered a custom sugar-free cake to celebrate Father's Day and her father's recovery progress.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen went to a nearby pastry shop to pick up a sugar-free cake ordered in advance by phone, with red lettering on it: 'Dad, keep going! Happy Father's Day.' She returned to the apartment and set a simple table with her mother, then brought the cake to her father. Her father's eyes welled up when he saw it, and the three of them hugged. Her mother recorded a video and sent it to the family group. When her brother saw it, he sent a video message of congratulations.

events.name: In the evening, returned to her own residence
events.description: After the celebration ended at about 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen drove back to her own place at her parents' urging, arriving home at 7:30 p.m., feeling a little tired but fulfilled.

events.name: Late at night, pouring out professional self-doubt to Wang Lina
events.description: At 11 p.m., after washing up, Yu Xiaowen lay down but tossed and turned unable to sleep. She picked up her phone and sent a message on WeChat to her close friend Wang Lina, who was far away in Shenzhen: 'Am I not cut out to be a doctor?' Wang Lina replied instantly: 'A good doctor is, first of all, someone who survives.' These words struck a chord with Yu Xiaowen. She took a deep breath, temporarily set aside her self-criticism, and replied, 'I'll try to live a little better.' After the conversation ended, her thoughts were still racing, and she did not fall asleep until the early morning.

events.name: Record the day's study and rehabilitation notes.
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen recorded in her reading notebook the key medical English vocabulary of the day, the core findings of the paper, and the effects of the adjusted training for her father, and noted, 'The course is more than halfway through, and applying what I have learned has been very rewarding.'

start_state.mood: Looking forward to spending the holiday with father

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Moved and self-doubting at once, but a friend brought me to my senses.

events.name: Received a package from Liu Yang at her parents' home
events.description: In the afternoon, a courier delivered a package. The sender was Liu Yang from Shenzhen. Xiaowen signed for it and brought the package into the living room. Her parents also gathered around curiously.

events.name: Opened the package and found a gift and a note
events.description: Opening the carton, there were two packs of Cantonese cured sausages and a box of Macau specialty golden-sand cookies, with a note: "Xiaowen, I heard your uncle is recovering. I'm sending you some Cantonese treats to try. Don't work too hard, and take care of your health." After reading it carefully, Xiaowen felt a warmth in her heart.

events.name: Sent a WeChat message to thank Liu Yang.
events.description: She sent Liu Yang a WeChat message on her phone: "Got the gift—it was such a surprise! The sausage and cookies look delicious. Thank you for caring about my dad. How have you been in Shenzhen lately?" Liu Yang quickly replied and asked about how her father was recovering.

events.name: Share gifts with my parents.
events.description: Xiaowen showed the gifts to her parents. Her mother remarked that Liu Yang was thoughtful, and her father joked that Cantonese cured meat paired with spicy soup had a unique flavor. The three tasted Golden Sand cookies. Xiaowen took a photo of her father smiling as he held the sausage box and sent it to the family group, and her brother replied.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: In the evening, she returned to her apartment and did a 10-minute meditation before bed, which slightly relieved the fatigue from the trip home.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Monday evening after work, she found that her mother had reorganized her exam-preparation flashcards. She was almost irritated, but after seeing the encouraging note her mother had left, she was moved and relieved. The mother-daughter connection deepened with greater mutual understanding.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning, she did 7 minutes of Baduanjin on the balcony to help start the day.

events.name: Discovered that her mother had sorted out the exam preparation cards.
events.description: Returning to her apartment after work in the evening, she found that all the exam preparation cards pasted on the refrigerator and at her bedside had disappeared, leaving tape marks. When she walked into the bedroom, the bedside card was gone too.

events.name: Found the card in the iron box and felt irritated.
events.description: On the coffee table, she found a green tin box. The cards were neatly placed inside, but the order was shuffled: her mother had organized them by body system rather than her review order. Xiaowen urgently needed to find the nervous system cards but couldn't find them. Irritation surged up, and she nearly complained.

events.name: Moved after reading Mom's note.
events.description: When she was about to burst with emotion, she found a note inside the iron box: 'Hang in there. Mom doesn't understand medicine, but she believes in you.' Xiaowen read it several times, thought of her mother's clumsy love, and her eyes grew hot and moist. Her irritation was replaced by being moved, and she did not call to complain.

events.name: Confided in her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat.
events.description: After calming down, she sent WeChat messages to Zhang Jing to vent. Zhang Jing instantly replied to comfort her and praised her progress, and the two chatted for a while.

events.description: At noon, did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder relaxation in the teaching room.

2025-06.daily_overview: After work on a weekday, she took an online mock exam. Her accuracy improved, but she discovered weak areas and re-planned her sprint schedule. In the evening, she tried a body scan meditation, and the stress-relief effect was obvious. For research, she organized midterm report data and downloaded literature.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, did 7 minutes of Baduanjin on the balcony, then had breakfast.

events.name: Took the online mock exam for attending physician
events.description: After getting home from work, she opened her laptop in the study, logged into the online simulated testing system, chose the core exam points paper for internal medicine, and answered questions with full concentration for about 2 hours, achieving a 68% accuracy rate, up 10% from last month.

events.name: Wrong-question analysis and plan adjustment
events.description: After carefully checking the answers, she found that the chapters on cardiovascular system drugs and neuropathology had the highest error rates. She highlighted the weak points with a highlighter and decided to spend half of her daily fragmented time memorizing weak knowledge points and the other half doing practice questions, adding targeted training.

events.name: Organize research data and download references
events.description: In the evening, in the department office, I organized the interim report data from the earlier univariate analysis into standard charts, and downloaded more than 10 papers from core journals via the hospital database to gather material for the introduction of my paper.

events.name: First attempt at body scan meditation.
events.description: At 10 pm, did a body scan meditation in the bedroom: scanning from toes upward, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and lower back, using breath to relax each area for about 2 minutes, 25 minutes total. Afterward, the shoulders and neck felt noticeably relaxed. Recorded feelings in the diary and plan to continue practicing.

events.name: Attend the final online discussion event for the Women's Power book list.
events.description: At 8 p.m., attended the final session of the three-month online discussion of the Women's Power reading list, reviewed the takeaways from 16 discussions, shared positive changes in career growth, mindset, and interest expansion, and expressed gratitude to the community.

events.description: Do 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching at noon.

2025-06.daily_overview: After my night shift, I rested but didn't just take it easy; I completed a first draft of the paper's introduction, made an intensive review plan for cardiovascular drugs, and received a question from my pottery teacher that made me want to take up the hobby again. Before bed, I continued body scanning, and my sleep improved.

events.name: Complete the first draft of the paper's introduction
events.description: Using the rest time after the night shift, in the hospital office, based on charts and retrieved literature, wrote the introduction to the paper, structured in three steps: research background, controversial issues, and research purpose. After three revisions, completed a draft of about 800 Chinese characters and saved it as "Paper_Draft_v1".

events.name: Formulate an intensive review plan for cardiovascular medications
events.description: After work, in her home study, she made a six-day intensive review plan for the cardiovascular system medications chapter based on weak points from the mock exam. The key points she highlighted included the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs and the management of digitalis poisoning, and she marked representative drugs and side effects. She planned to begin tackling it during her night shift break the next day.

events.name: Received a WeChat message from the pottery teacher and decided to take up pottery again.
events.description: In the evening, she received a WeChat message from her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong, asking whether she had any bisque pieces to fire together. This made her realize she hadn't touched clay in half a year and felt nostalgic. She opened the kaolin package sent by Su Ya, touched the fine clay, decided to start again, and replied to the teacher that she planned to make something small.

events.name: Do a make-up Baduanjin session in the evening.
events.description: Because she caught up on sleep during the day after a night shift, she did a make-up 7-minute Baduanjin session on the balcony in the evening to maintain the habit.

events.name: Deep body scan meditation before bed.
events.description: Before bed, do a 30-minute body scan meditation, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and lower back, imagining the breath bringing in warmth to relieve night-shift fatigue. In the gratitude journal, record the stress points discovered.

2025-06.daily_overview: During breaks in the workday, she studied the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs; she adjusted her bedtime routine to combine meditation with a gratitude journal, improving her sleep quality. In the evening, she drove to the pottery studio and, after six months, threw clay again, completing a rough tea cup and regaining a sense of peace she had long missed.

events.name: Fragmented-time study of antiarrhythmic drug classification.
events.description: During breaks in hospital duty, I used fragmented time to systematically study the classification of antiarrhythmic drugs. By comparing lecture notes and textbooks, I drew a classification tree diagram and focused on memorizing representative drugs such as lidocaine and propranolol.

events.name: Adjust and carry out the bedtime routine.
events.description: At 10:30 pm, I started a new bedtime routine: first I wrote a 5-minute gratitude journal, noting three small things; then I did a 15-minute body scan meditation, focusing on the shoulders and neck. I felt calm and fell asleep quickly.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin extended to 10 minutes
events.description: After her sleep improved, she resumed a full 10 minutes of morning Baduanjin, with smooth movements, and her body and mind felt clearer.

events.name: Feeling moved, she decided to go to the pottery studio.
events.description: After finishing work in the evening, she decided to go to the pottery studio that night. She packed up briefly, took her phone and car keys, and left home at 7 p.m.

events.name: Drove to Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio.
events.description: Drove along Jingsan Road and Longhai Expressway for about 20 minutes, arrived at the Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road in Guancheng Hui District, parked, and walked into the 'Between Clay' studio. Zheng Guodong was still trimming a pot under the lamp; he was a little surprised but very welcoming to see her.

events.name: Completed the initial shape of a tea cup by wheel-throwing
events.description: At around 7:30 p.m., she put on an apron, took about 300 grams of white clay, and made a simple tea bowl on the pottery wheel. Her technique was unfamiliar and the clay blank collapsed several times, but she no longer felt impatient. After nearly three hours of repeatedly pulling, raising, and shaping, she completed a rough tea bowl with a mouth diameter of about 8 cm. Zheng Guodong provided guidance from the side on the thickness of the base.

events.name: Arranged the next glazing time with the teacher.
events.description: After trimming the clay body, she discussed the glazing plan with Zheng Guodong. Zheng Guodong suggested letting it air-dry naturally for 3 days before glazing, and the two agreed to return to the studio on the evening of June 30 to do the work. Xiaowen placed the clay body on the drying rack and covered it with plastic wrap.

events.name: Return and share photos of the work
events.description: At around 10:30 p.m., she took photos of the tea bowl body from multiple angles and sent them to her best friend Su Ya, with the message that she had finally started. Su Ya replied with encouragement soon after. Then she started the car and headed home, feeling a long-lost sense of focus and calm on the way.

events.name: Focused study on managing digitalis poisoning.
events.description: After dinner, I sat at the desk, opened the textbook and online case analyses, and focused on the clinical manifestations and management process of digitalis poisoning. I wrote the key points by hand in my notes in a question-and-answer format and recited them aloud until I could fluently state the standard treatment steps.

events.name: Stick to the bedtime routine and record progress.

The number of times her mind wandered dropped to 0-1, and she was basically focused the whole time. That night she slept very soundly, waking only once at 3 a.m. to use the bathroom, and fell back asleep quickly. She woke up in the morning feeling refreshed.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, shopped for a home rehabilitation exercise bike with mother; installed and used it in the afternoon. Father started new strength training. In the evening, practiced the cardiovascular medication question bank, and played badminton at night to regain physical fitness.

events.name: Selected a home rehabilitation exercise bike with her mother.
events.description: On Saturday morning, I went with my mother, Li Xiuying, to a medical device specialty store on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District. After carefully comparing several home rehabilitation training bikes, we chose a magnetic-resistance pedal exerciser that displays heart rate and exercise time. I paid 3,500 yuan by card, and the clerk helped carry it to Xiaowen's car.

events.name: Install and instruct father on first use of the rehabilitation exercise bike.
events.description: In the afternoon, the mother and daughter transported the exercise bike to the parents' home, and Xiaowen assembled it step by step according to the manual. She then guided her father Yu Jianguo to start using it: she adjusted the seat height, set the lowest resistance, and had him try pedaling for 15 minutes, monitoring his heart rate and perceived exertion, and recording them in the rehabilitation log. Her father felt soreness in his leg muscles but found it acceptable, and said with a smile, "Better than just sitting around."

events.name: Specialized question bank practice on cardiovascular system drugs.
events.description: Later in the afternoon, at her desk, she used the medical exam online question bank on her phone to do 50 multiple-choice questions on the cardiovascular drugs chapter, covering antiarrhythmic classification, digitalis toxicity, and commonly used antihypertensive drugs. She reviewed the explanations, highlighted the weak points in the questions she got wrong in yellow, and added notes.

events.name: Evening badminton with Lin Wei
events.description: On Saturday evening, she went to Jinyu Badminton Hall for the last regular game of the month with Lin Wei. After an hour of doubles play, her stamina had basically returned to pre-interruption levels, and she sweated thoroughly. After the exercise, Lin Wei continued to guide her through lower-limb stretching to relieve the discomfort from squatting while installing the exercise bike. They agreed to continue in July.

In the morning I completed the final step of the hairstyle makeover: haircut, a light perm, and coloring, giving a completely fresh look. events.name: Early morning rehabilitation walk with family.

Father's gait is gradually steadier, and Xiaowen's lower back has adapted. After training, Father was in good spirits, and Xiaowen felt gratified.

events.name: Went to the hair salon for a full hairstyle makeover.
events.description: In the morning, she went again to the hair salon in Zhongyuan District, where the same stylist from last time gave her a full service of haircut, light perm, and coloring. She chose a natural dark brown hair dye, which complemented the slightly curled ends. Two hours later, she was satisfied with the result; in the mirror she looked more energetic and professional.

events.name: Took photos to share her new look

She sent the one she was most satisfied with to the family group and the close friends group. Her mother instantly replied, "My daughter looks really beautiful." Zhang Jing sent a string of starry-eyed emojis, and Wang Lina commented, "Gentle and capable."

events.name: Evening review of exam preparation notes.

Using different colored pens, she sorted key content by chapter, including antiarrhythmic drug classification, digitalis toxicity management, and antihypertensive drug mechanisms, producing 5 pages of logically clear handwritten notes containing tables, flowcharts, and memory mnemonics, as core material for the final sprint before the exam.

First she reviewed the framework by asking herself questions and answering them, then went over the wrong questions and difficult points, such as the differential diagnosis of digitalis toxicity and the principles of selecting antiarrhythmic drugs. Finally, she orally summarized the key scoring points and confirmed she had mastered them, laying the foundation for the weekend mock exam sprint.

events.name: Going to the pottery studio for glazing.
