2025-02.daily_overview: On the fourth day of the Chinese New Year, the Spring Festival holiday was still ongoing. In the morning, after briefly reviewing for the attending physician exam and doing waist stretches at their Luoyang home, Yu Xiaowen went with her parents to Luoyang Central Hospital. In the afternoon, her older brother Yu Xiaofeng rushed back from Shenzhen. All four family members discussed the rehabilitation plan for their father Yu Jianguo with the attending physician in the ward, and formally established a division of labor for weekend care. After returning home in the evening, she prepared a simple dinner with her mother, feeling heavy-hearted but filled with determination to protect her family.

events.name: Early morning exam preparation, stretching, and caring for father
events.description: After getting up at 7 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen used the quiet period in the study of her parents' home on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, to review the cardiovascular system section of the attending physician exam, focusing on the treatment guidelines for myocardial infarction and heart failure. After reviewing, she did 10 minutes of yoga on the mat, including cat stretch and child's pose targeting the lower back, to relieve the soreness caused by prolonged sitting during recent caregiving. Around 8 o'clock, she helped her mother get her father up, wash up, and then fed him breakfast.

events.name: Discussing the home rehabilitation plan
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaofeng flew from Shenzhen to Luoyang and went directly to the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital. Yu Xiaowen, her parents, and her brother sat around father's hospital bed, discussing the systematic rehabilitation plan for Yu Jianguo (left-sided hemiplegia) with the attending physician. Considering Yu Xiaowen's job in Zhengzhou, after nearly an hour of discussion they finally decided: Yu Xiaowen would continue working in Zhengzhou and drive back to Luoyang every Friday evening for weekend care; brother Yu Xiaofeng, due to urgent work projects in Shenzhen, would return to Shenzhen to provide financial support and remote assistance; mother Li Xiuying would be responsible for father's daily hospital care. After the plan was set, Xiaowen recorded the doctor's rehabilitation recommendations and medication adjustments in detail in her phone memo.

events.name: Evening family time
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen returned home from the hospital and prepared dinner in the kitchen with her mother, cooking millet porridge and reheating the handmade dumplings delivered by the community. Her father, Yu Jianguo, was practicing holding a spoon with his left hand in the living room, and Xiaowen encouraged him. After dinner, the family sat in the living room watching TV and chatting about everyday matters. Her brother shared news from Shenzhen, and Xiaowen talked about her work at the Zhengzhou hospital; it was a rare relaxed atmosphere. After washing up at 10 p.m., Xiaowen made her bed in the guest room, checked her father's medication list, stood by the window for a moment, and did a few side stretches before falling asleep.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Worried about my father; he still has slight discomfort in his lower back.

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: With family duties clearly divided, she felt a bit more at ease, but remained worried about her father's recovery progress.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fifth day of the first lunar month, Yu Xiaowen and her brother spent the whole day with their parents at home in Luoyang. In the morning they went to the hospital together to accompany their father and guide him in simple bed exercises. In the afternoon, Xiaowen used the quiet time to continue preparing for the attending physician exam and organizing her father's medication records. In the evening, the family of four had a simple reunion dinner in the ward. Her brother shared his life plans in Shenzhen, which put their parents' minds at ease.

events.name: Hospital care and first attempt at rehabilitation
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng went together to the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital. Xiaowen first helped the nurse turn her father over and pat his back. Then, under the guidance of the rehabilitation therapist, she and her brother helped her father try to use his healthy arm to pull the affected upper limb for passive stretching, holding each stretch for 5 minutes and repeating 3 sets. Although it was strenuous for her father, he was highly cooperative. During the session, Xiaowen also did a few neck and shoulder circles to relieve stiffness from standing for a long time.

events.name: Exam preparation review and organizing father's medication
events.description: After going home for a short rest at noon, Yu Xiaowen focused for 2 hours in the study on the respiratory system diseases chapter for the attending physician exam and did 40 practice questions, scoring about 70% correct. At 3 p.m., she took out her father's pillbox and carefully checked the discharge medications—aspirin, atorvastatin, nifedipine controlled-release tablets, etc. She wrote the administration time and precautions for each drug on label paper and stuck it onto the compartmentalized pillbox for her mother to manage. When she finished, she stood up to mobilize her lumbar spine and did several standing forward bends.

events.name: Simple meal in the ward and a heart-to-heart talk between siblings
events.description: At 5 p.m., her mother cooked tomato egg noodles at home, packed them in a thermos, and brought them to the ward. The family of four sat around a small table eating noodles; her father managed to hold a spoon with his left hand but was very happy. After the meal, her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng took out his phone to show their parents pictures of Shenzhen and his company's environment, saying that after being promoted to project team leader he was under some pressure but could handle it, and he promised to transfer 5,000 yuan to his father every month for rehabilitation costs. Xiaowen listened and silently noted her brother's contribution. At 8 p.m., the siblings walked home together. On the way, Xiaofeng reminded her to take care of herself and not to collapse from all the rushing around. After getting home, Xiaowen did 5 minutes of foam roller rolling in the living room to relax her lower back.

start_state.mood: Cherish the time of family reunion; the lower back soreness has eased a bit.

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Moved by her older brother's sense of responsibility, and somewhat relieved.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the sixth day of the first lunar month, a legal holiday. Mother Li Xiuying decided to personally make a meal that tasted like home for the family members staying with the patient at the hospital. In the morning, Xiaowen helped her mother shop and prepare ingredients. In the afternoon, her mother carefully simmered hulatang soup and braised noodles in the kitchen. In the evening, the whole family sat together to enjoy this warm dinner. After cleaning up, her brother and father went home first, while Xiaowen stayed at the hospital with her mother to accompany the patient late into the night, her heart filled with the warmth of home.

events.name: Street Market Shopping and Meal Prep
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen accompanied her mother to the community vegetable market near Kaixuan Road to buy ingredients for hulatang, such as beef bones, wood ear mushrooms, and vermicelli, as well as high-gluten flour to make hand-pulled huimian noodles. After returning home, Xiaowen tied on an apron and helped her mother wash and prepare the side ingredients: soaking wood ear mushrooms, mincing ginger, and washing greens. While her mother simmered the beef bone broth, she taught Xiaowen how to mix the spice ratio for hulatang; Xiaowen carefully wrote it in her phone memo. Because she stood for a long time, she occasionally tapped her lower back muscles.

events.name: Mother lovingly cooks hometown flavors
events.description: At 3 p.m., Li Xiuying was busy alone in the kitchen: first she simmered a rich broth from beef bones, then added cooked beef shank, shredded wood ear mushrooms, and fried tofu puffs one by one, thickened it with starch slurry, and finally drizzled in mature vinegar and sesame oil — a pot of thick, spicy hot soup was done. Then she kneaded dough, let it rest, pulled it into wide strips, boiled them, and tossed them with garlic sauce and chili oil to make two large portions of braised noodles. She poured the spicy soup into a large insulated thermos, divided the braised noodles into two glass lunch boxes, and wrapped them in cotton cloth to keep warm. Xiaowen was in the living room organizing her father's CT scans and medical records for the doctor's convenience.

events.name: Father and son delivering meals and reuniting in the ward
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, her father Yu Jianguo and older brother Yu Xiaofeng set out from home. Yu Jianguo insisted on carrying the thermos himself, and Yu Xiaofeng held the lunch box. The two walked ten minutes to the bus stop and took Bus No. 23 to the hospital. Along the way, Yu Jianguo asked whether Xiaowen found working in Zhengzhou tiring, and Yu Xiaofeng said their younger sister had become more responsible. At 6:10, the four of them gathered in the ward; their mother had also arrived earlier by electric bike from home. They moved a small table over, poured the spicy soup into bowls, and served the braised noodles. Father shakily picked up the soup spoon with his left hand and took the first sip, his eyes slightly moist, and said it was still your mother's cooking. Mother kept urging Xiaowen not to always order takeout after returning to Zhengzhou. Her brother shared funny stories from his office building in Shenzhen, drawing bursts of laughter. Xiaowen, because of the delicious food, could not help eating an extra bowl and felt a long-missed sense of fullness.

events.name: Warm follow-up and farewell
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, the whole family tidied up together: Mother cleaned the thermos, Xiaowen wiped the table and swept the floor, and her brother took out the trash. Father and brother said goodbye to mother and daughter, telling them not to be too tired while accompanying the patient at night. As Father walked out of the ward, he looked back at Xiaowen, his eyes full of concern. After the ward quieted down, Xiaowen tucked the quilt corners around Father, opened the copy of Better she had brought, and read for half an hour. Mother spread a thin quilt on the companion bed and quietly looked at the night outside the window. Before bed, Xiaowen walked slowly in the corridor for 10 minutes and did a few chest-expansion exercises to relieve her feeling of fullness.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Looking forward to my mother's cooking, and I also want to help with household chores.

end_state.location: Ward companion chair at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Warm at heart, greatly supported by family strength, but feeling slightly bloated from eating too much.

state.daily_exercise: Round-trip walk for errands about 5,000 steps; evening stroll and 10 minutes of chest expansion exercises

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the holiday, Yu Xiaowen packed her bags and prepared to return to Zhengzhou for work. In the morning, she said goodbye to her parents and brother and carefully checked the condition of the car; in the afternoon, she drove back to Zhengzhou along the Lianhuo Expressway, listening to classical music to relieve fatigue on the way; late at night, after arriving at her apartment in Jinshui District, she video-called her brother to report that she was safe. After a little tidying up, she fell into a deep sleep, recharging for her return to work the next day.

events.name: Farewell and Pre-Trip Preparations
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen was packing her suitcase at her home in Luoyang: she packed the dirty clothes into a bag, and put in the handmade steamed dumplings her mother had packed and a bottle of chili sauce. She checked her phone charger and the USB drive containing her medical records, making sure nothing was left behind. Then she put on gloves and checked her car's tire pressure (2.5 bar, normal), the oil dipstick level, and the wiper fluid level, and topped up the wiper fluid. At 10:30, she hugged goodbye to her parents and older brother. Her mother's eyes were slightly red; her brother patted her shoulder and said, 'Drive safely, see you on the weekend.' Just before she left, her mother tucked a small bag of dried red dates into her backpack.

events.name: Highway drive with classical music
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowen drove her white Corolla from Xigong District, Luoyang, entered the Lianhuo Expressway via Luoyang Station. The total distance was about 130 km, and she maintained a steady speed of 100 km/h. On the way, she made a brief stop at the Zhengzhou service area, filled a thermos with hot water, confirmed the fuel level was sufficient, and got out of the car to do a few bend-and-touch-the-floor stretches to relieve the stiffness in her lower back from sitting for too long. At 3 p.m., she switched the car audio to play MP3 classical music, felt the sound quality was mediocre, and thought it was worth upgrading.

events.name: Returning home late at night and checking in with family from afar
events.description: At 8 p.m., she arrived at the underground garage of the apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. She first took out the food and luggage her mother had packed from the trunk. Upstairs, she put the steamed dumplings in the freezer. After a quick wash, she opened WeChat and video-called her brother to let him know she had arrived home safely and ask about their father's rehabilitation situation that afternoon. Her brother said their father had kept mentioning her after taking a nap. After hanging up, she sat on the sofa in a daze for a while, then applied a hot towel to her lower back, and fell into a deep sleep at 22:50.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Reluctant to say goodbye, but needing to shoulder work responsibilities

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Though the journey was tiring, I am ready to return to work.

state.daily_exercise: No specific exercise; only walked and loaded/unloaded luggage, stretching at the service area.

2025-02.daily_overview: First day back to work after the holiday. After the morning meeting, she devoted herself to clinical work and handled several inpatients. During the lunch break, encouraged by her close friend Sun Yue, she enrolled in an online medical statistics course. In the afternoon, her supervising teacher Li Wei suggested expanding a cardiovascular case report into a paper. Yu Xiaowen immediately began a literature search and made an initial writing plan. With work and study running in parallel, the busy day reawakened her professional expectations.

events.name: Morning meeting after returning to work and routine ward rounds
events.description: At 7:55 a.m., Yu Xiaowen arrived at the cardiology doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital 5 minutes early. At 8:00 sharp, the morning handover meeting was held under the direction of department director Zhang Lei. The night-shift physician reported on the management of 3 newly admitted patients with acute myocardial infarction. After the meeting, she joined Li Wei's team on ward rounds, responsible for recording blood pressure and heart rate changes for patients in Bed 11 and Bed 15, and adjusted the antihypertensive medication orders. During this, she took the opportunity to turn her neck to relieve the fatigue of sitting at a desk for a long time.

events.name: Enrolled in an online medical statistics course.
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Yu Xiaowen saw a message on WeChat from her best friend Sun Yue: 'Didn't you say you were going to work on your paper? This medical statistics course is quite good and very systematic.' Xiaowen clicked the link and carefully read the course syllabus in her computer browser. It covered modules such as descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis, exactly matching the needs of her upcoming paper. She immediately used Alipay to pay 899 yuan to complete the registration, joined the course's WeChat group, and checked that the first live session was scheduled for 7 PM on February 8. After registering, she excitedly sent Sun Yue a voice message of thanks.

events.name: Thesis initiation and literature search
events.description: At 3 p.m., the supervising doctor Li Wei walked to Yu Xiaowen's workstation with a medical record and said, 'Xiaowen, the myocardial infarction patient with hypertension and diabetes that you managed before the new year has a very well-organized medical record. You could consider expanding it into a case report and submitting it for publication.' He opened the hospital intranet database and demonstrated a search strategy. Xiaowen readily accepted. Then she used the computer to search for articles with the keywords 'acute myocardial infarction, comorbidities, prognosis' and found 23 papers. She downloaded 5 highly relevant ones and created a folder named 'Case Report Writing'. She made a three-week plan: the first week, closely read the literature and complete the introduction; the second week, organize the data and methods; the third week, write the main text and discussion. Feeling a faint ache in her lower back after sitting for a long time, she did a few seated spinal twists in her chair.

events.name: Course preview and quick dinner after work
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowen walked 10 minutes back to her apartment. She took out the frozen steamed dumplings her mother had made, microwaved them, and had them for dinner. After dinner, she opened her laptop and logged into the medical statistics course platform to preview the first module, 'Variable Types and Data Distribution.' She watched a 20-minute introductory video and took notes. After studying until 20:30, she felt physically tired. She had planned to do stretching but gave up, and instead made a brief video call to her mother to ask how her father was doing today, then washed up and rested.

start_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: First day back at work, nervous yet fulfilling

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: With a clear thesis goal, I'm full of drive, but my body feels a bit tired.

state.daily_exercise: Commuting on foot round trip about 2,000 steps; seated spinal twist in the office.

2025-02.daily_overview: On a workday, Yu Xiaowen spent the day in routine clinical work. In the morning she followed Dr. Li Wei in the outpatient clinic and learned patient consultation skills; in the afternoon she handled ward matters independently and used spare moments to browse the papers and literature she had downloaded the night before; in the evening, after attending the department professional study session, she had a brief meal with her colleague Wang Fang and exchanged thoughts on adapting to work after the holiday.

events.name: Outpatient clinic shadowing and medical record writing.
events.description: From 8:30 to 11:45 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen shadowed Dr. Li Wei in Examination Room 5 of the cardiology outpatient clinic. She was responsible for recording patients' chief complaints, medical history, and medication information. When they encountered typical signs such as mitral facies, Dr. Li would explain in a low voice. They saw 42 patients over the morning, and Xiaowen quickly learned outpatient communication skills, occasionally shrugging to relax her neck and shoulders. After returning to the inpatient building at 12:00 noon, she rushed to complete the admission records for newly admitted patients and revise the discharge summaries for the next day.

events.name: Fragmented literature reading
events.description: At 2 p.m., the ward was relatively quiet. Taking advantage of the period with fewer monitor alarms, she opened the article downloaded last night, "Analysis of Short-Term Prognosis in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction with Metabolic Syndrome," on the computer at the doctor workstation and highlighted key data with a highlighter—patients with three or more metabolic disorders had a 30-day readmission rate as high as 18%. She wrote in her notebook: "Can compare with our hospital's case data." While reading, she remembered to stand up and move for a while every 30 minutes.

events.name: Department lecture and gathering with colleagues
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., the department held its biweekly professional study session in the demonstration room. Attending physician Liu Qiang shared a rare case of myocardial noncompaction, and Xiaowen carefully recorded the key diagnostic points. After it ended at 5:45, her colleague Wang Fang invited her: "First time meeting after the holiday, want to get some hot and sour noodles at the stall by the entrance?" The two chatted while eating at Chen's Noodle Shop near the hospital. Wang Fang complained about the trivialities of training new staff, and Xiaowen also talked about the exhaustion of running around after her father fell ill, encouraging each other. Xiaowen deliberately ordered a non-spicy clear broth, but still felt slight gastrointestinal discomfort. At 7 p.m. they each went home, and Xiaowen bought a cup of yogurt on the way to relieve it.

events.name: Evening review and note organization
events.description: After returning to the apartment, Yu Xiaowen washed up briefly, sat at her desk, and organized the notes from the day's clinical shadowing, circling a few unclear ECG phenomena and planning to ask Teacher Li Wei the next day. Then she opened the attending physician exam app and answered 30 internal medicine questions, with an accuracy rate of 65%. At 22:15, she sent her mother a WeChat message: “I learned a lot in the outpatient clinic today. How is Dad?” After receiving her mother's reply “Everything is stable,” she stood by the window looking at the night view, did a set of chest expansions and side bends, and then went to sleep.

start_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Feeling fairly energetic and willing to engage in work

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Felt somewhat relieved after being understood by colleagues, but had slight gastrointestinal discomfort.

state.daily_exercise: Commuting on foot about 2,500 steps; during office breaks, did multiple shoulder and neck relaxation exercises and standing.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Friday, she began the first trip of her two-city commute. After handling clinical affairs in the morning, she hurriedly organized the medical insurance reimbursement materials for her father's hospitalization during the lunch break and took photos to send to her brother; in the afternoon, she helped her brother submit the reimbursement application online; after work in the evening, she drove directly along the Lianyungang-Khorgas Expressway back to Luoyang. Light snow began to fall on the way, so she slowed down and drove carefully. After arriving home in the evening, she talked with her mother about her father's condition and settled in briefly.

events.name: Organizing and forwarding medical insurance materials.
events.description: At 12:10 noon, Yu Xiaowen did not go to the cafeteria. She took out from the office drawer all the invoices, expense details, diagnosis certificates, and copies of her father's social security card from his hospitalization. She sorted the materials by hospitalization date and used her phone to take vertical photos one by one, making sure the edges were clear. Then she sent them to her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng via WeChat in original quality, with the message: "Brother, the total cost is 13,547 yuan. According to Luoyang policy, about 60% can be reimbursed. Please log in to the medical insurance platform and submit it." Because she had bent over to search, her waist began to ache again, so she sat sideways on the chair and did a few cat stretches.

events.name: Submitting online reimbursement during work breaks
events.description: At 3 p.m., after the department's case discussion ended, Yu Xiaofeng replied to the message: 'Got it, I'll handle it right away.' He immediately used his computer in Shenzhen to log in to the official website of the Luoyang Municipal Healthcare Security Bureau, entered the personal online service hall, uploaded the 20 photos Xiaowen had sent step by step, filled in the reimbursement application form, and submitted it. The system showed that review was expected within 5 business days, with an estimated reimbursement amount of 8078 yuan. Xiaofeng took a screenshot and sent it to his sister: 'Success, keep an eye out for it.' Xiaowen's nerves, strained all noon, relaxed slightly, and she quickly drank the hot water from her thermos to warm herself.

events.name: First weekend driving back to Luoyang
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen picked up her car from the hospital's underground garage and set the navigation to her parents' home on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City. Shortly after entering the Lianhuo Expressway, fine snow began to fall. She slowed to 80 km/h and turned on the fog lights and heater. The car stereo played light music stored on her phone while she kept a vigilant eye on the road. On the way, she stopped at a service area to check whether the wipers had frozen, and called her mother to say she would be home around 7:30. When she got out of the car, she quickly did a few high knees to warm up.

events.name: Long talk with mother after returning home on a snowy night
events.description: At 7:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowen arrived safely at the door of her home in Luoyang. Her mother, Li Xiuying, heard the car and came out to greet her, taking the rehabilitation grip ball Xiaowen had bought for her father. Her father, Yu Jianguo, had already gone to bed. Xiaowen tiptoed into the bedroom and looked at his calm sleeping face before feeling at ease. Afterward, the mother and daughter chatted in the living room. Her mother said that her father had been able to stand for 5 seconds while holding the edge of the bed over the past two days, but his appetite was still poor; she had made chicken soup and coaxed him into drinking some. Xiaowen held her mother's rough hand, saying that tomorrow when they went to the hospital together, they should be sure to ask the nutrition department. After the chat, she did simple waist and back stretches on the yoga mat in the living room before washing up.

start_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: On Friday, she was eager to return home but also worried about the reimbursement

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Arrived home safely, temporarily relieved of work burdens; lower back feels a bit looser after stretching.

state.daily_exercise: No specific activity during the drive; after getting home, I stretched my lower back for 10 minutes.

2025-02.daily_overview: On a compensatory rest day. In the morning, Yu Xiaowen received an iPad mini and a warm note from her best friend Wang Lina, who had sent them from Shenzhen. She immediately activated the device and downloaded apps for medical statistics and literature reading. Then she spent the whole day at Luoyang Central Hospital accompanying her father and assisting with rehabilitation training, using the new iPad to record her father's blood oxygen and gait data. In the evening, she went home to help her mother make dumplings. The integration of technological assistance into her care made her feel the warmth of her friend's support.

events.name: Received remote encouragement and tools are in place
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yu Xiaowen signed for a SF Express delivery at her doorstep. Inside was an iPad mini (WiFi, 64GB) sent by Wang Lina, with a sticky note reading: 'Don't push yourself too hard, but don't give up either. — Nana.' Xiaowen's eyes warmed, and she immediately unboxed and activated it: connected to WiFi, logged in with her own Apple ID, downloaded apps like 'Medical Statistics,' 'EndNote,' and 'GoodReader' from the App Store, and imported the research materials she had organized before the New Year. She also updated the iPad's music library and downloaded a few high-resolution trial tracks.

events.name: All-day ward care and data collection.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Xiaowen arrived at the hospital with her new iPad. She first helped her mother wipe down her father and change his clothes, and used the iPad to record her father's morning blood pressure of 132/85 mmHg. At 10, when the rehabilitation therapist came to guide the training, she used the iPad to film a video of her father performing passive range-of-motion exercises, planning to show it to her older brother. In the afternoon, while her father napped, she read several articles on early post-stroke care from rehabilitation medicine public accounts on the iPad, and created a new 'Father's Rehabilitation Log' in Notes to record changes in gait and muscle tone. During the caregiving period, she used the iPad stand to do several standing stretches while watching.

events.name: Evening household cooking and remote communication
events.description: At 5 p.m., she got home, and her mother had already kneaded the dough. Xiaowen washed her hands and helped roll out the wrappers; the mother and daughter made dumplings stuffed with chives and eggs. After dinner, she had a video call with her older brother on her iPad, showing him their father's training video: "Look, today he actively bent his leg with a greater range than yesterday." Her brother looked carefully and told her to get some rest. Then Xiaowen opened Tencent Video and watched Xinwen Lianbo with her father. Although the old man had difficulty speaking, he would nod in response. Before bed, she played a soothing piano piece to relax.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Received a gift; felt touched and uplifted.

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Obtained my father's latest data and felt encouraged by his rehabilitation progress.

state.daily_exercise: In the hospital corridor, she supported her father while walking for about 15 minutes, and did standing stretches during breaks from accompanying him.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, high school classmate Chen Siyu made a special trip from Luoyang Old Town to visit her at the hospital, bringing handwritten cards and old photos that awakened youthful memories. After her classmate left, Xiaowen accidentally discovered a high-resolution classical music channel on her iPad and subscribed to it, downloading a stress-relief playlist. In the afternoon, she cooked a nourishing soup at home and brought it to the hospital, sharing it with her parents in the evening. While accompanying her father alone at night, she organized the music on her iPad, her thoughts drifting to the upcoming journey back to Zhengzhou.

events.name: Old friend's visit and memories of youth.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Chen Siyu walked into the ward carrying a fruit basket and a handwritten card album. She excitedly grabbed Xiaowen and said, "I finally found the notebook of notes we passed around in high school!" The two flipped through the yellowed cards and the photo taken at the school gate. Siyu pointed at one and said, "Look how shy you were back then." Laughter echoed softly in the ward. Her father watched them from the side and smiled slightly. Before leaving, Siyu slipped Xiaowen a pack of peanut crisp from Luoyang's old town. "Have a piece when you're stressed." Xiaowen opened it and ate one on the spot; the sweetness eased her fatigue a little.

events.name: Opening a new world of classical music
events.description: At 2 p.m., after Chen Siyu left, the ward was left with Xiaowen and her napping father. She browsed the App Store on her iPad and happened to see a channel called 'High-Resolution Classical: Timeless Masterpieces' in Apple Music recommendations, with an annual fee of 198 yuan. When she sampled Beethoven's 'Moonlight Sonata,' the clearly layered piano sound instantly absorbed her. She immediately subscribed via Alipay and selected 12 pieces including Mozart's 'Requiem' and Dvorak's 'From the New World' to create a 'Commute/De-stress' playlist, downloading all of them for offline listening. She couldn't resist putting on her earphones and closing her eyes to listen for a while, feeling her heart rate calm down.

events.name: Making soup at home and supplementing nutrition
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen went home to make soup for her father. She blanched the chicken carcass and skimmed off the foam, added red dates, goji berries, and angelica root, and simmered it in a clay pot over low heat for 2 hours. During that time, she also cooked a bowl of frozen wontons for herself to regain strength. In the evening, she strained the rich broth, poured it into a thermos, and brought it back to the hospital, feeding her father spoonful by spoonful. Her father drank two bowls, his forehead slightly sweating, and kept saying 'warm'.

events.name: Evening care and music sorting
events.description: At 7 p.m., mother went home to rest, and Xiaowen stayed in the hospital room. After her father fell asleep, she opened her iPad, sorted the tracks in the “Commute/De-stress” playlist by composer era, connected to the newly purchased small Bluetooth speaker, lowered the volume, and played Bach’s “Air on the G String” as background music. In her notebook she wrote: “Today’s two rays of light—an old friend and new music—make the night of caregiving less hard to bear.” At the same time, she did a few simple yoga side bends following the video to relax her shoulders and back.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Looking forward to seeing an old friend, to ease the tension a little.

end_state.location: Ward companion chair at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Comforted by old friendship and music, heart softened

state.daily_exercise: Walked approximately 4,500 steps round trip between the hospital and home, and did simple evening yoga stretches during the caregiving time.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, she set off from her home in Luoyang at 6 a.m. and returned to Zhengzhou, arriving at work at 7:30 to attend the department morning meeting. She officially started the new week's work, handling the backlog of progress notes; during the lunch break she went to the supermarket to buy healthy ingredients instead of takeout; after work in the evening, she transferred the high-resolution playlist from her iPad to the car's audio system and experienced the improved sound quality. Back at her apartment in the evening, she organized the laundry, had a brief video call with her mother, and confirmed that her father was stable.

events.name: Returning at dawn and continuing with the morning meeting
events.description: At 5:50 a.m., the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen quickly washed up, spread a yoga mat on the guestroom floor, and followed a newly downloaded Baduanjin instructional video on her iPad for 10 minutes, feeling her body stretch and relax. Then she brought the tea eggs and pancakes her mother had packed and set out from her home in Luoyang. She drove along the Lianhuo Expressway as the sky gradually brightened. On the way, she stopped at the Gongyi Service Area and bought a hot cup of soybean milk. At 7:20 a.m., she arrived at the hospital parking lot, changed into her white coat, and rushed into the doctors' office just in time for the 7:35 morning meeting. Today's discussion focused on a heart failure patient with diuretic resistance. Her suggestion to add a maintenance sodium supplement was acknowledged by Li Wei with a nod.

events.name: Adjust dietary structure
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Yu Xiaowen remembered that the body fat scale had shown a slight increase in body fat percentage, and that constantly being on the go could easily lead to internal heat. She walked to the Dennis supermarket near the hospital and picked out dragon fruit, yogurt, whole-wheat bread, and a chicken breast salad to replace the spicy takeout she usually ordered. She stocked a box of nuts and instant multigrain powder in her office desk drawer for snacks. After lunch, she also paced around the hospital's small garden for 10 minutes to aid digestion.

events.name: In-car music upgrade.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowen went to the parking lot and used a data cable to import the downloaded high-resolution classical music playlist from her iPad into the SD card of the car's multimedia system, replacing the original low-bitrate MP3s. When she started playing it, the fourth movement of Dvořák's Ninth Symphony rang out powerfully, and the soundstage was noticeably wider. She posted a photo of the steering wheel and iPad on Moments with the caption: 'Mobile concert hall.' Her friend Lin Wei commented instantly: 'Don't get too carried away while driving!'

events.name: Evening household chores and long-distance reminders
events.description: After returning to the apartment, she sorted the accumulated laundry into the washing machine and hung the bed sheets to dry. Dinner was homemade yogurt with fruit and whole wheat bread. At 8:30 p.m., she had a video call with her mother. On the other side of the screen, her father leaned in and said, 'Xiaowen, have you eaten?' Although his voice was intermittent, it was clear. She replied happily, 'Dad, I'm eating!' Her mother said that today her father had walked for 10 minutes in the living room with the help of a walker. After hanging up, she opened the statistics course replay and made up half an hour of content, preparing for the live session on February 12. She then did 10 minutes of stretching and core activation exercises (bird dog and dead bug) on the yoga mat, and then washed up and went to rest.

start_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Drowsy but must get going; lower back still slightly uncomfortable.

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Feeling pleased that her father's speech had improved, and her body felt limber after Baduanjin practice.

state.daily_exercise: Morning Baduanjin qigong for 10 minutes, walked about 1,500 steps from the parking lot to the office, evening stretching and core activation for 10 minutes

2025-02.daily_overview: Tuesday, clinical work as usual: in the morning I participated in monitoring a patient after thrombolysis for myocardial infarction. During the lunch break, I went to the rehabilitation physiotherapy department of our hospital and successfully borrowed a rehabilitation resistance band and grip balls, planning to take them back to Luoyang on the weekend to set up a rehab corner. In the afternoon, I found time at the doctor's workstation to continue reading literature and supplement data for the introduction of my paper. In the evening, I tried out the rehabilitation equipment at my apartment and studied statistics course videos to prepare for the weekend home rehab training.

events.name: Clinical monitoring and cross-department borrowing
events.description: At 8:15 a.m., Yu Xiaowen was assigned to monitor a patient after thrombolysis for acute myocardial infarction. She recorded the patient's electrocardiogram and blood pressure every 15 minutes until the patient was transferred to the general ward at 11:00. During the lunch break at 12:15, she went to the hospital's rehabilitation physiotherapy department, found the familiar therapist Xiao Wang, explained her father's condition, and asked to borrow one set each of resistance bands (green, medium resistance) and grip balls. Xiao Wang readily brought out the registration book, and she signed the borrowing agreement and promised to return them in half a month. In the rehabilitation department corridor, she also watched stroke patients doing standing training and quietly noted movements she could use.

events.name: Deep dive into the literature
events.description: At 2 p.m., after finishing her progress notes, Yu Xiaowen continued reviewing the literature she had downloaded last Friday. She compared the Discussion sections of three similar case reports side by side and found that blood glucose management during the rehabilitation period for patients with comorbid diabetes was rarely mentioned. She wrote in red pen in her notebook: "Entry point: the association between blood glucose control and recurrence rate in diabetic patients with myocardial infarction during rehabilitation." She planned to discuss it with her teacher Li Wei next time. During this period she sat for long stretches, and from time to time she stood up to do calf raises and half squats to counteract prolonged sitting.

events.name: Evening equipment trial and learning
events.description: After work, she brought the rehabilitation resistance band and grip ball back to her apartment. Dinner was chicken breast salad. After the meal, she followed the rehabilitation instruction manual and tried the resistance band for upper limb resistance exercises, feeling the tension at different stretch lengths, and recorded a short video to demonstrate to her father on the weekend. Then she opened the video of the second module 'Central Tendency and Dispersion' of the medical statistics course, learned the concepts of mean and standard deviation, and did 10 practice problems. Before bed, she called her mother: 'Mom, I borrowed some good equipment and will bring it home on the weekend.' After that, she did a set of bird-dog exercises and planks to strengthen her core.

start_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Daily work, slightly tired.

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Felt a small sense of achievement in preparing for the weekend rehabilitation, and felt relaxed after exercise.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen started a 4-week online medical English trial course. Using fragmented time during commutes and lunch breaks, she completed the registration and studied the basic medical roots of the first lesson on the mobile app. At work, she rotated to the CCU to learn monitoring knowledge. In the evening, she returned to her apartment to systematically review and organize notes, feeling that every step of learning was contributing to caring for her father and her career development.

events.name: Signed up for a medical English trial class.
events.description: During a break at 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowen searched on her phone and found a 4-week trial course for medical English vocabulary breakthroughs promoted by the 'Medical Classics English' WeChat official account, costing 9.9 yuan. She read the course introduction, which included high-frequency affixes for the cardiovascular, nervous, respiratory and other systems. She clicked to register and paid via WeChat Pay, immediately received the course activation code, and joined the student group. She browsed the course syllabus and found that 5 units were unlocked each week, allowing her to learn anytime in spare moments, which suited her very well. To stay alert, she made a cup of black coffee.

events.name: Start fragmented learning
events.description: After registering, she immediately opened the first lesson, 'Cardiovascular Word Roots.' While walking to the hospital during her commute, she put on earphones and listened to the root explanations: 'cardio- heart, myo- muscle, endo- inner...' while silently repeating them. At noon, while waiting for her meal in the staff cafeteria, she used the app to do the matching card test and scored 80%. She drew a simple heart diagram in her notebook and labeled it 'endocardium.' During the afternoon break between ward rounds, she quickly reviewed suffixes such as '-itis (inflammation), -ectomy (removal)' and took the chance to stand up and walk around.

events.name: CCU rotation clerkship
events.description: Today she was assigned to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) rotation. Under the guidance of the teaching nurse, she learned to zero and connect the invasive arterial blood pressure monitoring device, and observed the care of an IABP (intra-aortic balloon pump) patient. Teacher Li Wei reminded her: 'This monitoring knowledge will also help you write that myocardial infarction case report; pay attention to the blood pressure curve.' She used GoodNotes on her iPad to draw a simple circuit diagram and noted down the key points. The tense environment of the CCU kept her highly focused.

events.name: Evening systematic review and core training
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to her apartment and sat down at her desk. She opened the replay of the medical English course video, repeated long words like "hypertension" and "myocardial infarction" after the recording, and recorded her own pronunciation to compare with the standard pronunciation. Then she organized the day's accumulated 18 roots and 15 suffixes into an Excel table and saved it to her iPad. Before closing her computer, she exchanged encouragement with Wang Fang on WeChat: "I memorized 30 words today, how about you?" Wang Fang replied: "Crazy, but I memorized 10, haha." Before bed, she spread out her yoga mat and did a 15-minute session of neck, shoulder, and waist stretches, adding alternating bird-dog and forearm plank exercises to strengthen her core.

start_state.mood: Feeling curious and excited about the new course; basically no symptoms in the lower back.

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, the work pace in the department was intense. In the morning, she handled several temporary medical orders; during the lunch break, she continued memorizing medical English affixes; in the afternoon, she began showing early signs of a cold but still kept working. In the evening, she received a video call from her best friend Zhang Jing, and they talked at length for nearly an hour. She confided her recent stress and exhaustion and received warm comfort. Zhang Jing told her that she had sent local specialties from Luoyang, and Xiaowen thanked her repeatedly. After hanging up, she insisted on completing the third day's study check-in for her English course and wrote a short essay to record her mood. However, because of cold symptoms, she went to bed early but tossed and turned.

events.name: Busy Clinical Work and Noon English Practice
events.description: In the morning, two patients were discharged. Yu Xiaowen was responsible for writing the discharge summaries and giving medication instructions. She didn't get to eat lunch until 12:40. While eating her boxed meal, she used a mobile app to review yesterday's affixes and learn new content: 'hypo- low, hyper- high.' She jotted down on the back of an old receipt: 'hypoglycemia low blood sugar vs hyperlipidemia high blood lipids.' In the afternoon, she handled a medication consultation and happened to use the new word 'contraindication,' which secretly pleased her. But after noon she began to feel a bit chilly and a stuffy nose started to appear.

events.name: Online heart-to-heart with a close friend
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen answered Zhang Jing's WeChat video call in her apartment. In the video, Zhang Jing, wearing an apron, was cooking at home in Luoyang. The two started by teasing each other's looks today, then gradually went deeper. Xiaowen poured out her feelings: 'I feel torn in half: half of me wants to work hard and write my paper, and the other half just wants to stay in Luoyang. I drove on the expressway again this week, and I was especially frightened in the snow.' Zhang Jing listened patiently and comforted her: 'You're not Superman. It's already great that you've held up. Dad is recovering and the paper is being written—don't rush. I sent you a box of peony cakes and braised beef. Remember to check the package. Eat well, and you'll be in a better mood.' Xiaowen's eyes were slightly red, and her voice already sounded nasal.

events.name: First take a hot shower, blow-dry her hair, and apply a moisturizing mask; then lean against the headboard, send the compiled rehabilitation materials of her father to the rehabilitation doctor by email, and attach a short message.
events.description: After the video call ended, Xiaowen felt her headache and nasal congestion getting worse. She measured her temperature at 37.2°C, took Banlangen, and wrapped herself in a thick quilt. She forced herself to stay alert and opened Unit 3 of the course, 'Nerve Roots': neur/o- nerve, encephal/o- brain, mening/o- meninges. She wrote the roots on sticky notes and put them beside her water cup, and got full stars in the quiz. Then she opened the diary app on her iPad and wrote: 'Tonight, I was fed a whole box of peace of mind. Tomorrow is Valentine's Day, but all I want is for Friday to come soon so I can go back and accompany Dad in resistance band training. But I hope my cold doesn't get worse.' After writing, she turned off the lights and lay down early, but because of her nasal congestion, she had trouble falling asleep and tossed and turned.

start_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Body is somewhat tired, psychological load is heavy, and started feeling chills in the afternoon.

end_state.location: Apartment, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Nourished by friendship, negative emotions were relieved, but troubled by a cold.

2025-02.daily_overview: Valentine's Day, but Yu Xiaowen was more concerned about family finances. In the morning, she received a text message about the medical insurance reimbursement for her father's hospitalization, and promptly notified her family; during lunch break, she still persisted in learning medical English; in the afternoon, her cold worsened, but she insisted on finishing her work, left work on time in the evening, and set off again on the expressway back to Luoyang. After returning home, she told her father the reimbursement amount. The old man took her hand and said repeatedly, 'It's settled.' She shared a photo of street lights on a snowy night in the family group chat with the caption 'Friday road home'.

events.name: Reimbursement received and family notified
events.description: At 10:22 AM, Yu Xiaowen received a text message from China Merchants Bank on her phone: 'Your card ending in 3582 received a transfer of 8078 yuan (reimbursement from the Luoyang Medical Insurance Fund).' She immediately took a screenshot and sent it to the family WeChat group: 'Dad's hospitalization reimbursement has arrived! 8078 yuan in total!' Her older brother replied at once with 'Efficient.' Her mother sent a voice message: 'I just got the text message too. This is such a relief.' Xiaowen quietly breathed a sigh of relief in the office, but then she coughed violently and quickly put on her mask.

events.name: Persisted in learning English despite being unwell.
events.description: At noon, she used half an hour after lunch to open the course, entered the unit "Departments and Common Diagnoses", and learned words such as Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, and Diagnosis. She split the screen on her iPad, played the explanation audio on the left side, and made a mind map on the right side, labeling the entire hospital department structure in English. But nasal congestion made her voice muffled, so she drank plenty of warm water. Before the evening shift handover, head nurse Wu Min came to check the medical orders. Xiaowen said in a hoarse voice, "This patient needs a Cardiology consult." Wu Min was amused and also told her to rest more.

events.name: Wrapping up while unwell and preparing to go home
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowen finished writing the last two progress notes and completed bedside handover with the doctor on duty. Because she had a cold, she wore two layers of masks. Using the half hour before leaving, she organized her work plan for the next week: on Monday she needed to submit a medication review report, and on Tuesday she would make an appointment with the rehabilitation department to discuss her father's long-term plan. Then she poured out the cold tea, turned off the computer, packed her charger and iPad, and left on time at 5:30, her steps a little unsteady.

events.name: Returning home on Friday evening and feeling the warmth of home
events.description: At 7:10 PM, Yu Xiaowen was driving on the Lianhuo Expressway, with the new pressure sore prevention cushion she had bought for her father in the passenger seat. She played Dvořák's Humoresque, but the lighthearted melody sounded dull because of her cold. Along the way, she stopped at a service area to refuel and bought two cups of hot milk tea, one for her mother, while she herself drank hot ginger tea in an attempt to break a sweat. She arrived at the home in Luoyang at 8:30. As soon as she entered, her mother took the milk tea and said, 'Hey, you even bought this.' Her father, sitting in the living room, heard her voice and tried to raise his left hand to wave. Xiaowen showed her father the reimbursement screenshot; he nodded slowly and said in a slurred but firm voice, 'There's money... no need to worry.' Xiaowen squatted down to check the swelling in his ankles, then they discussed the weekend rehabilitation plan. But then she had a fit of coughing, and her mother urged her to go rest.

start_state.mood: Awaiting the reimbursement result, but my cold has worsened and I feel light-headed and weak.

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Financial pressure eased, feeling relaxed and grateful, but a cold caused physical discomfort

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yu Xiaowen accomplished a major task at home in Luoyang: setting up a home rehabilitation corner for her father. In the morning, she and her mother cleaned the living room corner, laid anti-slip mats, arranged rehabilitation equipment, and hung up calligraphy motivational scrolls that her father loved; in the afternoon, her best friend Sun Yue specially came from Zhengzhou to help with care, allowing Xiaowen to go home to rest and cook nutritious soup; in the evening, she returned to the hospital to deliver the soup and explain matters; at night, Sun Yue stayed in the ward, while Xiaowen quietly studied medical English anatomy terms at her parents' home, feeling the solid support of her circle of friends. Her cold symptoms had greatly reduced.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and preparation of the rehabilitation corner
events.description: After getting up at 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen felt her cold had improved and her stuffy nose was clear. She went to the living room and did 10 minutes of Baduanjin on a yoga mat following a video, paying special attention to stretching movements such as "holding the hands up to regulate the Triple Burner." After working up a light sweat, she felt refreshed. Then she called her mother to start setting up the home rehabilitation corner.

events.name: Building a home rehabilitation corner
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying moved the old cardboard boxes stacked in the east corner of the living room to the storage room, swept the floor clean with a broom, and then repeatedly wiped away the dust with a wet mop. Xiaowen cut the dark blue non-slip mat she had bought to a size of 1.5m x 1.2m, fitted it perfectly, and laid it flat. Then she neatly placed the green elastic band and orange grip ball borrowed from the hospital into the storage basket on the left side of the mat. Finally, standing on a chair, she used no-trace adhesive strips to hang her father's favorite calligraphy piece, a horizontal banner reading "Heaven rewards the diligent," squarely on the opposite wall. Her mother brought a rattan chair with a backrest and placed it near the corner for her father to rest. Xiaowen took a photo of the finished setup and sent it to the family group, tagging her father: "Your personal gym is ready!" It was a lot of physical work, and though she was sweating, she felt much lighter.

events.name: Best friend support and rotating care
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yue drove from Zhengzhou to Luoyang and followed the navigation directly to Luoyang Central Hospital. Xiaowen was waiting for her in the parking lot, and they hugged as soon as they met. Xiaowen detailed the nurse station contact, feeding times, and medication list, then said to Sun Yue: 'It's all up to you tonight. I'm going home to catch up on sleep.' Sun Yue patted her chest: 'Don't worry, this is a good chance to review neurology nursing.' Before leaving, Xiaowen stayed with Sun Yue in the ward and chatted with her father for a while. Her father was happy to see young faces too. She noticed that she no longer had a cough and her energy had recovered considerably.

events.name: Resting at home and cooking nourishing soup
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned to her home in Luoyang. She first took a hot shower and changed into loungewear. After resting for half an hour, she cooked beef brisket and radish soup in a pressure cooker, adding corn segments and a small amount of astragalus to supplement protein for her father. While the soup bubbled on the stove, she sat on the sofa eating an apple and flipping through a paper in the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine about home-based stroke rehabilitation training, using a red pen to circle 'Bobath hand clasp' and 'bridge exercise'. Once the soup was ready, she poured it into an insulated food jar. During this time, she also did a few yoga forward-fold stretches. In addition, during breaks in caregiving, she observed the rehabilitation equipment in the hospital's rehab department, such as the limb linkage trainer and balance board, and noted down her career change idea: perhaps she could become a home rehabilitation instructor.

events.name: Handover and night study.
events.description: At 6 p.m., she delivered the insulated food container to the ward. Her father was awake, and Sun Yue was helping him with hand massage. Xiaowen fed her father a bowl of soup, then went over the evening care notes with Sun Yue: help him turn over every 2 hours, record the number of times he urinates at night, and give him medication at 8 a.m. the next morning. When leaving, she gently hugged Sun Yue and said, "A great kindness needs no words of thanks; next time I'll treat you to a big meal." Back at her parents' home, her mother had already prepared dinner. After dinner, Yu Xiaowen opened Unit 4 'Musculoskeletal System' of Medical English in her room, repeated "skeleton, femur, patella" aloud, and drew a simple human figure labeling the anatomical terms. After studying, she did a 5-minute simple pre-sleep stretching routine, only gentle leg and shoulder stretches. At 10 p.m., Sun Yue sent a message: "Your uncle is sleeping very soundly, don't worry." She replied with a bear hug emoji and fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Cold is getting better, feeling excited and solemn about decorating the rehabilitation corner

end_state.location: Parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowen began her day at her parents' home in Luoyang. She prepared a loving breakfast for her parents, then went to the hospital to accompany her father. In the afternoon, she drove back to Zhengzhou through the snow and received local specialties sent by her best friend. In the evening, she focused on exam preparation, finishing cardiovascular system notes and practice questions, and wrote the first draft of a case report for her paper. Before bed, she did a short stretching routine, made a plan for the next week, and fell asleep at 23:15.

events.name: Prepared breakfast for parents
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen got up and prepared breakfast for her parents in the kitchen of her parents' home in Xigong District, Luoyang. She cooked millet porridge that her father loved, heated the steamed buns her mother had made, and fried three eggs. After carefully plating, she brought them to the table.

events.name: Friend and vegetable stall owner.
events.description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen spread out her yoga mat near the window in the living room and did 10 minutes of Baduanjin practice. The movements were slow and expansive, focusing on 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Remove Heart Fire' to relieve the shoulder and neck stiffness caused by caregiving.

events.name: Went to the hospital to accompany and care for her father.
events.description: At exactly 8:00, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying went together to the inpatient ward of Luoyang Central Hospital. She proactively helped her father Yu Jianguo wipe his body and change clothes, assisted him with turning over in bed, and fed him the morning supplemental fruit puree. While accompanying him, she told her father interesting things that happened at the hospital, successfully making him laugh and making the ward atmosphere much lighter.

events.name: Said goodbye to mother and drove back to Zhengzhou.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowen finished her caregiving shift. After briefly going over precautions with her mother, she drove her white Volkswagen Lavida from Luoyang back to Zhengzhou. Light snow began to fall on the expressway, so she slowed down, turned on the fog lights, and played Bach's unaccompanied cello suites on Apple Music to stay focused.

events.name: Received a package of local specialties from her best friend's hometown.
events.description: When she arrived at her residence at No. 89, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou at 6:30 in the evening, she found a delivery box at the door. After going inside and opening it, there were peony cakes, Luoyang meat swallows, and silver-striped vegetables sent by her best friend Zhang Jing, along with a handwritten card reading: Take care of yourself, keep going. Yu Xiaowen felt a warmth in her heart, took a photo and sent it to Zhang Jing on WeChat to express her thanks, and quickly reviewed several medical English diagnostic terms on her phone as fragmented learning.

events.name: Evening exam preparation and thesis work.
events.description: After a simple dinner, Yu Xiaowen sat down at the desk in her study, took out the Internal Medicine textbook for the attending physician qualification exam, organized the key points of the cardiovascular system chapter into a mind map, and marked easily confused points with colored pens. Then she opened the medical question bank app on her tablet and completed a timed set of 50 cardiovascular system practice questions. After grading, she scored 72%, and focused on analyzing the arrhythmia questions she got wrong. The entire study session took about 90 minutes.

events.name: Wrote the first draft of the case description for the paper
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop, pulled up the patient medical records she had organized earlier, and began writing the case description section of her paper. She described in detail the clinical presentation, imaging features, and initial treatment response of the complex case, carefully weighing her wording, and completed an initial draft of about 800 words by 10 p.m.

events.name: Pre-sleep relaxation: classical music and warm milk.
events.description: After turning off the computer, Yu Xiaowen played Chopin's nocturne on her phone, sat down on the living room sofa, and drank a glass of warm milk to help herself calm down from intense mental work. Then she washed up and got ready for bed.

events.name: Make a plan for next week
events.description: Before bed, listed next week's key tasks in the diary: 1) Daily medical English check-in; 2) Master the exam points for atrial fibrillation and premature ventricular contractions; 3) Make progress on the paper introduction; 4) Organize rehabilitation nursing materials before returning to Luoyang on the weekend. After completing the plan, prepared for sleep.

events.name: Brief neck and shoulder stretches at night
events.description: At 11 p.m., Yu Xiaowen did a 5-minute shoulder-neck stretch in bed to relieve the fatigue of a day at her desk, then turned off the light and fell asleep.

events.description: During the lunch break, she met her colleague Liu Qiang in the office looking up literature, so she asked Liu Qiang about the English pronunciation and clinical use of a few unfamiliar drugs. Liu Qiang patiently explained and recommended the drug monographs on UpToDate.

events.name: Communicate online with financial advisor and adjust regular fund investment.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen had a video call with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat. Wang Mingyuan analyzed recent market volatility and, based on her risk tolerance and income stability, suggested increasing the monthly fixed-amount investment from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan and adding a bond-biased fund to balance risk. Yu Xiaowen agreed to the plan, then immediately logged into the China Merchants Bank App, increased the monthly fixed-amount investment by 250 yuan for each of her two existing hybrid funds, and newly set up a 500 yuan monthly fixed-amount investment in a bond-biased fund. The operations were successful.

events.name: Bookkeeping and budget review
events.description: After the financial operations, she opened the bookkeeping app, checked this month's expenses, confirmed they were within budget, and set a reminder for the next deduction date to ensure sufficient funds.

events.name: Before bed, read "Better".
events.description: Half an hour before bed, Yu Xiaowen picked up "Better" from the bedside and read a chapter on improving medical quality, underlining lines and jotting notes, then turned off the light at 11.

2025-02.daily_overview: After the Friday workday ended, Yu Xiaowen once again set off on the road back to Luoyang. After stretching in the early morning, she reviewed what she had learned in medical English over the week. In the evening, she drove back to Luoyang through the snow, hugged her mother, and learned about her father's recent condition, preparing for the weekend of care. Because of the tiring journey, she went to bed early after returning to Luoyang.

events.name: Morning stretching and breathing exercises.
events.description: She got up at 7:00 a.m., did a 10-minute stretch in the living room, and added five deep-breathing exercises, imagining herself as steady as a tree to set a calm tone for a busy day ahead.

events.name: Review the week's medical English content overall during the commute.
events.description: On the way to work, she did not listen to a new lesson; instead, she opened the review mode of the course app, randomly played all the vocabulary and example sentences from the week, self-tested her memorization rate, and strengthened her weak points.

events.name: Clinical work and shift handover preparation
events.description: During the day, handle routine diagnosis and treatment in the department. In the afternoon, prepare the weekend patient handover items in advance and have a detailed handover with the on-duty doctor to ensure everything is foolproof.

events.name: Drive back to Luoyang and listen to classical music
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Yu Xiaowen drove her private car from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, heading west along the Lianhuo Expressway. Light snow fell outside the window. She turned on the seat heater and Apple Music and played Mahler's Fifth Symphony, letting the music accompany her through the 2-hour drive.

events.name: Arrived in Luoyang and talked with mother
events.description: At 7 p.m., she arrived at her parents' home on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang. Her mother, Li Xiuying, came up and took the rehabilitation aids she had brought. After a brief greeting, Yu Xiaowen asked in detail about her father's rehabilitation training and emotional state that day. Learning that her father had walked a few steps with a walker in the afternoon, she felt a little relieved.

events.name: Organize caregiving items and plan the next day's schedule.
events.description: After dinner, she put a change of clothes and study supplies such as an iPad into her backpack, and wrote Saturday's care plan on her phone memo: go to the hospital at 8 a.m., tidy up old items in the afternoon, and keep the appointment with a classmate. Because of fatigue from continuous work plus the trip, she washed up and went to bed earlier than usual.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but eager to go home

end_state.location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yu Xiaowen began a fulfilling day in Luoyang: after morning Baduanjin, she went to the hospital to accompany her father during rehabilitation training and used her lunch break to study medical English; in the afternoon, while sorting through old things, she found her middle school diary, which brought nostalgic feelings. Later, she took a City Walk in the old town with her high school classmate Chen Siyu, enjoying food and memories; in the evening, making dumplings with the family and writing her paper were interwoven—busy but warm. Before bed, she talked with Sun Yue on the phone and agreed to meet the next day.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin to relieve fatigue
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, she completed a full 10-minute set of Baduanjin exercises in her parents' living room, paying special attention to the move 'Seven heel bounces to eliminate all diseases' to promote circulation of qi and blood and relieve the lower back soreness caused by long periods of sitting as a caregiver.

events.name: Accompanying father and assisting with rehabilitation training
events.description: At 8 a.m., she went to Luoyang Central Hospital with her mother. Yu Xiaowen first helped her father do basic exercises at the bedside, such as leg flexion and extension and arm lifts, then helped him walk slowly about 10 meters in the ward, encouraging him constantly. Afterwards, she sat by the bed and read the day's Luoyang Evening News to her father. The father and daughter discussed the news in a warm atmosphere. She also recorded her father's training progress and communicated with the rehabilitation therapist about the next steps.

events.name: Studied treatment-related medical English during caregiving breaks.
events.description: While her father napped, Yu Xiaowen opened the course on her iPad and studied treatment-related terms such as 'therapy,' 'surgery,' 'prescription,' and 'rehabilitation,' and completed the accompanying fill-in-the-blank exercises.

events.name: Found junior high school diary while sorting old things
events.description: After returning home from the hospital in the morning, she used her free time to sort through the old item boxes in the study cabinet, uncovering childhood toys, yellowed homework notebooks, and picture books. At the bottom of one cardboard box, she was pleasantly surprised to find a locked diary from her middle school days. She sat on the sofa and carefully flipped through it, seeing the nicknames of friends, classroom anecdotes, and innocent dreams she had recorded back then. The corners of her mouth unconsciously turned up, and she felt a surge of emotion at how quickly time had passed. She then carefully put the diary back and decided to read it again another day.

events.name: A City Walk with Chen Siyu at Lijing Gate in the Old Town.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowen left home and took a bus to Lijing Gate in the Old City District of Luoyang to meet her high school classmate Chen Siyu. The two strolled along Cross Street, complaining about work pressure while admiring the renovated old street. They sat down in a time-honored spicy pepper soup shop, each ordering a bowl of rich spicy pepper soup with fried dough, and then bought peony cakes at a pastry shop to share. Passing by a used bookstore, they went in to browse. Yu Xiaowen found a copy of Stories of the Old City of Luoyang and happily bought it. Along the way, they talked about mutual high school friends and their youthful days until they said goodbye at the intersection in the evening.

events.name: Went to the food market with her mother and made dumplings.
events.description: In the evening, she returned to her parents' home and went with her mother to a nearby market to buy fresh pork, chives, and dumpling wrappers. Back home, the mother and daughter sat around the dining table making dumplings. Her mother taught her the technique of pinching pleats, and Yu Xiaowen's dumplings looked better and better. Some of the dumplings were frozen for later, and some were cooked that night, and the family enjoyed a hot dinner together.

events.name: Writing the introduction section of the paper
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop in the study of her home in Luoyang and began writing the introduction of her paper. She organized the background knowledge of the disease field and, drawing on the literature, explained the research significance and uniqueness of the case. During writing, she repeatedly used PubMed to look up references and adjusted her wording. By 10 p.m., she completed the first draft of the introduction and saved it together with the case description written the day before.

events.name: Arranged to meet my best friend Sun Yue tomorrow.
events.description: Before going to bed, she had a WeChat call with Sun Yue and learned that Sun Yue was coming to Luoyang tomorrow to help. Yu Xiaowen was very grateful, and the two discussed a time to meet.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but looking forward to the caregiving and the nostalgic trip.

end_state.location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang
end_state.mood: Body is tired but the spirit is full; friendship and family bring warmth.
