2025-02.daily_overview: Sunday was the last day of this caregiving stay. After her morning exercise, Yu Xiaowen went through the discharge procedures for her father together with her mother. In the morning, she assisted her father with the final inpatient rehabilitation training; in the afternoon, she used a brief break to try resuming jogging. Later, her close friend Sun Yue helped tidy the ward and helped her father walk home. In the afternoon, she used the remaining clay to make a handmade tea cup, rediscovering the joy of pottery. In the evening, she had a video call with her cousin to get caregiving advice and felt warm inside.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin practice in the small courtyard
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowen stepped out of the house and completed 10 minutes of Baduanjin in the open area of her parents' small courtyard. The early spring breeze brushed her face, and she felt her movements become more extended and stable, embracing the last day of caregiving with a calm mindset.

events.name: Assist father with rehabilitation training and discharge procedures.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she went to the hospital with her mother. In the ward, she assisted her father with balance standing and short-distance walking training, and helped organize his personal belongings. At 11, they completed the discharge procedures. Her mother brought a wheelchair, and Yu Xiaowen carefully wrapped a scarf around her father. The three returned together to their home on Kaixuan Road.

events.name: First time resuming jogging, 2 kilometers
events.description: After lunch, while her father napped and her mother accompanied him, Yu Xiaowen put on her running shoes and tried to resume jogging along the riverside path on Kaixuan Road in Luoyang. She ran 2 kilometers at a comfortable pace, taking about 11 minutes and 15 seconds, with her heart rate maintained at 140-150 beats per minute. Although her heart and lungs felt strained, the joy of running again lifted her spirits. After the run, she did 5 minutes of stretching.

events.name: Her best friend Sun Yue came over to help and then said goodbye.
events.description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, her best friend Sun Yue came from Zhengzhou to Luoyang to help. She helped support her father as he got out of the car and went upstairs, and together they arranged the recuperation environment at home. After a simple lunch for the three of them, Sun Yue accompanied Yu Xiaowen to sort out the medicines and rehabilitation equipment they brought back. At 4:00 in the afternoon, Sun Yue was about to return to Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen walked her to the community gate, and the two hugged goodbye. Yu Xiaowen said gratefully, 'Luckily I have you. See you again in Zhengzhou.'

events.name: Home pottery: hand-forming a teacup
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen took out from the storage cabinet a bag of gray clay left over from the pottery class before the New Year (about 500 grams) and tools (a wooden trimming knife, a simple turntable, a water basin, and a damp cloth). She spread old newspapers on the living room dining table, kneaded the clay, and then began shaping a handmade teacup. She used the coil-building method; although the cup wall was slightly crooked, she carved the character Yu on the bottom at the end, giving it a simple, rustic charm. After putting away the tools, she looked at the piece and felt a long-lost sense of peace and the joy of creation.

events.name: Video call with cousin to gain caregiving experience
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen initiated a video call with her cousin Li Yaqin, who was far away in Hangzhou, from her bedroom. Her cousin asked in detail about her father's condition and shared her experience caring for her sick mother-in-law, including how to prevent elderly falls and how to balance nutrition. She also encouraged Yu Xiaowen to maintain balance in her own life. The two also talked about fun childhood memories of climbing mountains together, and the call lasted nearly an hour. After the call, Yu Xiaowen recorded her cousin's suggestions in her phone's memo app, feeling fulfilled and warm.

events.name: Before bed, help mother settle father down for the night.
events.description: At 9:30, she helped her mother give her father a sponge bath, prepared the pill box for the next day, and did not return to her own room until she confirmed that the night light in the bedroom was on.

start_state.location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang
start_state.mood: A little reluctant to leave, but looking forward to the new stage after my father returns home.

end_state.location: Bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang
end_state.mood: Pottery and family affection bring satisfaction; restarting jogging brings vitality; I am full of confidence in my father's recovery.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of Baduanjin, then resumed a 2 km jog.

2025-02.daily_overview: Early Monday morning, Yu Xiaowen stretched at home in Luoyang, left a detailed note with instructions, said goodbye to her mother, and drove back to Zhengzhou. On the way, she signed up for the Women's Power Shared Reading Plan. After attending the department morning meeting on time, she reviewed rehabilitation literature during the lunch break, and in the evening downloaded the shared reading book for spiritual recharge. The new week began with bustling travel and personal growth. Because she had gotten up early for the return trip, she felt quite sleepy at night and went to bed early.

events.name: Morning stretching and preparation for the return trip
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen got up and did a 10-minute stretch in the living room of her parents' home, focusing on her neck and shoulders, and walked briskly around the room a few times to shake off sleepiness. Then she quickly packed her belongings and checked the car.

events.name: Wrote medication and rehabilitation reminder notes for my father
events.description: She sat at the desk in her father's bedroom and wrote detailed reminders in pen on an A4 sheet: her mother's three daily medication times (8:00, 14:00, 20:00), rehabilitation training (standing every morning and pedaling on the exercise bike every afternoon), and the documents and materials needed for next Wednesday's follow-up visit. At the end, she drew a smiley face. After writing, she put the note on her father's nightstand and held it down with a cup.

events.name: Verbally reminded her mother and said goodbye.
events.description: Around 6 o'clock, she went to the kitchen and found her mother Li Xiuying preparing breakfast. She quietly repeated the key points on the note, emphasized, “Mom, you also need to take your medicine on time, don't get too tired,” and hugged her mother to say goodbye. Her mother nodded with tears in her eyes, and Yu Xiaowen turned and left.

events.name: Drive back to Zhengzhou and sign up for the Women's Power Co-Reading Program
events.description: At 6:30, she set off from Luoyang by car. On the expressway, she opened the Fan Deng Reading app and found the '2025 Women's Power Book List' co-reading plan on the homepage, including books such as The Second Sex and Lean In. Deeply moved, she felt she needed to draw strength for women's growth under the dual pressure of family and career, so she immediately clicked to sign up and planned to join the online discussion every Tuesday at 8 pm. Meanwhile, the app automatically played the key insights audio of The Second Sex, and she listened for about 40 minutes while driving.

events.name: Attend the department morning handover meeting and start the day's work
events.description: Arriving at Zhengzhou Central Hospital at about 8 o'clock, she quickly changed into her white coat, attended the department morning meeting, listened to the handover report, and took on her own patients. In the morning, she handled medication order adjustments and family communications for 7 inpatients.

events.name: During lunch break, looked up rehabilitation medicine literature
events.description: At 12:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to go to the hospital library. In the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine section, she browsed recently published journals, focusing on a review of the impact of early rehabilitation intervention on stroke prognosis. She used her phone to take photos of the titles and DOIs of three key articles, accumulating material for her future career transition.

events.name: Download the book for the group reading and prepare a reading notebook
events.description: Back home in Zhengzhou that evening, she logged into the shared reading plan page and downloaded the e-book versions of The Second Sex and Lean In to her Kindle. Then she found a blank notebook and wrote "Women's Power Reading Notes" on the cover, getting ready for the book club starting on March 4. Because she had woken up early, she felt drowsy and went to bed earlier than usual.

events.name: Called mother to confirm father's condition
events.description: At 8:30 PM, she called her mother and learned that her father had taken his medication on time and was in a stable mood. After telling her to call immediately if anything came up, she felt reassured and prepared to rest.

start_state.mood: Reluctant but determined, filled with strength from a sense of responsibility.

2025-02.daily_overview: On a Tuesday workday, Yu Xiaowen practiced Baduanjin in the early morning and then devoted herself to clinical work. After work, she focused on the first round of revisions to the draft paper, straightening out paragraph logic and adding citations. Because she encountered difficulties in academic expression, the revision took a long time, and she eventually saved it as an intermediate version, planning to do the final revision on the 27th. The paper made solid progress, but it caused her to go to bed late.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin for improved flexibility
events.description: Got up at 7:00 in the morning and practiced Baduanjin for 10 minutes in the living room of the home in Zhengzhou. She felt that the 'two hands climbing the feet to strengthen the kidneys and lower back' movement was easier than last week, and her flexibility had indeed improved.

events.name: Clinical work: admitting new patients.
events.description: In the morning, the department admitted a patient with acute pancreatitis. Under the guidance of Dr. Li Wei, Yu Xiaowen participated in taking the history, physical examination, and writing orders, and recorded key points of the case.

events.name: Preliminary restructuring of the paper and addition of references
events.description: After getting off work at 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen went home, had a simple dinner, and immediately opened her laptop to revise the paper. She carefully compared the introduction and case description sections, found that the transition was not smooth enough, so she rearranged the paragraph order, added a literature citation, and polished the wording sentence by sentence. Midway through, to verify a statistical statement, she spent half an hour searching the literature, which made progress slower than expected. To track changes, she used Word's 'Track Changes' feature. By 11 p.m., she completed the first round of integrated revisions and saved the file as 'Paper_IntroductionCaseDescription_FirstRevision_20250225.docx' as an intermediate version, planning to do the final revision on the 27th.

events.name: Muscle relaxation and cervical spine health exercises
events.description: After long hours of desk work, she had neck and shoulder soreness. She did 5 minutes of cervical 'mi'-character exercises and shoulder circles, plus 8 neck rotations and 10 shoulder shrugs. After easing the discomfort, she washed up and rested.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen started her day with stretching and morning exercise. In the evening, she focused on completing the medical English conversation module, and before bed she made full preparations for the upcoming March morning-exercise habit, keeping her life moving along in an orderly way. The evening hospital English conversation practice gave her a breakthrough in speaking and lifted her mood, so she went to bed early.

events.name: Morning stretching and breathing exercises.
events.description: After getting up at 7:00 a.m., she did 10 minutes of stretching in the living room, paired with deep abdominal breathing, feeling calm in body and mind and setting the tone for the day.

events.name: Study the module on commonly used English conversations in hospitals.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen returned home and opened the Week 3 content of the medical English trial course on her tablet: the module on common hospital conversations. She watched the teaching videos for scenarios such as history taking, ward rounds, and medical orders, practiced repeating each sentence, and wrote down key sentence patterns in her notebook, such as "I'm going to examine your abdomen" and "Please take a deep breath." She repeated the sentences more than 20 times, studied for about 2 hours in total, and mastered all the core dialogues.

events.name: Preparing for the March morning exercise habit.
events.description: After studying, she made detailed preparations for the new month's morning workout plan: she set her phone alarm for 6:30 every day, set out her yoga mat and sneakers in the corner of the bedroom, and created a daily exercise reminder in the reminders app on her phone. She also downloaded a Baduanjin follow-along video to add variety.

events.name: Video call my father to check on his recovery progress
events.description: At 9 p.m. before bed, she had a video call with her father and saw him standing in the living room while holding a fixed handrail; he even showed her his arm-raising movement. Yu Xiaowen praised him repeatedly and encouraged him to keep going. Feeling relaxed, she felt sleepy earlier than usual and followed her body's signals to go to bed early.

2025-02.daily_overview: On her Thursday day off, Yu Xiaowen used the entire day productively: in the morning she studied medical literature reading; in the afternoon she thought about the methodological bottleneck of her paper; in the evening she completed the medical English end-of-course test and renewed her enrollment in the advanced course; at night, based on the structure adjusted on the 25th, she completed language polishing, terminology unification, and data verification for the final draft of the paper, and also did core training and spine relaxation. She balanced academics and health, feeling fulfilled and self-disciplined.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin completed with proficiency
events.description: After getting up at 7:00 a.m., she smoothly completed a full set of Baduanjin exercises in the living room, with fluid movements and a light feeling in her body.

events.name: Study the abstract reading section of medical literature
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yu Xiaowen continued studying the medical literature abstract reading section of the third week of the trial course. She opened the English literature excerpts and lecture slides provided by the course. When encountering complex terms such as 'Randomized controlled trial' and 'cohort study', she used a dictionary app to look up words and took notes. She translated and understood paragraph by paragraph, then tried to orally retell the abstract. It took 2.5 hours in total, and she clearly felt that her academic English comprehension had improved.

events.name: Considered the paper methodology and listed statistical questions
events.description: At 2 p.m., she began thinking about the methodology section of her paper and realized it involved survival analysis (such as Cox regression and Kaplan-Meier curves), while her undergraduate statistics foundation was weak. She listed the questions to be answered in her notebook: 'How to determine whether the Cox proportional hazards assumption is met?' 'How to interpret Kaplan-Meier plots', and planned to ask Teacher Li Wei or a colleague in the statistics office the next day.

events.name: Review the three weeks of medical English and complete the final course quiz.
events.description: At 4 p.m., she systematically went through the notes from the previous three weeks, reviewing everything from basic vocabulary to conversation and literature reading. She then logged into the course platform and completed the end-of-course quiz (15 listening multiple-choice questions, 10 scenario matching questions, and 1 short essay). She submitted it after 60 minutes and received a score of 88. She saved screenshots of the wrong answers for analysis, then logged into the course website to check the advanced course introduction and immediately decided to enroll in the two-month 'Systematic Advanced Medical English Course'.

events.name: Final revision and finalization of the paper draft
events.description: At 7:30 pm, Yu Xiaowen opened the first draft of the paper for a full read-through and revision. Based on the structure revised on the 25th, today she mainly focused on language polishing, terminology unification, and data verification. She corrected grammar and spelling errors sentence by sentence, unified professional terms (e.g., consistently using "acute coronary syndrome" instead of the abbreviation), and checked the time points and data in the case description. At 9:30 pm, she confirmed that the introduction and case description sections had reached pre-submission standard, named the file "Paper_Introduction_CaseDescription_Final_20250227.docx", and backed it up to the cloud.

events.name: Evening core training and spinal relaxation
events.description: After finalizing the draft, Yu Xiaowen rested for a moment, then laid out a yoga mat in the small living room at home and did a 15-minute core workout: 3 sets of planks, 45 seconds each; 3 sets of glute bridges, 15 reps each; and 3 sets of bird dog, 10 reps per side. She sweated slightly and felt her core area activated, which was very helpful for her waist and abdomen after long periods of sitting. After the workout, she did 5 minutes of cat-cow stretches and child's pose to relax her spine.

events.name: Evening organization of desk and task list
events.description: After training, she spent 15 minutes tidying her desk, putting reference books back in place, and listing tomorrow's to-dos on Todoist: ask about statistics questions, search the library for literature, and contact the paper's co-authors.

end_state.location: Apartment bedroom at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

2025-02.daily_overview: On Friday, after completing her consecutive micro-habit with Baduanjin, Yu Xiaowen reflected on habit formation and decided to keep it up long term. During the lunch break she continued reviewing rehabilitation literature. After work, she drove back to Luoyang carrying rehabilitation supplies, reunited with her parents, helped her father exercise in the evening, and before bed took a short walk with her mother around the neighborhood, seamlessly connecting a week of busy travel with family responsibilities.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and micro-habit review
events.description: After getting up at 7:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen did a 10-minute Baduanjin practice in the living room of her home in Zhengzhou. This was the 21st consecutive day she had kept up this morning micro-habit (since February 8). After finishing, she sat on the sofa and looked back on her persistence over this period. She found that her shoulder and neck soreness had significantly eased, and her mental state was better, so she decided to make this micro-habit a long-term lifestyle and keep it no matter how busy she was.

events.name: During lunch break, looked up rehabilitation literature and added supplementary materials
events.description: During the lunch break, she went to the hospital library again, continued browsing the latest issue of the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, took additional photos of 2 articles on the application of mirror therapy and motor imagery in stroke rehabilitation, and then went to the office to create a folder named "Rehabilitation Medicine Transition" in her electronic reference management software.

events.name: Afternoon clinical work and shift handover.
events.description: In the afternoon she handled routine matters in the department, and she made a point of asking Teacher Li Wei about the statistics questions she had summarized the day before. Li Wei recommended a medical statistics textbook written by Teacher Fang and suggested simply using SPSS’s menu operations. Yu Xiaowen noted the key points and planned to explore the software at home over the weekend.

events.name: Drive back to Luoyang and bring rehabilitation supplies
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., she drove from the hospital, with a new set of grip balls and resistance bands bought for her father, as well as some seasonal clothes, in the trunk. On the highway, she listened to pop songs on the radio to relax.

events.name: Arrived in Luoyang to reunite with parents and assist with rehabilitation
events.description: At 7 p.m., she returned to her parents' home on Kaixuan Road in Luoyang. Her mother had already prepared a hot meal, and her father was sitting on the living room sofa watching TV. He smiled when he saw his daughter. After dinner, Yu Xiaowen encouraged her father to do hand-grip exercises with the new grip strength ball, counting and cheering him on as he completed 15 repetitions per set. Then she helped her mother clear the dishes, and the family chatted about the weather in Zhengzhou and the latest happenings at the hospital.

events.name: Evening walk with mother around the neighborhood.
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen suggested going downstairs with her mother for a 20-minute walk in the community. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was somewhat tempted; her father, Yu Jianguo, was silent for a while and then said he needed time to think.

At noon, she cooked his favorite tomato scrambled eggs and steamed fish herself, and after the meal her father had a good appetite.

During breaks in the game, she helped her mother with household chores. While folding clothes, she described to her mother the equipment and facilities of the Zhengzhou rehabilitation department and her own care plan. Li Xiuying finally relented and said, "Let's discuss it with your father again."

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowen laid out a yoga mat in the living room at her parents' home and did 15 minutes of core training, including 3 sets of planks (40 seconds each), 20 glute bridges, and 20 bird-dog repetitions. She felt her core muscles activated and broke into a light sweat. She planned to make this a regular supplementary weekend workout.

Although her parents did not immediately nod in agreement, her father asked for the first time, 'When will we go look at houses?' which made her see a turning point.

events.name: Drove back to Zhengzhou in the early morning.

The roads were clear, and she arrived at the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital around 7:40. After a quick tidy-up and changing into her white coat, she got ready for work. Mozart piano pieces played during the drive to help her concentrate.

After the meeting, she made rounds with her supervising physician Dr. Li Wei, recording each patient's condition changes one by one. For a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction, she suggested adjusting the rehabilitation orders, which Dr. Li Wei approved. In the morning she saw 5 follow-up outpatients and wrote prescriptions and examination orders.

She opened her tablet to show a comparison table she had prepared in advance: a list of rehabilitation centers in Zhengzhou, costs, medical insurance reimbursement rates, and so on, and explained that it would also be convenient if her mother needed rehabilitation treatment in the future. Her father asked for the first time, "When are we going to see the apartment?" while her mother worried that the rent would be too expensive. The call lasted an hour, and her parents agreed to look at apartments first and then decide.

They agreed that the following Saturday (the 22nd), her parents would move in first with some simple luggage, leaving the furniture in the Luoyang old house for now. After the call, Yu Xiaowen wrote a weekend shopping list on paper: non-slip mats, night light, and a bedpan for her father.

She contacted the moving company recommended by her best friend and scheduled the moving of large furniture for next Friday (the 21st) in the afternoon. At the same time, she looked up the address of the community hospital and planned to go the next day to sign a family doctor contract for her father. Before bed, she sent her brother a WeChat message updating him on her progress, and he replied, 'Good work, the handrail I ordered will arrive next week.'

events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen completed 10 minutes of morning stretching and Baduanjin in the living room of her old residence on Jingsan Road. She then discussed the move with her parents, helped carry items, and told them in advance about her morning exercise routine so they could coordinate schedules at the new residence.

events.name: Buying dinner ingredients
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen went to the vegetable market near her home to buy lamb, flour, and vegetables for making stewed noodles, as well as pork tenderloin, sugar, vinegar, and other seasonings for sweet and sour pork tenderloin. She also picked up fresh fruit for making fruit salad, preparing for the family dinner that evening. She ran into her landlady Song Yumei, and Aunt Song, upon learning that she was going to bring her parents to live with her, warmly gave her several homemade steamed buns.

events.name: Saw the competition notice and agreed to form a team
events.description: In the morning, Zhengzhou Central Hospital issued a notice through its internal system for the annual emergency skills competition, asking each department to form teams freely to participate. After the notice was shared in the department's WeChat group, Wang Fang immediately went to Yu Xiaowen excitedly and suggested they form a team. Yu Xiaowen hesitated at first because of her heavy workload, but with Wang Fang's encouragement and the improvement in their relationship, she finally agreed, and they decided to prepare together.

events.name: Parents moved into their new home
events.description: Late in the morning, Yu Xiaowen's parents, Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, arrived in Zhengzhou by car from Luoyang. With Yu Xiaowen's help, they moved into a newly rented three-bedroom apartment in Jinshui District. She had cleaned the apartment in advance and bought daily necessities. Her parents were settled in, her father slowly walking while holding on to the walls to get familiar with the new home, while her mother kept praising the new place for being spacious and bright.

events.name: Formally submit the competition registration.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang filled out the registration form in the department office through the hospital intranet system, officially submitted the competition information, and agreed to strengthen practice during breaks next week.

events.name: Cooked a reunion dinner.
events.description: From afternoon to evening, Yu Xiaowen made her father's favorite braised noodles and her mother's favorite sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin in the kitchen of the new home, and carefully prepared a fruit salad. She cooked carefully following home-style methods, ensuring a hearty and delicious dinner. Her mother tried to help several times but was persuaded not to, saying with a smile that today she would let her daughter show what she could do.

events.name: Family reunion dinner
events.description: In the evening, the family of three sat around the dining table in the new home, eating and chatting. Yu Xiaowen tasted her own cooking. Her parents praised her for being filial, her father said with emotion that his daughter had worked hard, and her mother asked about her life in Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen comforted her parents, telling them to enjoy a peaceful retirement, and the atmosphere was full of warmth.

events.name: Post-meal cleanup.
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to clear the table, wash the dishes and utensils, and wipe down the kitchen stove. Her mother wanted to help, but she persuaded her to rest and completed the after-dinner cleanup on her own, keeping the new home tidy.

start_state.location: Former residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Nervous but excited; today I will welcome my parents as they start a new life.

end_state.location: At home in the newly rented three-bedroom apartment in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Physically tired but emotionally happy; family reunion marks a new starting point.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowen installed and arranged a rehabilitation corner in the living room of the new home, explained its purpose to her father, and accompanied her parents to get familiar with the area around the new home. The pace of life began to adjust.

events.name: Morning stretching and first morning workout at the new home.
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen completed a 10-minute stretching Baduanjin session in the living room of her new home. Her parents watched nearby. She explained her morning exercise habit to them and suggested that her father could try gentle movements in the future.

events.name: Installed and arranged a rehabilitation corner.
events.description: After receiving the non-slip mats and handrails ordered online, Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to set aside an area in the living room, laid the non-slip mats, and installed the handrails, completing the rehabilitation corner. She carefully checked that it was sturdy, explained the purpose and precautions of the rehabilitation corner to her father Yu Jianguo, and encouraged her father to keep training every day. Her father tried standing with support on the spot and expressed satisfaction.

events.name: Walked with parents around the neighborhood and surrounding areas.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her parents on a walk around the residential area, introduced the surrounding environment, helped her mother become familiar with the roads and public facilities, while her father walked slowly with a walker. The family chatted as they walked. Then they went to the supermarket and pharmacy outside the residential area to learn the routes, and her mother noted the locations of the shops they often used.

events.name: Organize items brought from the old residence.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen sorted and put away the remaining personal items moved from the old residence yesterday, placing books, pottery tools, and other things in the corner of the new study. She came across a few Chinese zodiac commemorative coins and had the inspiration to incorporate them into her pottery.

events.name: Dinner and family conversation
events.description: Dinner was simply prepared by mother Li Xiuying. The family chatted about old times in Luoyang and hopes for their new life, and the atmosphere was warm. Father talked about his old friends in Luoyang, and Yu Xiaowen suggested inviting them to Zhengzhou someday.

start_state.mood: A bit unfamiliar with the new life, but full of hope.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday, Yu Xiaowen attended the last session of the series training and completed the comprehensive assessment with good results; during the lunch break, she and Wang Fang practiced two-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the first time, laying the foundation for the competition.

events.name: Morning stretching and commute
events.description: After finishing stretching in the living room of the new home at 6:30 a.m., have a simple breakfast, then drive 10 minutes to the hospital. Remind your mother to be careful of slippery roads before leaving.

events.name: Clinical work and lunch-break practice
events.description: Routine clinical work in the morning. During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang did their first two-person CPR practice in the department's demonstration room. Wang Fang timed and recorded issues such as compression depth and frequency, while Yu Xiaowen operated according to the standard procedure. They alternated roles in practice and discussed and corrected details of coordination and handover.

events.name: Skills training assessment
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen attended the last session of the series of training at the Clinical Skills Training Center, followed by a comprehensive skills operation assessment. She completed four assessments in turn: CPR, defibrillator use, deep venous puncture, and doctor-patient communication scenario simulation. She ultimately passed with a good score, laying a solid foundation for the emergency competition and boosting her clinical confidence.

events.name: Evening family rehabilitation supervision
events.description: After getting home from work, she urged her father to complete his daily training in the rehabilitation corner, observed how he used the handrail and non-slip mat, and recorded the training duration. Today her father could stand with support for 3 minutes, showing obvious progress.

events.name: Exam preparation review
events.description: In the evening, I reviewed the materials for the attending physician exam, focusing on the latest cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidelines covered in today's training. My mother brought me a glass of warm milk, and I felt very touched.

events.name: Organize the outline for transitioning to rehabilitation medicine.

events.description: After the shared reading session ended, Yu Xiaowen contacted financial advisor Wang Mingyuan via WeChat voice message, explaining in detail the financial pressure caused by her parents' move and the doubled rent. Wang Mingyuan suggested lowering the monthly fund investment plan from 3,000 yuan to 2,000 yuan, and putting the reduced 1,000 yuan into a money-market fund as an emergency reserve. She immediately modified it successfully in the China Merchants Bank app.

events.description: To ease difficulty falling asleep caused by work stress, Yu Xiaowen tried bedtime meditation for the first time in her bedroom. She lay in bed, opened the Tide app, chose the 5-minute body scan meditation guide, followed the audio to breathe deeply and relax her body, felt her nerves gradually unwind, and fell asleep more quickly.

events.name: Morning stretching and morning handover
events.description: After stretching at 6:30 in the morning, I went to the hospital for the department morning handover meeting. I am on night duty today, so the daytime is relatively busy.

events.description: After the afternoon departmental routine meeting, Yu Xiaowen proactively went to Director Zhang Lei's office and formally proposed her idea of transitioning from general internal medicine to rehabilitation medicine, briefly outlining the research prospects, her own strengths, and feasibility. Director Zhang listened carefully and expressed understanding, suggesting that she first accumulate clinical experience and strive to publish rehabilitation-related papers, while promising to help connect her with rehabilitation specialists for guidance. The conversation lasted about 20 minutes.

events.name: Record the key points of the interview and the action plan
events.description: After the meeting ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation and immediately recorded the key points of the conversation and Director Zhang's suggestions in her personal work notebook. She sorted out two core recommendations and, based on them, listed a short-term action plan: search core journals and schedule a discussion with her supervising teacher within this week, and complete the initial screening of a paper topic within one month.

events.description: After the night shift, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang focused on practicing tracheal intubation coordination in the department's demonstration room. Yu Xiaowen was responsible for intubation, while Wang Fang assisted in exposing the glottis and passing instruments. They recorded the time taken and common mistakes for each attempt, repeatedly refined their division of labor, and corrected details against the competition scoring criteria.

events.description: Before bed that night, Yu Xiaowen continued with a 5-minute breathing meditation on the Tide app, focusing on abdominal breathing and calming her heart rate, pulling away from the busyness of the day to prepare for sleep.

Wang Fang timed and recorded the handover time, while Yu Xiaowen focused on optimizing pre-intubation preparation and the timing of switching compressions. After the practice, they verbally reviewed and adjusted the plan.

On the way, she received a WeChat message from Su Ya sharing photos of newly fired pottery works from the ceramics class. She replied with a like and agreed to go to the studio together another day. After returning home, she thoroughly cleaned the living room and kitchen of the three-bedroom apartment, set out tableware and seasonings, and prepared for the arrival of her close friend Sun Yue.

Her father voluntarily brought up wanting to do something for his grandparents before Qingming Festival. Yu Xiaowen suggested making small clay lamps to pay tribute from afar.

events.name: Morning stretching and preparation

events.name: Sun Yue's visit and tour of the new home
events.description: At around 10 a.m., Sun Yue drove to Yu Xiaowen's newly rented apartment in Jinshui District, bringing a carefully selected fruit basket and a handwritten card. The two hugged warmly, and Yu Xiaowen showed her around the new home while they caught up. Sun Yue marveled at how warm and cozy the decoration was and was full of praise.

events.name: Cooking lunch together

Around 11:30, the stewed noodles and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin came out of the wok one after another and were placed on the table. Mother occasionally came in to give tips and joked that the two had improved their cooking skills.

Sun Yue shared funny stories from the pediatric ward and her on-call experiences, while Yu Xiaowen confided her recent financial pressure and confusion about career transition. They encouraged each other; Sun Yue guided her with her own experience, and Yu Xiaowen responded with an optimistic attitude, effectively releasing their anxiety. The meal lasted until 2 p.m.

Afterwards, Yu Xiaowen walked Sun Yue to the entrance of the residential community, and the two agreed to meet again next time. Along the way, she also recommended a few affordable breakfast shops. Her mother carefully noted down the key information.

Her father watched from the side, looking nostalgic.

Her parents had the leftover braised noodles from lunch for dinner. Yu Xiaowen poured herself a glass of lemon water and scrolled through medical WeChat official account posts on her phone while eating.

events.name: Body scan relaxation before bed

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Yu Xiaowen was still at home polishing and doing the final review of her paper. At noon she had a video chat with her best friend Zhang Jing about the pressure of exam preparation. In the evening she received a call from Director Zhang Lei asking about progress, and after reporting, she received encouragement. At night she tried following an app to do a set of cervical spine exercises.

events.description: Yu Xiaowen did a final paragraph-by-paragraph read-through of her paper in the study, checked logical coherence, corrected 3 punctuation errors and 1 terminology inconsistency, made sure all figure and table captions were correctly numbered, and proofread the Chinese and English abstracts again. The Word document showed 28 pages in total.

events.name: Video call with best friend Zhang Jing to de-stress
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Yu Xiaowen video-called her best friend Zhang Jing on WeChat while eating tomato and egg noodles. The two chatted from complaining about the hardships of exam preparation to gossip about Wang Fang's wedding planning. Zhang Jing joked, 'In your eyes there's only your thesis; you're almost a bookworm.' The laughter eased Xiaowen's tension from the past few days.

events.name: Received a phone call from Director Zhang Lei.

events.name: Evening cervical spine exercises and massage.

She then massaged her father's calf muscles and reminded him of the key points for tomorrow's rehabilitation training.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yu Xiaowen completed exporting the final draft of her paper at home, submitted it to Henan Medical Research, and wrote a solemn written application letter in the evening to transfer to the rehabilitation department. This was a day full of turning points and symbolic actions, setting the stage for her career change in August. Her mother brought hot milk late at night, and she worked until falling asleep at 23:30.

events.name: Final version confirmation and PDF export of the paper
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen opened the final version of her paper, which had been revised over several days, on the computer in the study at her home in Zhengzhou. She performed a final format check against the submission system requirements. After confirming that the figures and tables were embedded and that the margins and fonts were correct, she exported the Word document to a PDF that met the requirements. The file was named Observation_on_the_Efficacy_of_Early_Rehabilitation_Intervention_after_Stroke_Final_20250805.pdf and saved to the desktop.

events.name: Online submission and email notification
events.description: At 14:00, Yu Xiaowen logged into the online submission system of the journal Henan Medical Research and spent about 40 minutes filling in author information, uploading the PDF and abstract attachment, and uploading scanned copies of the ethics approval statement and conflict of interest statement. After successful submission, she immediately sent the submission receipt and paper abstract to her collaborator Director Zhang Lei via the hospital email, with a note asking him to check and confirm.

events.name: Writing a formal application letter to transfer to the Rehabilitation Department
events.description: At 20:30 in the evening, Yu Xiaowen sat under the desk lamp in her study and, drawing on the family caregiving pressure caused by her father's condition, her interest in rehabilitation medicine, and her career plans, handwrote a three-page written application letter on the hospital's red-letterhead paper. She detailed the reasons for the application, her reflections on the specialty transition, and her vision for carrying out a community rehabilitation project for stroke patients in the rehabilitation department. The letter was sincere.

events.name: My mother brought hot milk to comfort me.
events.description: In the middle of writing, her mother Li Xiuying gently pushed open the study door, handed her a glass of hot milk and two pieces of soda crackers, and said in a low voice, 'Don't stay up too late. Get some rest after you finish writing.' Yu Xiaowen squeezed her mother's hand, feeling both bitter and determined.

events.name: Simple evening stretching
events.description: At 23:00 in the evening, Yu Xiaowen stood up and exercised her shoulders, doing 5 minutes of standing forward bends and side stretches to relieve the stiffness from three hours at the desk, then quickly washed up and got ready for rest.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: After waking up, realized that the submission and the application letter had to be completed today; felt a little heavy-hearted but was clear about the goal

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: The relief and slight nervousness after writing the application letter were intertwined, and she became even more determined about the decision to transfer departments.

state.daily_exercise: Prolonged sitting while writing; only 5 minutes of stretching in the evening

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen completed a series of actions at Zhengzhou Central Hospital: submitting the department transfer application, having an in-depth talk with Director Zhang Lei, informing her supervising teacher Li Wei, and organizing personnel materials. This was a substantive step in her career transition. She wavered between reluctance and anticipation, but gained the support of key people.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin
events.description: At 6:20 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen laid out her yoga mat on the balcony and followed an instructional video to practice the full Baduanjin routine. Her movements were smooth and fluid, helping her concentrate and calm the nerves caused by having to submit the application today.

events.name: Morning meeting and application submission.
events.description: After the morning handover meeting, Yu Xiaowen waited outside the department director's office. After Director Zhang Lei finished handling his affairs, she knocked and entered, handing over a written application letter with both hands. The director was silent for a few seconds, then read it carefully and expressed understanding of her choice and filial devotion. He also advised, 'Clinical competence is the foundation; after transferring to the rehabilitation department, you can explore the intersection of clinical practice and research.' The two talked for twenty minutes about her post-transfer work plan and family situation.

events.name: Inform the supervising attending physician Li Wei
events.description: After coming out of the director's office, Yu Xiaowen proactively found Teacher Li Wei in the doctors' office area, honestly told him that she had submitted the department transfer application, and thanked him for his meticulous guidance over the past three years. Li Wei was a little surprised but quickly acknowledged it, telling her to remain dedicated in her final days in the neurology department and that he would help with the handover.

events.name: Organized personnel file materials
events.description: Near the end of the workday that afternoon, Yu Xiaowen, in the department break room, put the copy of the application letter, the notes from her conversation with Director Zhang Lei, and photocopies of her ID card and physician qualification certificate into a file folder. She marked it 'Yu Xiaowen Transfer Materials' with a marker and asked a colleague to pass it to the personnel department. She also recorded this key career turning point and the follow-up plan in her personal work log.

events.name: A brief word of encouragement with Wang Fang in the hallway
events.description: While organizing materials, colleague Wang Fang passed by the rest area and proactively asked about the situation. After learning about the department transfer, Wang Fang smiled and playfully punched her, saying, "You were finally brave once. Come back and see us often." They agreed to have another meal together before September.

events.name: Returning home to share the decision with her parents
events.description: After work in the evening, Yu Xiaowen told her parents about the progress of the department transfer at the dinner table. Her father, Yu Jianguo, was silent for a while, then said, 'Dad supports you. The rehabilitation department needs a doctor like you more.' Her mother choked up a little but expressed understanding. Yu Xiaowen felt that her family's support gave her strength.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: Woke up a little nervous, but the decision was made.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: Tired after a day of intense communication, but with a secure sense of being surrounded by understanding and support

After work, she went to a nearby supermarket to buy flour and fillings, and in the evening made dumplings with her parents, enjoying warm family time.

events.name: Morning run at Bishagang Park.
events.description: At 5:45 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen arrived at Bishagang Park and jogged 2.5 kilometers along the familiar shaded trail at a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer. Although she had slept only a little over six hours the previous night, she felt invigorated after exercising and did a thorough post-run static stretching routine.

events.name: Daily ward rounds and case organization
events.description: During the morning ward round, Yu Xiaowen assisted the attending physician in performing neurological examinations on 3 newly admitted patients and recorded changes to medical orders. After the round, she began organizing the 28 medical records under her name on the computer, categorizing them as 'ready for handover' and 'needs close attention', and wrote several follow-up suggestions.

events.name: Discussing difficult cases with Dr. Liu Qiang
events.description: In the afternoon, Dr. Liu Qiang came over with a complex headache case pending investigation. Yu Xiaowen went through recent imaging reports and lab results with him and discussed possible differential diagnoses. Liu Qiang appreciated her attention to detail, and the two agreed on an ENT consultation the next day.

events.name: Buy dumpling ingredients at the supermarket.
events.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen drove to the Vanguard supermarket on Jingsan Road and bought pork front leg meat, Chinese cabbage, scallions, and dumpling wrappers. She also grabbed two boxes of yogurt that her mother likes. At the checkout, she remembered that her father needed to control his salt intake, so she specifically switched to low-sodium soy sauce.

events.name: Making dumplings with the whole family and teaching how to roll out wrappers.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen and her mother were busy in the kitchen. Her mother demonstrated the dough-wrapper rolling technique: turning the wrapper with the left hand while pushing the rolling pin with the right. Yu Xiaowen tried a few times and gradually improved. Her father, sitting in a wheelchair, helped wrap the filling. Though his movements were slow, he was beaming. Half an hour later, piping hot dumplings came out of the pot. The family of three sat around and enjoyed them in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: Reading rehabilitation fundamentals before bed
events.description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard and used her Kindle to read the chapter on muscle strength assessment in "Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine" for 30 minutes, highlighting the MMT grading standards with a fluorescent marker to warm up for later systematic study.

Lin Wei joked, "It's been so long since I played that my racket is covered in dust."

She practiced "My Motherland" and "Jasmine Flower" with more than a dozen retired neighbors. During the tea break, she hit it off with an Aunt Wang who had previously worked in a cotton mill, and they agreed to go grocery shopping together in the future. After returning home, her mother was in high spirits and vividly recounted the details of the activity during dinner, and her father smiled frequently.

events.name: Final review for the attending physician examination
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen opened her homemade box of mistake cards in her study and focused on reviewing the stages of Parkinson's disease in neurology and the post-operative procedure for hip replacement in rehabilitation medicine, reciting memory mnemonics to herself. Then, following her checklist, she placed her admission ticket, ID card, black gel pen, 2B pencil, eraser, and an unmarked water bottle into a transparent document pouch, and set her alarm.

events.name: Father's encouragement before the exam
events.description: At 22:00 in the evening, her father Yu Jianguo walked to the study door on crutches and said softly, "Wenwen, don't be nervous tomorrow. After the exam, Dad will make you your favorite braised noodles." Yu Xiaowen's eyes welled up slightly, and she went over to hug her father.

events.name: Fell asleep late due to nervousness
events.description: After lying in bed, Yu Xiaowen kept replaying the knowledge points in her mind and tossed and turned until after midnight before falling into a dazed sleep. During that time, she tried a mindful breathing exercise once to relax, but the effect was limited.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yu Xiaowen spent the whole day at the Zhengzhou No. 1 Middle School test site taking the attending physician qualification exam, completing four subjects. She handled it calmly, especially the neurology and rehabilitation questions, which went smoothly. In the evening, she felt relieved after finishing and went home to share with her parents; the pressure of months of exam preparation was finally released.

events.name: Pre-departure checks and breakfast
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen got up and checked the document folder again, quickly flipping through the key points of the cranial nerve examination in neurology and the summary of rehabilitation medicine assessment scales. Her mother had prepared millet porridge and egg pancakes, but she only ate half a bowl of porridge and half a pancake before driving off, arriving at the Zhengzhou No. 1 Middle School exam center near Jianshe West Road at 7:30.

events.name: Morning exams for the first two subjects.
events.description: From 8:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., Yu Xiaowen took the basic knowledge and relevant professional knowledge exams at the designated examination room. She first answered the familiar rehabilitation medicine questions, then tackled the difficult neurology ones, allocating her time reasonably. She finished filling in the answer sheet 15 minutes early and repeatedly checked her exam number and answers.

events.name: Lunch and a short break
events.description: After the exam ended at noon 12:00, Yu Xiaowen ordered a beef and potato stew set meal at Li Ji Fast Food Restaurant next to the test center. While eating, she browsed a few exam answer discussion posts on her phone but quickly closed them to avoid affecting her mindset. Afterwards, she reclined the seat in her car, closed her eyes and rested for 30 minutes, and listened to a Bach cello piece in G major to regulate her breathing.

events.name: Afternoon exams for the third and fourth subjects
events.description: From 14:00 to 17:30, she took the professional knowledge and professional practice ability exam. The case analysis questions were long; she read each question word by word, listed key points on scratch paper, and then answered. The final question about the three-level rehabilitation plan for stroke left the deepest impression. After finishing it, she felt a strong sense of professional value.

events.name: Sharing with parents after the exam
events.description: At 18:30 in the evening, she returned home in Jinshui District and told her parents in detail about the exam process. Her mother had prepared cold noodles, and her father listened with a smile. She said that no matter the result, she had done her best. The family was happy and harmonious, and Yu Xiaowen finally felt a huge weight lifted off her shoulders.

events.name: Post-exam relaxation: binge-watching shows and going to bed early
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen made an exception and curled up on the sofa to watch an episode of "Hospital Playlist," enjoying a rare moment of relaxation. By 22:00 she had washed up, was lying in bed doing a body scan relaxation, and soon fell asleep.

events.name: Registered for the Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine course during lunch break

events.description: Then she went to the nearby Rehabilitation Home medical equipment store. After comparing three nursing beds, she chose a model with lift adjustment, side rails, and a movable tabletop. After paying, she arranged for the store staff to deliver it that day to the 6th-floor apartment at No. 89 Jingsan Road.

Her mother cooked mung bean soup to beat the heat.
