2025-08.daily_overview: Early Tuesday morning, Yu Xiaowen assembled a rehabilitation nursing bed with her father. After trying it, her father's quality of life obviously improved. In the afternoon, at the hospital, she received official notice from the personnel department: her application for a department transfer was approved, and she was to report to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department on September 1. Her cousin Li Yaqin sent congratulations, and she patiently shared rehabilitation tips. In the evening, she studied a neuro-rehabilitation course, feeling fulfilled and making progress.

events.name: In the morning, assembled the rehabilitation nursing bed
events.description: At 7:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowen and her father unpacked the parts of the care bed that had been delivered the previous day and assembled them one by one according to the instructions. They first fixed the bed frame, installed the lifting motor, and then attached the side rails and the movable tabletop. About an hour later, the assembly was complete. Her father lay down on it and adjusted the lift and backrest angle, exclaiming, “It’s much easier to get up now, and during the day I can also lie back and watch TV.”

events.name: Received the department transfer approval notice from the Personnel Section.
events.description: At 15:00 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen received a call from a staff member of the Human Resources Department in the Neurology Department office and was told that her transfer application had been approved by the vice president in charge, and that she should report to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine at 8:30 a.m. on September 1. She thanked the caller on the spot. After hanging up, her heart beat faster—she felt both excited and reluctant to leave.

events.name: WeChat congratulations and rehabilitation consultation from cousin Li Yaqin
events.description: In the afternoon, cousin Li Yaqin from Hangzhou saw the family group message on WeChat and sent a private message to congratulate Yu Xiaowen. She also mentioned that her husband had lumbar muscle strain from prolonged sitting and asked for rehabilitation exercise methods. Yu Xiaowen replied in detail in the lounge by voice, explaining the key points and precautions for supine hip raises, the little swallow exercise, and other movements, and promised to send her an illustrated guide later.

events.name: In the evening, studied the stroke overview in the neurorehabilitation course
events.description: At 20:00, Yu Xiaowen logged into the MOOC platform in her study and studied the first section of the Neural Rehabilitation module of Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine: Overview of Post-Stroke Rehabilitation. She watched a 40-minute instructional video, drew a diagram of the pathophysiological mechanisms of stroke in her notes, then completed 5 in-class multiple-choice questions with an accuracy of 80%, and took a screenshot of the wrong questions and saved it.

events.name: Report the approval news to Director Zhang Lei
events.description: During a study break, Yu Xiaowen briefly reported the notice from the human resources department to Director Zhang Lei via WeChat. The director replied, 'Good news, prepare well; the rehabilitation department has great potential.' She felt affirmed by her former leader.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: When she woke up, she remembered that the bed needed to be assembled that day and felt focused.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: The sense of reality that the career transition has landed, and the joy of being recognized

state.daily_exercise: Assembling the nursing bed was physically draining; after evening study, do a 5-minute neck and shoulder relaxation.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to sunny, 27°C to 34°C, muggy at noon.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, after finishing her morning jog, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to visit Wang Zhenhua, director of the rehabilitation medicine department, to learn about the department's projects and pick up study materials, making full preparations for registration in September. In the evening, she continued the neurorehabilitation course, studying post-stroke exercise therapy in depth.

events.name: Morning run at Bishagang Park.
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen completed a 2.5 km morning run in Bishagang Park. The temperature was rising but still acceptable. She used the Keep app to record it and added three 30-second acceleration runs, feeling that her cardiorespiratory function had somewhat recovered. After the run, she bought a portion of multi-layer pancake and soy milk and went home.

events.name: Reviewed internal materials in the rehabilitation department.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowen, in the resident physicians' office, downloaded the Rehabilitation Medicine Department introduction, the annual report of the stroke community rehabilitation project, and common rehabilitation assessment procedures through the hospital information system. She spent 20 minutes browsing and marking key points to prepare for the discussion with Director Wang Zhenhua.

events.name: Visited Director Wang Zhenhua of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department.
events.description: At 10:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowen walked to the office of the director of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, knocked on the door, introduced herself to Director Wang Zhenhua, and explained the reason for her visit. Director Wang received her warmly, introduced the department's ongoing 'Community Rehabilitation for Stroke' project, suggested that she familiarize herself with the rehabilitation assessment process before reporting for duty, and handed her a copy of the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual and a project proposal booklet.

events.name: Agreed to attend the departmental professional learning session
events.description: During the conversation, Director Wang Zhenhua mentioned that the department had a professional study session every Wednesday afternoon. Yu Xiaowen proactively asked to attend as soon as Wednesday, September 2. Director Wang immediately agreed and wrote her name on the study schedule, advising her to read relevant literature in advance.

events.name: Collected learning materials and expressed gratitude
events.description: After the conversation, Yu Xiaowen took the thick document folder containing the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual, the Community Stroke Rehabilitation Program Plan, and a compilation of commonly used scales in the rehabilitation department, thanked him with both hands. Director Wang encouraged her: 'It's a good thing that a young doctor has ideas. Welcome aboard.'

events.name: Evening study on rehabilitation of motor dysfunction after stroke
events.description: At 19:30 in the evening, Yu Xiaowen continued her online course in the study, learning rehabilitation treatment for motor dysfunction after stroke. She watched a 50-minute video, took detailed notes on the key points of Bobath technique and Brunnstrom stage training, and marked highlights with colored sticky notes. Then she completed 8 practice questions and repeatedly reviewed the PNF technique difficulties involved in the wrong questions.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: Cautious anticipation of meeting the new leader; the morning run helped adjust my mindset.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: A feeling of reassurance after smooth communication, and a strong aspiration to work in the rehabilitation department

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 2.5 km, and walking back and forth within the hospital.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 28°C to 36°C, with a gentle breeze by Ruyi Lake in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, because of the heat and an evening blind date arrangement, Yu Xiaowen paused her morning run and switched to indoor Baduanjin. In the morning she scheduled her annual physical exam at the hospital. In the afternoon she continued studying rehabilitation courses, but her mother called and insisted she go on the blind date. That evening she reluctantly went, only to have a dull dinner. Afterward, she reflected by the lake and wrote in her diary, making clear her relationship boundaries.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin instead of morning running
events.description: At 6:20 a.m., considering the high daytime temperatures and the energy that the evening blind date might take, Yu Xiaowen decided to reschedule her morning run. She completed a full set of Baduanjin and 10 minutes of stretching on the balcony, feeling her body gently awakened.

events.name: Online booking for annual physical examination
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowen selected a physical examination package through the Zhengzhou Central Hospital WeChat official account and booked a comprehensive physical examination for the morning of August 16 (Saturday). She specifically added anteroposterior and lateral DR radiographs of the cervical spine and confirmed the fasting requirement and the 8:00-10:00 time slot.

events.name: Afternoon study of speech and swallowing disorder rehabilitation
events.description: From 14:00 to 16:00 in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen used the computer in the teaching room in her office to continue the MOOC course on rehabilitation of post-stroke aphasia and dysarthria, as well as swallowing function training methods. She simulated swallowing movements and drew a flow diagram of the Kubota water swallowing test in her notebook.

events.name: Mother called to persuade me to go on a blind date
events.description: At 16:30 in the afternoon, her mother Li Xiuying called and said in a dejected tone that her father's illness had kept the family under long-term strain, and urged her to meet a state-owned enterprise engineer introduced by a relative, saying it would be like making a new friend. Yu Xiaowen detected her mother's anxiety and reluctantly agreed to the meeting to appease her, arranging to meet at 19:00 in the evening at the Dennis Lakeview Restaurant in Zhengdong New District.

events.name: Dress up and go to the appointment.
events.description: After getting home from work, Yu Xiaowen took a shower, changed into her newly bought misty-blue floral dress, put on light makeup, wore the pearl earrings her mother had given her, and encouraged herself in the mirror. Her father, not knowing why, even praised, 'My daughter looks really beautiful today.'

events.name: Blind date at Dennis Lakeview Restaurant
events.description: At 7 p.m., guided by the waiter, Yu Xiaowen met her blind date—a 29-year-old engineer at a state-owned enterprise, wearing glasses and speaking reservedly. They ordered set meals, and the conversation revolved around superficial topics like their respective company structures and commute times, failing to go deeper. Yu Xiaowen was polite but uninterested, and the other person seemed to sense it. After the meal, they split the bill, and he bid her a gentlemanly farewell.

events.name: Strolling by Ruyi Lake and reflecting
events.description: After the blind date ended, Yu Xiaowen walked alone along the Ruyi Lake boardwalk for two laps. The neon lights reflected on the lake, but she felt somewhat empty inside. She realized more clearly that what she needed was not matching conditions, but spiritual resonance and mutual growth.

events.name: Ranted to the bestie group on WeChat.
events.description: After sitting down on a lakeside bench, Yu Xiaowen sent 'Mission accomplished' in her WeChat best-friends group 'Childhood Friends Trio' and described the process. Wang Lina replied instantly, 'Like completing a KPI, right? If you don't want to go in the future, just say so. Don't force yourself.' Zhang Jing then sent a string of comforting emojis and suggested, 'Next time we'll help you pick.'

events.name: Write in a diary to clarify emotional needs
events.description: When she got home at 10:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen wrote in her diary: I don't want to settle. Companionship can't be just a pile of conditions. At the same time, she understood her mother's concern and decided to communicate her inner thoughts more openly with her mother in the future.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: Woke up feeling a little resistant to today's blind date arrangement, but her attention was mainly on work and study.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: After the blind date, complex emotions settled into clarity: a clearer sense of self, with slight tiredness.

state.daily_exercise: Morning Baduanjin exercises and a 1-hour walk around Ruyi Lake

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with light rain, 24°C–28°C, with a noticeable chill

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday, Yu Xiaowen encountered light rain and a temperature drop and worked in the department as usual. During her lunch break, she inquired about insurance for her father but was rejected. After accepting this rationally, she systematically adjusted the family financial plan in the evening, raising the priority of the medical reserve fund to the highest level. She then continued tackling the spinal cord injury rehabilitation course, honing her resilience under pressure.

events.name: Routine case discussion and clinical observation
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen attended the department morning meeting and reported on the conditions of two newly admitted patients with cerebral infarction. After the meeting, she followed teacher Li Wei in the outpatient clinic, learned about the medication adjustment plan for a patient with Parkinson's disease, and helped record the UPDRS scale scores.

events.name: Contact insurance consultant Wang Jie to inquire about taking out insurance.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen called insurance advisor Wang Jie over the phone and explained in detail her father Yu Jianguo's age, history of cerebral infarction, and current rehabilitation condition, hoping to purchase hospitalization medical insurance for him. After understanding the situation, Wang Jie apologized and explained that the cerebral infarction history was a major pre-existing condition that could not pass the health disclosure, and suggested considering other options. Yu Xiaowen expressed understanding, thanked him, and hung up.

events.name: Accepted the insurance company's rejection and expressed gratitude
events.description: After the call ended, she sat in the lounge in silence for a moment and accepted the reality. She realized the limitations of commercial insurance and decided to use her own savings to cope with the risk. Then she sent Wang Jie a WeChat message to thank him again for his frank explanation.

events.name: Evening financial plan adjustment and bookkeeping
events.description: At 20:00 in the evening, Yu Xiaowen returned to her rented apartment, took out her account book and mobile banking app, and increased the monthly "parents' medical reserve fund" from the originally planned 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan, marking it as the first-priority expense with a red marker. In her diary, she wrote that only by passing the attending physician exam and changing departments to increase income could she truly withstand risks. At the same time, she reallocated her monthly budget: 5,000 yuan for rent, 2,500 yuan for the reserve fund, 2,000 yuan for living expenses, 500 yuan for emergencies, and the rest for financial management.

events.name: Study the spinal cord injury rehabilitation module
events.description: After the financial planning, Yu Xiaowen opened the MOOC course to study spinal cord injury rehabilitation. She watched videos on ASIA grading and neurological level determination, read the textbook section on pressure ulcer prevention, and completed 10 practice questions. The score of 70 made her somewhat frustrated, so she spent 20 minutes rereading the difficult parts of sensory level assessment and marked several concepts she did not understand to ask a rehabilitation physician.

events.name: Telephone communication with brother Yu Xiaofeng
events.description: At 22:00, her brother Yu Xiaofeng called from Shenzhen. Yu Xiaowen told him about the failed insurance application and the progress of her department transfer. Her brother said he understood and promised to keep transferring the 5,000 yuan monthly rehabilitation fee. He also advised his sister, "Focus your energy on advancing your main career; we siblings will shoulder family matters together." This warmed Yu Xiaowen's heart.

events.name: Before-bed cervical spine exercises and meditation.
events.description: After a day of prolonged sitting and studying, Yu Xiaowen did the Keep cervical spine exercises again before going to bed, and meditated for 10 minutes to adjust her state for the next day's physical examination.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
start_state.mood: The early morning after the rain was cool; she felt fairly energetic upon waking, with today's insurance consultation on her mind.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District.
end_state.mood: The brief disappointment after the insurance rejection was softened by a clear financial plan and support from her siblings, eventually turning into a sense of reassurance.

state.daily_exercise: Did 5 minutes of neck exercises during work breaks, 10 minutes of yoga stretching in the evening, and 15 minutes of cervical spine exercises before bed.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the compensatory rest day, after completing Baduanjin in the early morning, she accompanied her father on a rehabilitation walk. In the morning she finished her annual physical examination and then devoted herself to studying rehabilitation courses; in the afternoon she had a breakthrough at the pottery studio and successfully threw several pieces; in the evening she made a ceramic plaque for a close friend and enjoyed the joy of creation.

events.name: Morning stretching and Baduanjin
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, she did 10 minutes of stretching and Baduanjin on the apartment balcony in Jinshui District, following an instructional video with smooth movements to wake up her body.

events.name: Weekend family rehabilitation walk.
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, she supported her father for a slow 30-minute walk on a gentle slope in Bishagang Park, incorporating turning and obstacle-crossing exercises, while paying attention to heat prevention and hydration.

events.name: Annual comprehensive physical examination.
events.description: In the morning, I went to the Health Examination Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital for the annual comprehensive physical examination. After arranging a compensatory day off, I felt at ease. I completed blood routine, biochemistry, electrocardiogram, abdominal ultrasound, and other items in turn. The whole process took about 1.5 hours. After getting breakfast, I learned that the results would be issued on the afternoon of August 18.

events.name: Learning rehabilitation treatment techniques for spinal cord injury
events.description: After the physical examination, she returned home in Jinshui District and deeply studied rehabilitation treatment techniques for spinal cord injury in the study, covering physical therapy (muscle strength training, respiratory training, bladder and bowel management), occupational therapy (activities of daily living training, use of assistive devices), and psychosocial rehabilitation. She watched two instructional videos of about 30 minutes each, read the wheelchair selection and mobility training content in the courseware, and simulated developing a rehabilitation plan for a patient with a complete T10 injury, writing down key points.

events.name: Breakthrough in pottery wheel throwing.
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio. After two failed attempts at throwing, she played Bach's Unaccompanied Cello Suites on her phone on the third try, and amid the serene melody she successfully threw six pieces — two bowls, two cups, and two plates — and applied a warm, glossy glaze. Pottery teacher Zheng Guodong praised her, saying, 'Music and clay have fused in your hands; your technique is steady.' Xiaowen was delighted by her breakthrough.

events.name: Making a ceramic plaque as a gift
events.description: In the evening, using leftover material from that day's creations, she carefully shaped and carved a small clay plaque with the characters Siyu, as a gift for her high school friend Chen Siyu. She fired it herself in the studio's electric kiln, handwrote a card reading For Our Luoyang Memory, and after finishing, wrapped it up, ready to send it the next day.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Before bedtime, she did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation guided by the Tide app to relax her body and mind.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home in Jinshui District
start_state.mood: Calm and relaxed

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Jinshui District
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and happy

state.daily_exercise: Morning Baduanjin for 10 minutes, home rehabilitation walk for 30 minutes

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, after finishing a morning run and a family walk, I stayed home to rest and wait for the physical exam results; in the morning, I held a small pottery viewing session and shared the joy of creating with good friends; in the afternoon, I mailed gifts; in the evening, I continued studying the rehabilitation course. The pace of life was relaxed yet fulfilling.

events.name: Morning run (Bishagang Park)
events.description: Got up at 6:00 in the morning, went to the greenway of Bishagang Park for a 2.5-kilometer jog, at a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer, with full stretching before the run, recorded with the Keep app, mindful breathing to regulate rhythm, and felt breathing smoothly.

events.name: Weekend family rehabilitation walk.
events.description: After the morning run, returned home. At 7:00, helped Father walk slowly on the gentle slope of Bishagang Park for 30 minutes. With the aid of a cane, Father could barely complete the whole route, and his mental state improved.

events.name: Resting at home and monitoring physical exam results
events.description: In the morning, she relaxed and rested at home, checked the hospital official account reminders on her phone, waited for the next day's physical examination report to be issued, and tidied up the house.

events.name: Small pottery appreciation session
events.description: At 10:00 a.m., she held a small demonstration session at the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio, inviting her friends Su Ya (classmate from the pottery class), Zhang Jing (best friend), and Sun Yue (college classmate and colleague) to visit. She introduced the process of the previous day's creative breakthrough, displayed her new works, and demonstrated wheel-throwing techniques on site. Her friends were full of praise. They drank tea and exchanged thoughts on pottery and life in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere that lasted about two hours.

events.name: Send the pottery plaque gift
events.description: After the observation session, she sent the fired "Siyu" clay plaque along with a handwritten card from the studio via SF Express to Chen Siyu at Luoyang Experimental High School, and told her via WeChat to watch for the delivery, expressing her appreciation for their shared memories of Luoyang.

events.name: Neurological rehabilitation case study.
events.description: In the evening, I studied case analysis for the neurorehabilitation module in the study, opened the three comprehensive cases provided by the course (stroke hemiplegia with speech disorder, spinal cord injury paraplegia, and sequelae of traumatic brain injury), and analyzed them step by step according to rehabilitation assessment, goal setting, treatment planning, and prognosis evaluation. I first wrote the analysis in a notebook, then compared it with the explanation video, and summarized the shortcomings. It took about 1.5 hours.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Before going to bed, did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation to help consolidate the day's learning and calm her mood.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and expectant

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Jinshui District
end_state.mood: Satisfied and pleased

2025-08.daily_overview: On a workday, after doing Baduanjin in the early morning, she checked her physical examination report and learned that her cervical spine curvature had straightened, so she began doing neck exercises. After work, she reluctantly attended the speech club her colleague had invited her to and unexpectedly received affirmation. Late at night, she finished the rehabilitation course test, spending the day on professional duties and personal challenges.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin
events.description: At 6:45 in the morning, she did 10 minutes of stretching and Baduanjin on the balcony, following a video. Her movements were smooth, and she maintained the habit as the new week began.

events.name: Set the alarm for the next day and confirm the bank card deduction
events.description: In the afternoon, she checked her electronic physical examination report via the WeChat official account of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. All indicators were normal, but it noted mild straightening of the cervical physiological curvature. She carefully read the attached suggestions and decided to do cervical spine exercises every day as instructed.

events.name: Performed cervical spine health exercises for the first time.
events.description: In the evening, following the physical examination recommendations and standard movements found online, she performed the full set of cervical spine exercises for the first time in the living room at home, including neck flexion and extension, left and right rotation, and shoulder shrugs to relax. It took about 10 minutes, and she decided to make it a fixed evening habit.

events.name: Attended the Toastmasters speech club's regular meeting at invitation
events.description: During the workday, colleague Liu Qiang invited her in person to attend that evening's Toastmasters speech club regular meeting. Xiaowen hesitated out of reluctance to refuse but agreed. After work, she went home to change, then walked to the community activity center near Jianshe West Road in Zhongyuan District. At the meeting, she was called on at the last minute to give a one-minute impromptu speech, sharing her insights from seeing patients on the theme of a doctor's daily work. Though nervous, she spoke fluently and received warm applause. After it ended, she had a brief exchange with Liu Qiang, then walked home alone. Although she decided not to attend again, she gained more recognition of her expressive ability. After returning home, she recorded the experience, washed up, and rested.

events.name: Neurological Rehabilitation Module Summary and Test
events.description: After work, she reviewed the entire neural rehabilitation module in her study, quickly went over six days of notes and incorrect questions, organized a mind map, then took an online unit test (30 multiple-choice questions + 2 short-answer questions, 60 minutes), scoring 86. She noted weak areas (such as details of bowel management) and planned to strengthen them later.

events.name: Doctors' Day cake preparation (background event)
events.description: In the afternoon, department director Zhang Lei asked head nurse Wu Min to order a batch of small cakes for Doctors' Day, with special instructions to label one of them with the word “Guardian” for the next morning's meeting. Wu Min contacted the cake shop, completed the order, and brought the cakes back to store in the department refrigerator.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home in Jinshui District
start_state.mood: Slightly nervous (at work)

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Jinshui District
end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of Baduanjin in the morning, about 40 minutes walking to and from the speaking club, and 10 minutes of cervical spine exercises in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Doctors' Day, she was greatly encouraged by the department director's specially made 'Guardian' cake at the morning meeting. Apart from her normal work, she shared the joy with colleagues and passed on the emotion to her family. In the evening, she kept up Baduanjin, studied exercise therapy, and completed neck health exercises, ending the day with warmth and determination.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, she did 10 minutes of stretching and Baduanjin on the balcony, welcoming the holiday with a calm mind.

events.name: Doctors' Day morning meeting and cake distribution
events.description: At 7:50 in the morning, she attended the department morning meeting on time. Director Zhang Lei first handled the daily handover and ward round arrangements, then announced a special segment for Doctors' Day. At 8:10, the director extended greetings to all doctors and thanked them for their hard work. Head Nurse Wu Min helped distribute the custom small cakes. The cake Xiaowen got had the words Guardian on it. She was deeply moved, thinking of her professional mission, her father's teachings, and the upcoming rehabilitation department rotation; her eyes were slightly moist but her heart was resolute.

events.name: Share and celebrate with colleagues.
events.description: After the morning meeting, she shared cake with her good friends Wang Fang and Liu Qiang in a corner of the meeting room and took photos. Xiaowen took a close-up of the 'Guardian'; Wang Fang praised it as exquisite, and Xiaowen said she would send it to her parents.

events.name: Share holiday feelings with family
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., sent photos of the cake and thoughts from the morning meeting via WeChat to father Yu Jianguo, mother Li Xiuying, and cousin Li Yaqin, writing, "Received the director's 'guardian' cake, feeling very warm, will continue to work hard." Father replied with encouragement, mother sent a voice message expressing relief, and cousin gave a like and congratulations.

events.name: Study the exercise therapy module.
events.description: After work, she went home and studied the joint range-of-motion training section of the exercise therapy module in the study. She watched instructional videos to understand the assessment methods and passive/active training techniques, and recorded key points. Then she studied the basics of muscle strength training, mastered the grading standards and resistance training principles, and completed about 3.5 class hours of study and organized her notes.

events.name: Neck care exercises (morning and evening)
events.description: Persist with cervical spine exercises once each morning and evening; with proper form, the neck and shoulders feel flexible, without any discomfort.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation before bed and fell asleep with gratitude.

2025-08.daily_overview: A day of intense emotional swings: She worked normally in the morning. In the afternoon, at the department, she learned that her best friend Zhang Jing’s wedding clashed with Wang Fang’s, and she became anxious. She left work early, returned to her parents’ home, and prepared a warm dinner. The family reunion brought a long-missed sense of peace, but late at night she was troubled again by financial pressure and worries about being a bridesmaid.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and cervical spine exercises.
events.description: At 6:50 in the morning, did Baduanjin and stretching on the balcony. Because she had a heavy heart, her movements were a bit hasty, but she persisted to the end; afterwards, she did neck health exercises.

events.name: Learned that Zhang Jing's wedding date coincides with Wang Fang's.
events.description: While working in the department in the afternoon, she received a wedding invitation message from Zhang Jing and was surprised to find that the wedding was scheduled for October 2, exactly the same day as Wang Fang's wedding. She was shocked and anxious, facing a dilemma.

events.name: Left work early and returned to her parents’ home
events.description: Feeling upset, I asked the department for permission to leave work early and drove to my parents' three-bedroom home near Huayuan Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. The drive took about 20 minutes, and I arrived in the evening, wanting to be with my family to ease my anxiety.

events.name: Buy ingredients to prepare dinner
events.description: After arriving at my parents' home, I braved the light rain and went to the nearby market to buy the sea bass my father likes, and the seasonal vegetables and seasonings my mother likes, to prepare dinner.

events.name: Cooking personally and having family dinner.
events.description: In her parents' kitchen, she prepared steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cooked rice, and made cold dishes such as cucumber salad, cooking entirely on her own. At dinner, she sat with her parents and enjoyed the home-style food. Her father talked about teaching stories from his youth, and her mother shared anecdotes from the community choir. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. It was the first relaxed, happy meal the family had shared since her father's illness, and Xiaowen felt a long-lost sense of family peace. After dinner, she cleaned up the dishes and chatted with her parents until 9:30 before returning to her room.

events.name: Calculating bridesmaid expenses and inner conflict
events.description: That night, in her room at her parents' home, she took out her phone calculator to figure out that the bridesmaid dress and cash gift for Wang Fang's wedding would cost at least 1,000 yuan. After checking her bank savings balance and finding it tight, she immediately felt anxious and guilty. Pacing back and forth, she decided to stop hiding it and began drafting wording in advance to honestly tell Wang Fang about her financial difficulties and schedule conflicts, thought of remedial plans, and recorded the key points in her phone memo.

events.name: Return to her own apartment and prepare for bed.
events.description: At 22:30, said goodbye to my parents and drove from their home on Huayuan Road back to my apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District. I arrived home at 23:10, quickly washed up, then completed the neck exercises and 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, and fell asleep at 23:30.

Sun Yue demonstrated the rules, Su Ya played light music and led the elderly in finger exercises, and Xiaowen helped the elderly complete jigsaw puzzles and card matching. The atmosphere was lively. Afterwards, she individually guided a retired teacher who had hemiplegia from a cerebral infarction to shape clay with her healthy hand. Su Ya encouraged her from the side and helped adjust, and they successfully created a small flower vase, making the elderly resident laugh with joy. At 4:30 p.m., the activity ended. The elderly resident held Xiaowen's hand and said, "Come again next month." The three took a group photo with the elderly and confirmed the service time for next month.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day of the May Day holiday, Xiaowen drove early to the rehabilitation hospital to reunite with her parents and was pleasantly surprised to find that her brother Yu Xiaofeng had also rushed back from Shenzhen. The four of them shared home-style dishes cooked by her mother in the hospital garden. Her father's concern made her feel both warm and sad. After returning home in the evening, she and her brother settled on holiday outing plans. The long-missed family warmth eased the recent caregiving pressure.

events.name: Drive to the hospital to reunite with family
events.description: On the morning of Labor Day, Yu Xiaowen drove from her home on Jingsan Road in Jinshui District to Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital, where her father was staying. On the way, she bought a basket of seasonal fresh fruit at a fruit shop. After arriving at the inpatient department, she was pleasantly surprised to see her older brother Yu Xiaofeng, who had just arrived by high-speed rail from Shenzhen. Her mother Li Xiuying was organizing the meal boxes she had brought from their home on Huayuan Road. After the family of four exchanged a few words in the ward, they pushed the wheelchair and accompanied her father for a walk in the hospital garden.

events.name: Garden family gathering and father's reminders
events.description: The spring sun was gentle, and roses were in full bloom in the garden. Yu Xiaowen and her brother settled their father on a bench, and their mother opened the insulated container she had brought from home on Huayuan Road, taking out homemade sweet and sour pork, fruit salad, and stewed noodles. The family sat together; Father was in good spirits, listening while eating as the siblings talked about work. After the meal, Father held Xiaowen's hand and softly told her: "Don't be too tired; you need to take care of yourself too." Her brother also reassured her that taking turns to care for their parents was no problem. Xiaowen's eyes felt slightly hot, but her burden was a little lighter.

events.name: Pack up, return home, and plan the holiday
events.description: After the small gathering, Xiaowen cleaned up the dishes with her brother, safely escorted her father back to the ward, and reminded her mother to rest. Then she drove back alone to her home in Jinshui District, feeling relaxed on the way. Once home, she discussed with her brother via WeChat taking their father on a short trip to the Yellow River Scenic Area during the holiday, and made an initial plan for the trip.

events.name: Evening tidying up and meditative relaxation.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yu Xiaowen did some simple stretching at home and practiced 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation to relieve the tension that had built up over the past few days. Then she wrote out tomorrow's to-do list and went to sleep.

events.name: Room tidying and breakfast
events.description: At nine in the morning, Yu Xiaowen got up, tidied the apartment, put accumulated laundry into the washing machine, and made a simple yogurt fruit salad from leftover ingredients in the fridge for breakfast, enjoying a rare lazy moment.

events.name: Literature review and note excerpts.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Xiaowen opened her laptop and logged into the hospital library's remote access system. She systematically searched for the latest intervention research on the sequelae stage of cerebral infarction complicated by depression, highlighted high-evidence-level literature on psychological intervention and exercise therapy, and used OneNote to excerpt available clinical pathways and scales, preparing for next week's departmental case discussion.

events.name: Remote chat with her best friend
events.description: At six in the evening, Zhang Jing called to chat. The two talked about everything from what they had for lunch to Wang Lina's funny blind date stories in Shenzhen. Xiaowen complained about the exhaustion of working two consecutive shifts, while Zhang Jing shared adorable homework from her students. The relaxed chat lasted nearly an hour.

events.name: Evening reading and music
events.description: After dinner, Xiaowen pulled from the bookshelf the copy of Better she was halfway through and read forty pages to the melody of Dvořák's From the New World, casually marking a few passages related to her current work until her eyelids gradually grew heavy.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Relaxed but with a faint undercurrent of anxiety about unfinished work

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and calm, and the literature preparation gave me confidence

2025-05.daily_overview: Her brother kept his promise, and the whole family went for a short trip to the Yellow River Scenic Area. With support, her father managed to walk slowly along the trail for nearly 100 meters, which greatly boosted everyone's confidence. Xiaowen took precious videos. In the evening, the family enjoyed authentic Henan cuisine at a farmhouse restaurant, laughing and chatting, recapturing the long-missed feeling of a family outing.

events.name: Family short trip to the Yellow River Scenic Area
events.description: At nine in the morning, Yu Xiaowen and her brother drove the family car, taking their mother and father (the wheelchair placed in the trunk) to the Yellow River Scenic Area in the northern outskirts of Zhengzhou. After arriving, her brother was in charge of pushing the wheelchair, while Xiaowen helped their mother walk slowly along the riverbank. On a flat section of the path, their father volunteered to try walking. The siblings supported him on both sides, and he actually walked steadily about ninety meters, even stopping to gaze at the Yellow River with a relaxed expression. Xiaowen recorded the whole time with her phone, and her mother kept cheering him on.

events.name: Farmhouse lunch and casual chat
events.description: At noon, the family had lunch at a farmhouse restaurant near the scenic area, ordering home-style dishes such as Yellow River carp, braised noodles, and Mulan stir-fried free-range eggs. During the meal, her father’s appetite was better, her brother shared amusing stories from a Shenzhen tech company, and her mother kept saying that once Dad got better, they should all go to the parks in Zhengzhou together. The atmosphere was relaxed.

events.name: Return trip rest and video organization
events.description: At 3 p.m., considering that her father needed an afternoon nap, the whole family drove back. After taking her parents back to the rehabilitation hospital ward, Xiaowen and her brother edited the video recorded in the morning into a one-and-a-half-minute short film in the ward, shared it to the family WeChat group, and each kept a copy.

events.name: Evening discussion of study materials and exam preparation plan
events.description: After returning to the apartment, Yu Xiaowen took out the previously purchased syllabus for the attending physician exam from her desk, roughly planned the review topics for May and June against the calendar, and used labels to mark weak points, warming up for the official exam preparation starting next week.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Excited and expectant, but slightly nervous because her father was taking on the challenge of walking today.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Relieved and content; my father's progress is a morale booster for the whole family

2025-05.daily_overview: The last day of the holiday was mainly spent resting at home. In the morning, Xiaowen curled up on the sofa reading; in the afternoon she began washing winter clothes to prepare for the seasonal change around the Start of Summer. In the evening, a sudden shower arrived, and after hurriedly bringing in the clothes, she cooked a bowl of hot noodle soup. Later she video-called her mother and learned that her brother had changed his ticket to an evening high-speed rail return to Shenzhen. Though she felt a little reluctant, it gave her even more motivation to work hard.

events.name: Morning reading and reflection
events.description: After waking up naturally at 9 a.m., Xiaowen didn't rush to get out of bed. Leaning against the headboard, she used her Kindle to read a few chapters of 'The Second Sex,' a recommended title from the recently added 'Women's Power Reading List,' and casually underlined several passages about self-realization, gaining a brief mental escape.

events.name: Initial sorting of clothes for the season change
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., she began the seasonal storage before Start of Summer: she put the winter heavy sweaters and down jackets into vacuum compression bags in batches, took the summer quilt and a few lightweight dresses out of the top cabinet, touched them up with a garment steamer, and hung them in the regular wardrobe. During this, she realized she had bought very few new clothes in the past two years, and laughed, sighing, 'I really am a frugal resident doctor.'

events.name: Afternoon showers and time at home.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, a sudden rain shower began outside the window. Xiaowen hurriedly took in the sheets drying on the balcony. As the rain grew louder, she simply turned off the air conditioner, opened the window to let the smell of damp earth into the room, brewed a cup of jasmine tea, sat at her desk to organize her handwritten notes from recent work, and copied the easily forgotten key points of the doctor's orders into a new notebook.

events.name: Cooked noodles and had a phone call with Mom
events.description: At dinner time, Xiaowen made herself a bowl of hot soup noodles with tomatoes, eggs, and dried noodles from the fridge. Halfway through, her mother video-called. They chatted for half an hour. Her mother said her brother had changed his high-speed rail ticket to the 7 p.m. train back to Shenzhen, and reminded Xiaowen not to forget her umbrella when going to work the next day. After hanging up, Xiaowen quietly set an alarm for 6:50 the next morning.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Lazily relaxing and enjoying being alone.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Calm, with slight nervousness about returning to work tomorrow, but prepared for the new week.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the day of Start of Summer, Xiaowen and her mother worked together to do a deep seasonal switch-over of the whole house, putting away heavy winter items and cleaning the air conditioner filters to welcome the coming summer heat. In the afternoon, her mother returned to the hospital to accompany the patient, while she drove alone to the bookstore city to buy an SPSS case tutorial, stocking up ammunition for the research practice to be resumed tomorrow. In the evening, when video-chatting with her best friend Wang Lina, she was reminded not to work too hard, and her heart relaxed a little.

events.name: Start of Summer seasonal storage
events.description: At nine in the morning, her mother Li Xiuying came over from the hospital to help. The two first vacuum-packed the down comforter and thick mattress pad from the bedroom and stuffed them into storage boxes under the bed, then took out two summer quilts and a rattan mat and spread them out. Yu Xiaowen was in charge of cleaning the air conditioner filter, while her mother wiped the fan blades with a cloth. As they worked together, her mother muttered that it was time to plant loofah seedlings in the courtyard of the old house in Luoyang.

events.name: Washing and drying
events.description: At 10:30, Xiaowen put the removed curtains and winter bedspreads into the washing machine, and also hand-washed several wool sweaters. Taking advantage of the clearing weather, she hung the washed clothes on the north-facing balcony. In the sunlight, the faint fragrance of laundry detergent filled the small room.

events.name: Afternoon book shopping
events.description: At 2 p.m., her mother returned to the hospital to accompany her father during his afternoon nap, so Xiaowen drove alone to the Xinhua Bookstore Book Center in Zhongyuan District, where she picked out a copy of Medical Statistics and SPSS Practical Tutorial and the accompanying case CD, planning to use them with the database exercises starting tomorrow. She also stopped by the café downstairs and bought an iced latte.

events.name: Video call with Wang Lina
events.description: At eight in the evening, Wang Lina, far away in Shenzhen, sent a video call invitation. After answering, Xiaowen leaned back on the sofa and talked with her old friend. Lina keenly noticed the tiredness in her eyes and said bluntly, "Have you been pushing yourself too hard lately again?" She also shared an embarrassing story about recently learning to swim, which made Xiaowen laugh and relaxed her tense nerves considerably. After hanging up, she decided to go play badminton tomorrow evening to let off some steam.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: I have enough energy, and I'm determined to get the housework done during the break.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: The comfort of a clean environment, and the relief that came from an old friend's encouragement.

state.daily_exercise: About 1.5 hours of housework

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day back at work, while on duty, she received the medical English training notice and decisively signed up. In the evening, at the Women's Power Book Club, she shared her insights on pottery, and unexpectedly found resonance with Zhao Min from the same group, and they added each other as friends. A busy but efficient Tuesday, opening a new dimension of learning.

events.name: Morning handover and management of key patients
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Xiaowen arrived at the department on time and received the handover from the night-shift doctor, focusing on the overnight conditions of two agitated patients after cerebral infarction. She then followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds, where she was responsible for recording new medical orders and adjusted the antihypertensive dose for one patient.

events.name: Sign up for systematic medical English training.
events.description: While resting at noon in the doctors' on-call room, a notification popped up in the department's internal system: registration for the systematic Medical English training program co-organized by the hospital and a university (lasting 6 months, with online classes on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, at 128 yuan per month) starts today. After Xiaowen carefully read the syllabus, she immediately clicked the link, filled in her personal information, chose the class at 8:30 p.m. on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paid the first month's fee online, and officially became a student.

events.name: Join an online discussion of the women’s empowerment book list
events.description: At eight in the evening, Xiaowen logged into Tencent Meeting on time to participate in the group reading discussion for the “Women’s Power Book List.” This week’s selection focused on women and creativity. She connected it to the sense of relaxation she feels when shaping clay, and shared: “Handcrafting lets me briefly step away from clinical precision. I suggest everyone cultivate a ‘useless’ hobby.” Her remarks earned likes from several group members, and Zhao Min, a newly joined member (who later turned out to be a book editor), proactively added her on WeChat, complimenting her pleasant voice and down-to-earth views.

events.name: English preview before bed
events.description: After the book club ended, Xiaowen logged into the medical English course app and downloaded in advance the preview materials for tomorrow evening's first class—a set of vocabulary terms related to the circulatory system. She repeated them aloud twice and highlighted unfamiliar words with a highlighter.

2025-05.daily_overview: After handling medical records in the morning, in the afternoon I independently ran univariate analysis results in SPSS for the first time. Though I was still unfamiliar with it, I took the first step in research practice. After work, I went straight to the gym and played badminton vigorously with Lin Wei for an hour. Sweating heavily, we poured out our anxiety about exam preparation. After exercising, the two of us shared a bottle of water, sat on the ground giggling, and felt our energy return.

events.name: Routine medical work in the morning
events.description: After the morning handover meeting, Xiaowen accompanied the attending physician of her team on ward rounds, recording and executing rehabilitation therapy adjustments for three patients. One of them was a patient who had just been transferred in yesterday after the acute phase of cerebral infarction. She assessed muscle strength in detail and updated the rehabilitation plan. After ten o'clock, she returned to the office and wrote three progress notes, quite efficiently.

events.name: SPSS univariate analysis exercise
events.description: At 2 p.m., taking advantage of the patients being relatively stable, Xiaowen opened the SPSS tutorial she had bought yesterday and gradually imported a set of simulated cerebral infarction case data (150 cases) that Teacher Li Wei had given her. While flipping through the book, she tried descriptive statistics, t-test, and chi-square test. Her first independent operations met with frequent errors, but after the fifth time of reorganizing the variable attributes, she finally succeeded in outputting results. Excitedly, she took a screenshot and archived it, labeling it 'First Step in Research'.

events.name: Playing badminton against Lin Wei.
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m., Xiaowen changed into sportswear directly in the hospital changing room and drove five minutes to the court to meet Lin Wei. The two first did fifteen minutes of basic swing and footwork drills, then played three intense singles games. Xiaowen's smashes were especially smooth, and her heart rate once spiked to 150 beats per minute. During the break between games, wiping sweat, she confided to Lin Wei her worry that she didn't have enough time to prepare for the attending physician exam. Lin Wei encouraged her by sharing her own experience of cramming for exams in her student days, and they agreed on the spot to continue next Wednesday.

events.name: Return home to bathe and have a light dinner
events.description: After exercising, Xiaowen felt relaxed all over. She went home, took a hot shower, and assembled a plate of ready-to-eat chicken breast and vegetable salad from the fridge as dinner. While eating, she scrolled through a few WeChat official account articles related to rehabilitation medicine.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready to start work

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally relaxed; exercise released stress.

2025-05.daily_overview: After the ward round, her supervising teacher Li Wei gave Xiaowen 30 minutes of precise guidance on her research direction, which suddenly made things clear to her. During the day, she independently handled a case of sudden dyspnea, and her calm performance won praise from the head nurse. Because of days of desk work, her right shoulder and neck began to feel stiff and sore, so she created a midday relaxation routine to relieve it. In the evening, she attended her first online medical English course and filled three pages of notes; life gained a new rhythm.

events.name: Ward rounds and research mentoring
events.description: In the morning, before the fog had fully dispersed, Xiaowen followed Li Wei on ward rounds and then took the initiative to ask him for advice on research progress in the office. Li Wei flipped through the preliminary statistical results and case list she had made the day before, and suggested: first build a clean small database, focus on the association between neurological deficit scores and depression scale scores during the rehabilitation period, and put data cleaning first. In just half an hour, Xiaowen wrote down a four-step action checklist in her notebook and her confidence greatly increased.

events.name: Independently handle sudden breathing difficulty
events.description: At around 10 a.m., the cerebral infarction patient in bed 23 suddenly developed difficulty breathing, and blood oxygen saturation dropped to 89%. Xiaowen arrived immediately, determined that it might be sputum obstruction, immediately suctioned the sputum and increased the oxygen flow rate, while calling for a senior doctor. When Li Wei rushed over, the patient had stabilized. He then ordered antibiotics to be adjusted, and Xiaowen recorded the entire rescue process. Afterwards, head nurse Wu Min praised her for “handling the first step quickly.”

events.name: Neck and shoulder stiffness and midday relaxation exercises
events.description: After sorting out the emergency treatment records in the afternoon, Xiaowen felt a soreness in her right neck and shoulder, and when she turned her head, the pulling sensation was obvious. She realized it was caused by several days of desk work and last night's long time spent looking down while previewing, so she stood against the wall in the teaching room during her lunch break and improvised a set of neck stretches and shoulder circles. After 5 minutes, the soreness was slightly relieved. She decided to do this set of relaxation exercises every lunch break from today.

events.name: Medical English Lesson One
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., logged into Zoom on time for the first medical English class. The foreign teacher previewed circulatory system terms in English and simulated doctor-patient dialogues. Xiaowen was a little nervous at first but quickly adapted. During the dialogue practice, she even proactively spoke a passage; although a bit halting, she completed it well. At the end of class, she organized 15 new words and manually added them to her Anki deck.

events.name: Reviewed flashcards before bed.
events.description: After class ended at 10:30, Xiaowen didn't go to sleep immediately. Instead, she quickly reviewed today's English flashcards and the pharmacology flashcards she had copied a few days earlier, for about 20 minutes. She felt she was building a systematic learning network.

start_state.mood: Slightly drowsy but quickly became alert.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

2025-05.daily_overview: Today she made progress on three fronts: in the morning, following her teacher's guidance, she spent three hours building a basic database containing indicators from 150 patients with cerebral infarction; at noon, the attending physician textbook she ordered arrived, and in the evening she immediately threw herself into making excerpt cards. Her mother quietly sorted the scattered cards by subject and clipped them with colored clips. When Xiaowen found them in the evening, she was too moved to speak. Her neck and shoulders still ached faintly, but she persisted with her midday relaxation exercises.

events.name: Build a small research database.
events.description: After the morning handover, Xiaowen got permission from the on-duty colleague, took over a corner of the desk, opened SPSS, and, based on the field suggestions Li Wei gave yesterday, screened 150 eligible cerebral infarction cases from the electronic medical record system. She gradually extracted variables including age, sex, admission NHISS score, rehabilitation duration, HAMD depression score, and FIM functional independence score, and entered them row by row. When she encountered inconsistent variable coding, she called a colleague in the statistics office to resolve it. It took about three hours to complete the initial database. She then ran a simple frequency distribution and found several suspicious outliers, which she marked for follow-up. Because staring at the screen for a long time made her neck and shoulders stiffer, she got up and moved around every half hour.

events.name: Receiving the teaching material delivery
events.description: At noon, a JD delivery courier called to notify her. Xiaowen went downstairs and retrieved the package from the locker. When she opened it, it turned out to be a thick set of attending physician exam textbooks and the accompanying exercise book. She eagerly flipped through the table of contents and saw that the chapters on physiology, pharmacology, pathology, and so on were clearly organized. The exercise book also included a distribution table of exam points over the years, and the map for exam preparation gradually became clear in her mind.

events.name: Lunchtime neck and shoulder relaxation and rapid reading of literature
events.description: In the afternoon, Xiaowen did a 5-minute neck and shoulder relaxation exercise, then used her spare moments to quickly scan the abstracts of five articles on non-pharmacological interventions for post-stroke depression on PubMed, and downloaded a systematic review to her phone for careful reading over the weekend.

events.name: Making study flashcards for exam preparation.
events.description: After dinner, Xiaowen carefully copied the easily confused pharmacology and pathology exam points marked in the textbook (about 15 items in total) onto white index cards, writing on both sides with a black pen in neat handwriting. When she finished, she casually divided the cards into small piles by subject and put them in a pen holder, planning to post them up on the weekend.

events.name: Mother quietly sorted the cards
events.description: Around 9:30 p.m., mother Li Xiuying noticed the small cards scattered on the desk, sat on the edge of the bed, and sorted them into five categories by content: internal medicine, surgery, gynecology and pediatrics, neurology, and pharmacology. She found plastic clips in five colors from the drawer and clipped each category separately. In particular, she put the purple clip for neurology-related cards in a separate transparent bag for her daughter's convenience. When Xiaowen came back from getting water and saw this, she hugged her mother in surprise, feeling an extra gentle support on her exam-prep journey.

start_state.mood: Clear goals, tight preparation and execution

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou

2025-05.daily_overview: A milestone Saturday: In the early morning, she went on her first weekend morning run, a 3-kilometer run along the Dongfeng Canal, reconnecting with the city through her body; she received clay and tools sent by Su Ya from Jingdezhen, and the touch of the moist clay instantly awakened her shelved desire to create; in the afternoon, her father sat up independently for the first time at the rehabilitation center, and she recorded the whole process with her phone while her mother clapped with relief. The entire day was filled with small blessings and great hopes.

events.name: First weekend morning run
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Xiaowen put on her quick-dry clothes and running shoes and went out to jog along the Dongfeng Canal section of the Jinshui River. The spring breeze was slightly cool but felt comfortable. She kept her cadence with a metronome and completed 3.2 kilometers at an average pace of 6:30. After the run, while stretching by the river, she felt some pulling in her neck and shoulders, but it was a bit better than yesterday, so she deliberately added shoulder circles. Watching the elderly doing morning exercise and young people walking their dogs, she decided to make weekend morning runs a regular habit.

events.name: Received a pottery surprise from Suya.
events.description: At ten in the morning, a courier delivered a package from Jingdezhen. When she opened it, it contained a whole block of kaolin clay wrapped in plastic wrap, a set of mini sculpting tools, and an elegant card. Su Ya had written: 'The clay is waiting for you to come back. Xiaowen, don't give up the joy of shaping mud.' She placed the clay in the most prominent spot on the bookshelf. As her fingertips grazed the moist clay, the idea of restarting her creative work became concrete. She immediately took a photo and sent it to Su Ya, replying: 'I'll start sculpting the zodiac animals next week.'

events.name: Family members drove to the rehabilitation center
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Xiaowen drove the family car to the rehabilitation hospital to pick up her mother, then went to her parents' rented home on Huayuan Road to pick up her father (because of his improvement, he was allowed to go home on weekends), and together they went to the Rehabilitation Center in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. Her father was in excellent spirits today and was even joking in the car.

events.name: Father's rehabilitation milestone: first time sitting up independently.
events.description: In the rehabilitation treatment room, under the supervision of therapist Dr. Zhang, her father did his daily core muscle training. After the improvement in bed mobility in the previous few days, today, with Xiaowen and her mother watching, her father finally sat up from a supine position completely on his own strength after four attempts, keeping his back straight for nearly ten seconds. Xiaowen had already turned on the camera, so she held her phone steady and recorded the whole process, while her mother clapped with relief. After evaluation, Dr. Zhang believed that his core strength had significantly increased and that standing balance training could be gradually added. Xiaowen sent the video to the family group chat with the caption: "Dad sat up on his own for the first time today!"

events.name: Post-rehabilitation discussion and return home.
events.description: After the training, Xiaowen briefly confirmed with the therapist the plan to increase standing bed time next week. On the way home, her father was still excited and said to Xiaowen, 'I feel that by the end of the year I can walk a few steps.' Back at her parents' place, Xiaowen and her mother worked together to wipe her father down and change his clothes. After settling him, she drove back to her own apartment.

events.name: Evening ward companionship and English study
events.description: Learning that her mother insisted on staying overnight with her father, Xiaowen came to the ward at eight to briefly relieve her mother. Taking advantage of her father falling asleep, she put on headphones and used her tablet to shadow-read the dialogues in the circulatory system chapter of Medical English, and wrote out vocabulary from memory on sticky notes. This lasted about 40 minutes. At ten, her mother urged her to go back and rest, and only then did she leave.

start_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
start_state.mood: Awake and full of anticipation to try new sports.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Joyful but exhausted; my father's milestone brought a huge psychological reward.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Mother's Day, Xiaowen ordered flowers for her mother early in the morning and sent a hand cream gift set. Hearing her mother's voice, half reproachful and half delighted, made her especially satisfied. Then she drove back to Zhengzhou and hurried to the bridal salon to accompany Wang Fang in trying on wedding dresses for three hours. The friends teased each other about the dress silhouettes and what their future weddings would look like, laughing so hard they rocked back and forth. In the evening, she unexpectedly shaped her first clay horse of the Chinese zodiac and sent it to Su Ya to share. Although her skills were still raw, she was filled with the joy of creation. The discomfort in her neck and shoulders was completely forgotten in the absorption of kneading the clay.

events.name: Order flowers and gifts for Mom in the early morning.
events.description: At seven in the morning, Xiaowen woke up at her apartment on Jingsan Road and immediately ordered a bouquet of pink carnations with baby's breath, along with a L'Occitane shea butter hand cream gift set, through the Flowerplus platform. She instructed the courier to deliver it to her mother's rental home on Huayuan Road before 11 a.m., with a message: "Mom, happy Mother's Day. Don't forget to use the hand cream every day."

events.name: Went to her parents' home to spend the morning of Mother's Day.
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Xiaowen drove from her apartment on Jingsan Road to her parents' rental home on Huayuan Road, bringing breakfast she had bought (hot soy milk and steamed buns) to share with them. At home, she chatted with her mother, watched her arrange flowers, and applied hand cream to her mother's hands. At about 9:30, she said goodbye and returned to her own apartment to prepare for trying on wedding dresses.

events.name: Accompanied Wang Fang to try on wedding dresses
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, Xiaowen drove to the bridal salon near Wanda in Zhongyuan District to meet Wang Fang. The two first picked out five different styles at the rack (satin A-line, strapless mermaid, light tulle ball gown, etc.). Every time Wang Fang changed into one, she lifted the hem and walked out to twirl around. Xiaowen carefully took photos from multiple angles with her phone and, from a doctor’s aesthetic perspective, suggested, ‘The neckline could be lowered a bit to make the neck look longer.’ The dress fitting lasted about three hours in total. After liking two styles, Wang Fang took Xiaowen’s hand and said, ‘You must be my bridesmaid, and wear the champagne-colored one!’ Xiaowen agreed with a smile. During that time, they also talked about Zhang Jing, and on a whim called her to arrange to attend a symphony performance together at the provincial concert hall on the evening of May 17.

events.name: Mother received the gift and gave feedback
events.description: At noon, her mother sent a voice message, pretending to complain: "You're spending money again, but the flowers are really pretty. I'm looking for a vase to put them in, and I'll apply the hand cream right away." In the background, her father could be heard saying "Thank you, Erniu." Xiaowen listened to it twice while taking a break from trying on wedding dresses, a smile creeping into the corners of her eyes, and replied with a hug sticker.

events.name: Return home for a rest and a simple lunch
events.description: Returned to the Jingsan Road apartment at 2 p.m. Xiaowen used the remaining bit of high-gluten flour to try making a small bowl of hand-pulled braised noodles, topped with tomato and egg sauce. The taste unexpectedly had about forty percent of her mother's cooking. She took a photo and sent it to the Three-Person Family group chat. Her mother instantly replied, "Learned it?"

events.name: First pottery hand-shaping: a little zodiac horse
events.description: At six in the evening, while it was still light out, Xiaowen took out the kaolin clay Suya had sent, spread newspaper on the desk, and started shaping the zodiac horse from memory. Her technique was rough, and the horse's neck was crooked, but after an hour of focused pressing and shaping, a simple little horse about 8 cm tall stood on the desk. She looked at it from all sides, found it charmingly clumsy, covered it with a damp cloth to prevent cracking, took a photo, and sent it to Suya: 'The first one, ugly-cute.' Suya replied instantly: 'Ten times better than my first one! Next time I'll teach you glazing.'

events.name: Video chat with mother
events.description: At 8 p.m., Xiaowen proactively made a video call. On the screen, her mother had already placed the carnations in the most prominent vase in the living room; her hands were clearly coated with hand cream, shiny. Her mother asked about the wedding dress fitting. Xiaowen described the details of the gown, and they chatted about everyday matters for another half hour. Finally, her mother reminded her to rest well. Through the screen, Xiaowen felt an ordinary yet solid happiness.

events.name: English review before bed
events.description: After her shower, Xiaowen, while it was quiet, opened the English app and reviewed the vocabulary for the circulatory system and last week's skeletal system. She completed the after-class quiz with a 90% accuracy rate.

2025-05.daily_overview: She entered a full-load work state. During the morning ward round, she paid special attention to several patients with low mood after cerebral infarction, drawing on her own father's rehabilitation experience. In the afternoon, she focused on reading literature and wrote an outline for the case discussion, organizing the idea of psychological intervention combined with exercise therapy into writing. She felt the logic was coherent and gained more confidence in tomorrow's departmental discussion. She did her usual midday relaxation exercises, and the stiffness in her neck and shoulders eased.

events.name: Monday morning shift handover and ward rounds
events.description: Monday routine: Director Zhang Lei presided over the major handover, and each medical group reported on the weekend situation. Xiaowen's group reported the multidisciplinary assessment results of three newly admitted patients with cerebral infarction. During the subsequent ward round, she deliberately squatted down to ask a young cerebral infarction patient in Bed 15 about his feelings, recorded his exact words 'I feel like a useless person,' and marked 'psychological intervention needed' in her ward round notebook.

events.name: Midday neck and shoulder relaxation exercises
events.description: At 12:30, Xiaowen did a 5-minute neck and shoulder relaxation exercise in the demonstration room. The stiffness was noticeably relieved today, so she decided to make it a daily habit.

events.name: Systematically write an outline for a case discussion presentation.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Xiaowen made a cup of instant coffee in the doctors' office, opened her laptop and all the literature notes she had organized, and, based on the improvement in her father's mood during rehabilitation (such as his talking more after short outings), wrote a case discussion speech outline of about 1,200 characters, item by item, in four sections: Disease Background and Current Status, Evidence-Based Psychological Intervention, Mechanisms of Exercise Therapy, and Case Application and Recommendations. After finishing the first draft, she practiced it in a low voice and revised the transition sentences.

events.name: Texted Sun Yue to set up Wednesday dinner.
events.description: At six in the evening, her university classmate Sun Yue sent a WeChat message inviting her to dinner on Wednesday evening. Xiaowen remembered that she had plans to play ball on Wednesday, so she replied, “Thursday evening or Friday noon?” and they finally settled on a small get-together after work on Thursday. Then she casually shared the video of her father sitting up with Sun Yue and received a bunch of exclamations and likes.

events.name: Continued building up English terminology in the evening
events.description: Starting at eight o'clock, Xiaowen had no classes, but she took the initiative to open the Medical English textbook, organized roots and affixes of the nervous system (neuro-, -plegia, aphasia, etc.) into Anki cards, and repeatedly listened to and read the words that might appear in tomorrow's case discussion. When she closed the book at half past ten, she had also listened to the BBC Six-Minute Medical English podcast three times as extensive listening.

2025-05.daily_overview: Today's highlight: during the case discussion, Xiaowen drew on her own experience to propose “psychological intervention combined with exercise therapy,” which was recognized on the spot by Director Zhang Lei, who publicly encouraged her to write up a case report, cementing her professional confidence. After work, she took a detour to buy two bouquets of lisianthus for her mother and Wang Fang to share her joy. In the evening, the second medical English class started to go well, and she could read along with complete case reports. Her neck and shoulders had largely recovered, but she still persisted with her relaxation exercises.

events.name: Morning rounds and preoperative preparation
events.description: Tuesday routine work. In the morning, she assisted Li Wei in a pre-injection assessment of a patient with post-stroke spasticity before botulinum toxin injection. Xiaowen was responsible for recording the muscle tone score and filming pre-treatment videos for archiving. After completing rounds on twenty beds, she used the interval to silently go over yesterday's outline.

events.name: Midday neck and shoulder relaxation exercises
events.description: After the meal, I did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder relaxation in the demonstration room. The stiffness has basically disappeared, but I still keep the habit.

events.name: Presentation at the department case discussion meeting
events.description: At three in the afternoon, the department held a difficult case discussion in the conference room. The subject was a middle-aged man with post-stroke sequelae complicated by depression. Xiaowen, representing Li Wei's group, presented the PPT she had made, and from the perspective of evidence-based practice and direct observation of her father's care, she clearly proposed that "in addition to standard medication and rehabilitation, psychological counseling and a regular exercise prescription should be integrated early." After her speech, Director Zhang Lei commented: "Combining clinical observation with the literature is well done. You can organize this type of case into a case report and aim to submit it within the year." Xiaowen bowed to express thanks, her heart stirring with waves.

events.name: Buy a bouquet to express gratitude
events.description: After work, Xiaowen drove to the flower shop on Jingsan Road and picked two simply wrapped bouquets of lisianthus (white and green). She sent one bouquet to her mother's home and told her, 'The director praised me.' The other was sent to Wang Fang's home via Flash Delivery with a card reading 'Stress relief for the bride-to-be.' Her mother held the flowers and took a photo to post in the group chat, and Wang Fang replied with a string of hearts.

events.name: Evening Medical English Lesson 2
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., she attended the medical English class on time. Today's topic was common English for neurological physical examination. In the role-play segment, Xiaowen was asked to describe the Babinski sign pathway in English. Although she mispronounced some words, her fluency had improved significantly compared with last week, and the teacher said 'Good job.' After class, for the first time she wrote a brief review of the day in her diary in English.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
events.description: After days of excitement, Xiaowen sat cross-legged before bed and did a ten-minute body scan meditation, consciously relaxing her shoulders, neck, and eyes. When her breathing slowed and deepened, she soon fell asleep.
