2025-05.daily_overview: When assisting in the outpatient clinic during the day, she stood for half the day drawing blood. Her lower back was a little sore, but she was efficient. After work, she honored her badminton appointment with Lin Wei. The two played hard until the streetlights came on, and sweat washed away the anxiety of the past few days. When she got home, she was pleasantly surprised to find that her mother had come from her home on Huayuan Road and had already sorted all the exam flashcards by subject. The purple binder even had a label marked Neurology. Xiaowen looked at it for a long time, her weary heart filled with maternal love.

events.name: Assisted in the outpatient clinic and drew blood in the morning.
events.description: On Wednesday morning, she rotated to the outpatient clinic to assist. Xiaowen stood by the blood collection window all morning, issuing test requisitions and directing more than 20 patients while quickly entering electronic medical records. After standing for four hours, her lower back was somewhat stiff, but she used breaks to do two back extensions for relief. She finished at 11:30 and returned to the ward for lunch.

events.name: Midday neck and shoulder relaxation exercises
events.description: After the meal, I did 5 minutes of relaxation exercises in the on-call room. My neck and shoulders felt fine; keep it up.

events.name: In the afternoon, complete the filing of medical records.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Xiaowen used the relatively quiet time to organize five department rotation medical records, checked the lab reports, and filed them. In the middle, she also assisted Liu Qiang in analyzing a complex EEG result, and Liu Qiang praised her for having "good clinical intuition."

events.name: Regular badminton sessions with Lin Wei.
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Xiaowen changed into her gear and hurried to the badminton court. Lin Wei had already warmed up, and the two started playing without further ado—three games of singles plus half a game of doubles practice (temporarily teaming up with the players on the next court). Xiaowen's smashes were in superb form today; she scored consecutively and covered nearly 4 kilometers on court. Between games, she shared recent family and career pressures with Lin Wei. Lin Wei, speaking from experience, comforted her: "Doctors have to learn to live with uncertainty," and gave her a badminton keychain as a small gift. The two agreed to increase the training intensity next Wednesday.

events.name: Mother's quiet show of concern during dinner.
events.description: After exercising, Xiaowen returned to her apartment on Jingsan Road, sweaty. Her mother had come over in the afternoon from her Huayuan Road residence and prepared a simple dinner (red date millet porridge, cucumber salad). During the meal, her mother mentioned casually, "I saw your cards spread out all over the table, so I sorted and clipped them. The neurology stacks I put aside separately with purple clips." Xiaowen put down her chopsticks, walked to the desk, and saw five neatly stacked piles of cards. Her nose tingled, and she turned around and hugged her mother tightly. Her mother patted her back and said, "Silly girl."

events.name: Evening stretching and flashcard memorization.
events.description: Before bed, Xiaowen did twenty minutes of yoga stretching (mainly for the lower back), then leaned against the headboard, took out three neurology cards from the ones her mother had sorted, and silently recited the correspondence between cerebral infarction lesion locations and signs. Five minutes later, she closed the cards and answered all the self-test questions correctly.

2025-05.daily_overview: During the morning ward rounds, she focused on adjusting the treatment plan for the depressed patient, and the director praised her for being thoughtful. In the afternoon, she finally received the revision request for her paper, which required supplementary data, and her stress suddenly mounted. In the evening, she helped Aunt Song, a recently retired neighbor, register for electronic medical insurance and was given a pot of pothos in return. At dinner, her mother came over from her home on Huayuan Road. After the meal, her mother quietly complained about feeling lonely in the city. Xiaowen put her arm around her shoulder to comfort her and agreed to take her to the park and buy daily necessities on Sunday. Then she forced herself to stay energized through English class, and when it ended, she found the city was already lit up with thousands of lights. She wrote in her diary: I want to make Mom smile again every day.

events.name: Ward rounds and medication adjustment for a depressed patient
events.description: On Thursday morning, because of the effect of last week's case discussion, Li Wei had Xiaowen lead the ward round interview of an elderly patient with post-stroke depression. Using the PHQ-9 scale for an initial assessment, she found that the patient's interest had decreased. After discussing with Li Wei, she added escitalopram and scheduled psychological counseling. Director Zhang Lei observed the rounds, nodded, and privately said to Li Wei, Xiaowen is really getting the hang of it.

events.name: Midday neck and shoulder relaxation exercises
events.description: At noon, I did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder relaxation in the teaching room to keep up the habit.

events.name: Received the revision comments for the paper
events.description: At 2 p.m., Xiaowen received an email from the editorial office of Henan Medical Research stating that the paper needed to add follow-up data from the past two years and adjust the statistical methods. She felt a wave of anxiety, immediately forwarded the email to Teacher Li Wei, and scheduled a discussion for tomorrow on the revision plan. This sudden task disrupted her original exam-preparation plan.

events.name: Helped neighbor Aunt Song.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Xiaowen left work ten minutes early. At the elevator entrance, she met Aunt Song (a relative of the landlord) who had just retired and lived downstairs. Aunt Song held a smartphone and asked how to apply for an electronic medical insurance credential. Xiaowen immediately helped her download the National Healthcare Security APP, complete facial recognition verification, and taught her how to use it. Aunt Song was grateful and insisted on giving her a pot of home-grown hydroponic pothos. After arriving home, Xiaowen placed the pothos on a corner of her desk, lush with greenery.

events.name: Expressed loneliness to mother during dinner
events.description: Before dinner, my mother came from her home on Huayuan Road to Xiaowen's home on Jingsan Road and made hand-rolled stewed noodles for her daughter, served with shredded pork and green peppers. After the meal, my mother sat on the sofa and was silent for a long time, then suddenly murmured, 'These buildings are so tall here. I don't even have an acquaintance to talk to when I go out, and it feels suffocating.' Xiaowen's heart tightened. She walked over, gently put her arm around her mother's shoulders, and said softly, 'Don't worry. On Sunday we'll go to People's Park, and I'll take you to the West Suburb vegetable market to get familiar with the area. You'll gradually have company.' Mother sighed and nodded.

events.name: After comforting her mother, attended the third lesson of Medical English
events.description: After calming her mother down, it was almost 8:30. Xiaowen hurriedly opened the computer and entered the Zoom classroom. That night, the class covered diabetes-related terms. Because she was distracted, she interacted somewhat less in class, but she still kept up with the reading and screenshotted key slides. During the break, she switched to WeChat and sent Zhang Jing a message: “Are you free on Sunday? I want to take my mom to the park. Are you coming?” Zhang Jing replied instantly, “ok.”

events.name: Diary and mood tracking
events.description: After class, Xiaowen didn't review immediately. Instead, she opened her hardcover notebook and wrote a brief entry: "5.15 Mom felt unwell; it was my negligence. I must take action this weekend. The paper revision adds more pressure, but I have to deal with it one thing at a time." Then she listed the items for Sunday's park trip (water bottle, picnic mat, cut fruit, camera) before washing up.

It was a full and colorful day.

events.name: Balcony stretching and breakfast
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen did 10 minutes of stretching on the balcony, then jogged 3 kilometers along the Dongfeng Canal greenway. After returning home and showering, she prepared a sandwich and milk. At 8:15, her mother Li Xiuying walked over from the neighboring residential compound.

events.name: Taking my mother for a walk in Zijingshan Park
events.description: At 9 a.m., the mother and daughter walked to Zijingshan Park and strolled slowly along the lakeside path. Yu Xiaowen pointed out the iconic pavilion to her mother. When her mother saw the elderly people doing morning exercises and dancing, her eyes lit up with interest, and Yu Xiaowen encouraged her to come regularly in the future.

events.name: Taught my mother to use mobile payment to buy water
events.description: At the park kiosk, Yu Xiaowen taught her mother hand-by-hand to buy water by scanning a QR code with WeChat. Her mother was unfamiliar with the operation, but after succeeding, she smiled and muttered, 'This thing is actually quite convenient.'

events.name: Three-way video call, Lina's warm care.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Wang Lina initiated a WeChat video call, and the three of them, including Zhang Jing, chatted together. Seeing that Xiaowen looked thinner, Lina said directly, "Don't push yourself too hard. While taking care of your dad, you also need to take care of yourself." Zhang Jing chimed in. The three caught up on recent news, with laughter throughout. Yu Xiaowen felt her tense nerves relax quite a bit.

events.name: Prepare hiking gear for Mount Song
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowen took out her hiking shoes, quick-dry clothes, and backpack, and packed a water bottle, energy bars, a sun hat, sunscreen, and a small first aid kit. She confirmed with Sun Yue via WeChat to meet at the entrance of Zijingshan Park at 7 a.m. the next morning. Sun Yue reminded her to bring knee pads, so Yu Xiaowen rummaged through the drawer, found the old knee pads, and packed them.

events.name: An Evening of Tchaikovsky with Zhang Jing
events.description: At 6 pm, changed into a French floral print dress and met Zhang Jing at Henan Art Center. Listening to the Swan Lake suite and other pieces, Yu Xiaowen closed her eyes and immersed herself in the melody. During the intermission, Zhang Jing sighed softly, "It's different live," and the two agreed to pay more attention to performances at the Art Center in the future.

events.name: Stretching after returning home and going to bed early.
events.description: The show ended at 9 p.m. After taking a taxi home, she did 10 minutes of stretching, checked her hiking backpack, set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, and went to bed at 10:30 on time.

2025-05.daily_overview: Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue challenged Junji Peak on Mount Song with an outdoor club. The physical exertion was huge throughout, but the view at the summit completely released her stress and strengthened her resolve to take up more outdoor activities.

events.name: Gather and set off
events.description: The 6:00 alarm went off. I quickly washed up, put on my hiking gear, left at 6:30, and took a taxi to Zijingshan Park. At 6:45 I met up with Sun Yue and the 'Walker Outdoor' team. Sun Yue handed me a sports drink, and the two of us happily took a selfie. At 7:00 the bus departed. The leader explained the route: Songyang Academy → Junji Peak, return by the same route, with a total climb of about 800 meters and an estimated 6 hours.

events.name: Initial section of the Songshan hike
events.description: Arrived at Songyang Academy at 8:40 a.m., took a group photo, and then started walking. The stone steps were gently sloping at first, and Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue chatted and laughed. After entering Zhongyue Palace, the steps became steeper. Yu Xiaowen was short of breath and asked for a rest every ten minutes. Sun Yue lent her a hiking pole and encouraged her.

events.name: Lunch break and rest on the platform
events.description: They arrived at the flat viewing platform at 11:40 a.m. and rested for 40 minutes. Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue shared sandwiches, apples, and beef jerky. A cool breeze blew at the mountaintop, and they could see Dengfeng city in the distance. Yu Xiaowen rubbed her sore calves, feeling only 30% recovered, and thought, 'I have to go up.'

events.name: Successfully summited Junji Peak
events.description: At 1:10 p.m., gritting her teeth, she climbed the last section of the "Sky Ladder" and finally stood beside the 1,492-meter monument on Junji Peak. Clouds rolled like a sea, and in the distance the Yellow River looked like a ribbon. She stared with her mouth open; Sun Yue took a photo of her from behind with her arms outstretched. She shouted into the valley, and months of pressure seemed to be blown away by the wind. In her notebook she wrote, "Broaden boundaries."

events.name: Going down the mountain and heading back.
events.description: Started descending the mountain at 1:30 PM. The knee hurt a little but it was no problem. Walked down while chatting and sharing goals. At 4 PM the whole team returned to the parking lot, and Yu Xiaowen fell fast asleep in the car. At 6 they returned to Zijingshan, had a bowl of Lanzhou beef noodles, and then went home separately. The first thing after entering the house was to soak her feet in hot water, and then she sent the summit photos to her parents.

events.name: Organize reflections and sleep early
events.description: In the evening, sitting at the desk, she wrote reflections in her phone diary: 'Climbing a mountain is like life—only after persisting do you see the scenery. From now on, go on at least one outdoor hike every month.' She sent the photos to her close-friends group and received a bunch of likes. At 9:30, her whole body was sore but her mind was clear, and she soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Both excited and nervous.

end_state.location: Home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou
end_state.mood: Extremely exhausted but utterly exhilarated

2025-05.daily_overview: On Monday she went to work, body still achy from the previous day, but Yu Xiaowen was still energetic and devoted to her work. During the lunch break, she ran into her dentist and chatted about oral health. In the evening, she continued thinking about her career direction.

events.name: Morning restorative stretching.
events.description: Got up at 6:30 in the morning. My legs were sore, so I did 15 minutes of stretching on my yoga mat targeting my calves and thighs, and felt much better. For breakfast, I drank soy milk and ate eggs.

events.name: Daily hospital work
events.description: Arrived at the hospital at 8 a.m. and did ward rounds with Li Wei. The several patients I was in charge of were in stable condition. One patient in the recovery phase of a cerebral infarction tried to stand, and I carefully recorded changes in muscle strength. Li Wei noticed she was limping slightly and asked with a smile, "You went hiking, didn't you?" She nodded sheepishly.

events.name: Midday Encounter with Dentist Chen Mingyuan
events.description: While waiting in line at the cafeteria at noon, she ran into Dr. Chen Mingyuan from the Department of Stomatology, and the two sat together with their trays. Dr. Chen talked about recent cases of the link between periodontal disease and overall health. Yu Xiaowen thought of her father's recovery and asked a few more questions.

events.name: During lunch break, consulted an introduction to rehabilitation medicine.
events.description: After returning to the office, she used her computer to search for basic textbooks and training materials on rehabilitation medicine and bookmarked several recent review articles. The magnificence of reaching the summit last night sparked a cross-disciplinary idea in her, and she wrote down the keywords “rehabilitation, technology, and humanities” in her notebook.

events.name: Afternoon medical record writing and teaching Q&A
events.description: At the computer finalizing the discharge summary, Li Wei passed by and asked about the timing of post-stroke rehabilitation. She answered well. Li Wei encouraged her to pay more attention to the new equipment in the rehabilitation department, saying there might be opportunities to rotate there in the future.

events.name: Confirming the meeting time with Zhao Ming
events.description: Before leaving work, Zhao Ming sent a WeChat message: "I'm on a business trip to Zhengzhou on the 20th. Are you free for dinner in the evening?" Yu Xiaowen happily replied, "Sure, old classmate, we haven't seen each other for a long time. Let's go to that Hunan restaurant near the hospital." They agreed on 7 p.m. tomorrow evening.

events.name: Evening organizing mountain climbing photos and exam preparation
events.description: After dinner, she selected 9 mountaineering photos on the computer and posted them on WeChat Moments: 'Back from Mount Song, legs are done, heart is wider. #OneMountainAWeek#' She soon received dozens of likes. Then she reviewed circulatory system flashcards for the attending physician exam for 30 minutes and went to bed at 11.

2025-05.daily_overview: Busy at the hospital during the day, and in the evening a reunion with old classmate Zhao Ming over dinner sparked her career vision of integrating rehabilitation technology and humanities.

events.name: Normal work rhythm
events.description: Walked to the hospital at 6:40 a.m. and independently handled several routine cases in the morning, including prescribing physical therapy for a patient with lower back pain. At noon, she ate with colleagues Wang Fang and Wu Min in the cafeteria. Wang Fang talked about next week's baking class. Yu Xiaowen was not very interested but did not spoil the mood.

events.name: Zhao Ming's dinner invitation and anticipation
events.description: At 3 p.m., Zhao Ming sent a WeChat message: 'I've arrived in Zhengzhou. See you at 7 p.m.?' Yu Xiaowen replied: 'See you there no matter what.' She finished her medical records early before getting off work and changed into a clean shirt.

events.name: A small gathering with Zhao Ming; sparks flew over rehabilitation technology.
events.description: At 7 p.m., the two sat down at a Hunan restaurant near the hospital. Zhao Ming excitedly shared the development of the rehabilitation department in Shenzhen: 'Our department has introduced lower-limb rehabilitation robots; patients train wearing VR goggles, and data is uploaded in real time. There's also AI gait analysis, which is scarily accurate.' Yu Xiaowen listened intently and, thinking of the monotony of her father's self-training and her own tactile experience in pottery, blurted out: 'Rehabilitation can't be cold and impersonal. Wouldn't it be better to add some artistic design?' Zhao Ming was stunned for a moment, then slapped the table: 'That's a great angle! Technology also needs warmth.' The more they talked, the more they hit it off, from rehabilitation robots to empathy between doctors and patients, until the restaurant was about to close and they left.

events.name: Late-night diary: a new direction emerges
events.description: She got home at nearly 10 o'clock and firmly wrote down the combination 'rehabilitation + technology + humanity' in her diary, then drew a triangle. After that, she searched the literature on 'art therapy rehabilitation' and found foreign cases of pottery used for hand function rehabilitation. Excited, she took a screenshot and saved it, deciding to talk with Teacher Li Wei tomorrow.

events.name: Bedtime exam preparation and new ideas

She simply sat up and wrote on the back of a study card the keywords 'rehabilitation robots, artistic intervention, Dad's rehabilitation', adding a question mark: 'My next step?' She only gradually fell asleep after midnight.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen personally observed a demonstration of a lower-limb rehabilitation robot at the hospital and had an in-depth discussion with her instructor Li Wei about the technology's applications, further planting the seed of a career change. After work, she hurried to her parents' home to share the good news.

events.name: Arrived early to prepare for the observation
events.description: At 6:50 a.m., she arrived at the hospital 10 minutes early and saw a notice on the department bulletin board: “At 10:00 a.m. today, there will be a lower-limb rehabilitation robot demonstration in the rehabilitation therapy room. All are welcome to observe.” She was delighted, quickly finished the morning handover and ward rounds, and at 9:50 hurried to the rehabilitation therapy room with a notebook and pen.

events.name: Observed the entire robot demonstration and took detailed notes.
events.description: From 10 to 11 a.m., the manufacturer's rehabilitation engineer explained and demonstrated the operation of the lower-limb exoskeleton robot in detail: from startup calibration and securing the patient safety straps, to gait parameter settings (stride length 35 cm, assist mode enabled, emergency stop threshold set), and then to passive training with a simulated patient. Yu Xiaowen stood in the front row, eyes fixed on the screen and the movement of the robotic legs, filling her notebook with dense notes: 'gait cycle symmetry adjustment,' 'safety torque limit,' 'comparison of effects when combined with conventional PT.' She also took a short video with her phone.

events.name: Discuss application prospects with her instructor Li Wei.
events.description: After the demonstration, Yu Xiaowen found Li Wei in the department rest area, spread open her notebook, and said excitedly, "Teacher, if this robot is used for patients with abnormal gait after cerebral infarction, would the recovery period be shortened?" Li Wei smiled and analyzed, "In principle, the robot provides precise repetitive movement and feedback, which helps early neural remodeling, but the patient's muscle strength and cognitive level need to be assessed. Given your father's current condition, you could wait until his muscle strength improves a bit more before considering it, on top of regular training." Yu Xiaowen nodded seriously, thinking to herself about how to combine this technology with her budding idea of "humanistic rehabilitation."

events.name: Li Wei suggested rotating to the rehabilitation department.
events.description: Seeing her strong interest, Li Wei added, "If you're truly interested, the hospital has a rotation policy. I can help you ask about the rehabilitation department. But if you want to switch departments, you need to plan early." Yu Xiaowen's heart skipped a beat, and she thanked him repeatedly.

events.name: Afternoon ward follow-up and supervised clinical learning
events.description: In the afternoon, continued ward rounds with Li Wei, compiled the parameters recorded today into an electronic document, and sent it to Li Wei for backup. She also asked head nurse Wu Min for advice on how to use technological devices in daily care to improve patient compliance. Wu Min said that some elderly people are afraid of machines, and the key is communication.

events.name: After work, visited parents and shared what I saw and heard
events.description: After leaving work at 6 p.m., she went directly to her parents' rental home on Huayuan Road. As soon as she entered, she took out her phone to show her father a robot video, explaining that future rehabilitation might be easier. Her father, wearing reading glasses, watched carefully and nodded. Her mother brought out freshly steamed buns, and the family of three ate while chatting. Before leaving, she helped massage her father's legs and encouraged him to keep practicing standing the next day.

events.name: In the evening, organized Tencent Docs and reviewed coursework
events.description: After returning home, she created a new Tencent Doc titled “Ideas on Integrating Rehabilitation Technology and Humanities” on her computer, and summarized today's experiences and the inspiration from Zhao Ming. After washing up, she reviewed the pharmacology section for the attending physician exam for 30 minutes and went to bed at 11.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Thursday, facing the financial advisor's aggressive suggestions, Yu Xiaowen calmly calculated and stuck to her conservative strategy, redeeming wealth management products to ensure liquidity. Outside of work, she began cleaning up research data to prepare for statistical analysis.

events.name: Routine workday, morning handover discussion.
events.description: Got up at 6:40 in the morning and walked to work. At the 8 o'clock morning meeting, Director Zhang Lei stressed the recent standards for medical record writing and praised the accurate wording Yu Xiaowen had written over the weekend. In the morning, she assisted with more than a dozen patients in the outpatient clinic.

events.name: The financial advisor called and suggested adding to the position.
events.description: At 10:20 a.m., she received a call from financial advisor Wang Mingyuan in her office. Wang Mingyuan analyzed the recent stock market pullback and suggested taking the opportunity to convert some fixed-income funds into equity-focused ones, saying 'long-term returns are higher.' After listening, Yu Xiaowen said she needed to think it over carefully, then hung up and opened mobile banking to check her account details.

events.name: Calculate expenses and stick to a conservative strategy
events.description: During the lunch break, she listed on paper the expected costs for her father's rehabilitation next month (physical therapy + medicine about 3,000 yuan), rent 5,000 yuan, car loan 1,000 yuan, living expenses 2,000 yuan, and so on; the balance in her current account would only last three months. She realized she absolutely could not risk the emergency money, so she called Wang Mingyuan back: "Manager Wang, my family expenses are high right now, and safety of funds comes first. I won't make any equity adjustment. Also, I'd like to redeem a 50,000-yuan short-term wealth management product in advance and move it to my current account for backup." Wang Mingyuan understood and processed it immediately.

events.name: Afternoon work and discussion of wedding details with Wang Fang
events.description: After the afternoon ward round, Wang Fang came to see her. The two chatted about wedding preparations at the nurses' station for 10 minutes. Wang Fang was a bit anxious about the seating arrangement. Yu Xiaowen comforted her, telling her to relax and that she would help keep an eye on it. Wang Fang broke into a smile and said she would treat her to milk tea another day.

events.name: Fund redemption operation and evening research database cleanup.
events.description: At 5:40 PM, she logged into mobile banking and confirmed that the redemption of 50,000 yuan of wealth management products had succeeded and was credited to her current account, which put her mind at ease. After dinner, she opened SPSS on her computer, opened the database of 150 stroke patients, and began data cleaning as Li Wei had suggested: deleting missing values, flagging outliers, and assigning values to categorical variables. Thanks to her mental focus in the evening, she worked straight through until 10 PM and had basically completed the cleaning.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and exam review flashcards
events.description: Do 10 minutes of meditation before bed, and reflect on today's decision to stick to the financial bottom line, feeling at ease. Then memorize several hematology system flashcards and turn off the lights at 11 o'clock.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Friday, Yu Xiaowen took half a day off and installed safety handrails, non-slip mats, and other items at her parents' home, making a key upgrade to her father's rehabilitation environment. After trying them, her father approved, and her brother transferred money to show support, making the family's care more concrete.

events.name: Taking leave and heading to her parents' home
events.description: At 6:50 in the morning, she sent a WeChat message to her supervising teacher Li Wei to ask for half a day off, explaining that she needed to go home to install safety equipment for the elderly. At 8:00, carrying a drill toolbox and express packages (safety grab bars, non-slip mats, shower chairs, etc.), she drove to her parents' rented three-bedroom apartment on Huayuan Road.

events.name: Install a foldable safety grab bar in the bathroom.
events.description: At 9 a.m., with her father's help, she determined the proper height on the wall beside the toilet in the bathroom. She used a drill to make holes, inserted expansion bolts, and firmly fixed the foldable grab bar in place. She repeatedly tested the load-bearing capacity to make sure her father could use it for support when standing up. Her father sat nearby watching and nodded from time to time.

events.name: Laying non-slip mats and placing a shower chair
events.description: Then, together with her mother, she laid large anti-slip mats on the floor of the shower area and placed the height-adjustable shower chair under the shower head. She had her mother simulate entering and exiting the shower to confirm the anti-slip effect, and her mother smiled with satisfaction.

events.name: Install a bedside assist rail for getting out of bed
events.description: Finally, she positioned and installed a small bed rail on the wall at the head of her father's bed. Her father tried it and found it much smoother to go from lying to sitting. He patted the handrail and said, "Really steady." Her mother quickly took a photo.

events.name: Warm feedback in the family WeChat group
events.description: At noon, after her father tried out the new facilities one by one, a smile appeared in his eyes. Her mother sent photos to the "Happy Family" WeChat group with the caption: 'Xiaowen has worked hard!' Soon her older brother Yu Xiaofeng replied: 'Professional! Dad will be much safer now. I'll transfer 2,000 yuan as my share.' Then a transfer of 2,000 yuan arrived. Yu Xiaowen expressed gratitude in the group: 'This is all I should do. Bro, life outside isn't easy either. Let's keep working hard together.'

events.name: Returning to work in the afternoon
events.description: At 2 p.m. she hurried back to the hospital for work, caught up on the medical records she had missed in the morning, and assisted Li Wei with a newly admitted patient. In the evening after work, she stopped by the supermarket to buy some daily necessities.

events.name: Evening relaxation and pottery hand-shaping.
events.description: In the evening, I took out the kaolin clay sent by Su Ya and shaped a little rabbit (her zodiac sign is the Ox, but she recently likes rabbit designs). The process was very relaxing. I photographed the piece and sent it to Su Ya. Su Ya replied: 'Great progress! Wait until you come to the studio to glaze it.' Afterward, I briefly reviewed my notes for the attending physician exam and went to bed at 11.

2025-05.daily_overview: I had planned to stay home on Saturday, but Wang Fang dragged me to a baking classroom, where I unexpectedly discovered the joy of handmade desserts. I came home with freshly baked croissants and madeleines and could not wait to share them with my parents. This new hobby adds sweetness to my high-pressure life.

events.name: Weekend lie-in and simple breakfast
events.description: I went to bed late last night and slept until 8 a.m. I had fried eggs and milk for breakfast. I had planned to read at home in the morning, but Wang Fang called at 10.

events.name: Wang Fang called and strongly invited her to a baking experience.
events.description: Wang Fang said excitedly on the phone, 'Xiaowen! There's a French dessert experience class this afternoon. The original price is 298 yuan, now 99 yuan. I grabbed two spots, and you have to come with me!' Yu Xiaowen initially declined, 'I don't know how to make them, and going would just waste the ingredients.' Wang Fang played her trump card: 'If you come with me, I'll cover a night shift for you next month!' Yu Xiaowen had no choice but to smile and agree.

events.name: Heading to the baking studio
events.description: At 12:30 noon, after a quick tidy-up, she took the subway under Wang Fang's guidance and arrived at the 'Sweet Time Baking Classroom' near Jianshe West Road in Zhongyuan District. Wang Fang was already waving at the door.

events.name: Hands-on French dessert class.
events.description: From 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., a dozen or so students gathered around a long table, and the teacher first demonstrated how to fold croissant dough. At first, Yu Xiaowen's technique was unfamiliar, and butter leaked everywhere. Wang Fang laughed at her, "Even a surgeon's hands shake!" But under the teacher's one-on-one guidance, she gradually found the rhythm and could not help but marvel as the layered pastry unfolded. The madeleine cake was relatively simpler; she mixed the batter with lemon zest and poured it into molds. When the buttery aroma came out of the oven, everyone in the room swallowed their saliva. When the baked goods came out, her croissants were crispy and flaky, and the madeleines had clear shell patterns. The teacher praised her for having talent. While packing up, a sense of achievement welled up in her heart, and she thought she could occasionally make these for her parents in the future.

events.name: Said goodbye to Wang Fang and brought desserts home
events.description: The class ended at 6 p.m. Wang Fang called her boyfriend to arrange dinner, while Yu Xiaowen took the subway home alone. Carefully protecting the pastries in the paper bag, she arranged the croissants and madeleines on a plate after getting home, took a nice photo, and sent it to the family group chat: 'I'll bring some for you to try tomorrow~' Her mother, Li Xiuying, replied instantly: 'Amazing! They look delicious.'

events.name: Evening exam preparation and rest
events.description: After washing off the flour, I opened the attending physician exam prep app and answered 50 questions, with about 70% accuracy. I felt unexpectedly relaxed today, so I went to bed at 10:30.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowen's carefully planned effort to help her mother settle into Zhengzhou worked. A walk in the park and shopping at the vegetable market made her mother more talkative. In the afternoon, she met editor Zhao Min at a book club, broadening her social circle. In the evening, she hurried home to give the desserts to her parents; the smiles of the whole family were the best reward.

events.name: Brought desserts to pick up her mother
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, she packed the croissants and madeleines she had made the night before into a fresh-keeping box and drove to her parents' community on Huayuan Road. As soon as she entered, her father was slowly walking around the living room holding the walker, and her mother was cooking porridge in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowen proudly took out the pastries. Her mother took a bite of the croissant, her eyes lighting up: "This is flakier than the bakery's!" Her father also finished a madeleine and squinted his eyes contentedly. Yu Xiaowen took the opportunity to suggest: "Mom, today let me take you around People's Park nicely. Last time at Zijingshan you said you wanted to see more places." Her mother gladly changed her shoes.

events.name: Took my mother to People's Park for in-depth teaching.
events.description: At 9 a.m., the mother and daughter walked 15 minutes to People's Park. Yu Xiaowen pointed at the rose garden and taught her mother to identify the varieties. Her mother had loved growing flowers in her youth, so she began to chatter: 'These pink roses look like the ones in Luoyang Wangcheng Park.' Yu Xiaowen had her take photos with her phone and post them to her newly registered WeChat Moments. When they reached the kiosk, she had her mother independently complete a WeChat Pay transaction to buy drinks. This time her mother was much nimbler. While resting in the pavilion, an auntie nearby who was looking after her grandson struck up a conversation. Yu Xiaowen proactively introduced her mother, and the two ended up chatting for 20 minutes, even adding each other on WeChat before parting. Her mother said happily, 'These Zhengzhou people are quite warm-hearted.'

events.name: Practiced buying groceries at the vegetable market
events.description: At 10:40, the two walked to the Renmin Road vegetable market. Yu Xiaowen took her mother to the stall she usually visited and taught her how to tell whether vegetables were fresh and how to bargain with mobile payments. Her mother bought a bunch of leafy greens and two jin of apples. The stall owner smiled and said, "Sister, next time if you bring cash, I'll accept that too." Her mother sighed, "Buying vegetables in the city is different from going to the market fair in our hometown." Yu Xiaowen thought to herself that she could bring her mother here once a week from now on.

events.name: After taking her mother home, she organized her reading notes
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., she took her mother back to her parents' home. As she was leaving, her mother held her hand and said, "Wenwen, I'm really happy today. Will you take me out again next week?" Yu Xiaowen nodded seriously. Then she returned home, had a simple lunch, picked up "Better" and her notebook, sorted out a few clinical insights and questions, and prepared for the afternoon reading club discussion.

events.name: Attend the book club under the plane tree.
events.description: At 2:30 p.m., she walked to the second floor of the 'Under the Wutong Tree' bookstore. This month's theme was 'The Doctor's Progress'. As a practitioner, she was the first to share a chapter from the book about facing medical uncertainty, combining it with the medication adjustment she had made in the ward yesterday, and she spoke very sincerely. A woman with glasses asked, 'As a doctor, how do you balance evidence-based practice and intuition?' After a brief thought, Yu Xiaowen answered and won applause.

events.name: Met book editor Zhao Min and expanded her network
events.description: After the reading club ended, the woman who had asked the question came over and introduced herself. Her name was Zhao Min, a medical book editor at a local publishing house. The two chatted for half an hour in the coffee area. Zhao Min recommended books such as *When Breath Becomes Air* and *Being Mortal*, and Yu Xiaowen was very interested. They added each other on WeChat. Zhao Min suggested bringing her own book to sign at the next reading club, and Yu Xiaowen happily agreed.

events.name: In the evening, returned to parents' home to share dessert.
events.description: At 6 p.m., she bought some fruit and went to her parents' house again. Her mother had already laid out the leftover desserts from yesterday, and Yu Xiaowen brought out the ones she had brought in the morning. The family ate and watched TV with tea. Her father said he wanted to go to the community rehabilitation center the next day to try the exercise bike, and Yu Xiaowen immediately checked the center's opening hours. At 8 p.m. she returned home, added the book title recommended by Zhao Min to her shopping cart, and then did some stretching before bed.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the new week, Yu Xiaowen did clinical rotations during the day and, after work, started the statistical analysis of her research data, taking a key step from database building to output.

events.name: Full of energy on Monday morning.
events.description: Woke up at 6:30 a.m., did 10 minutes of stretching, then had a simple breakfast. Found a WeChat message from Li Wei on her phone: 'Have you organized the database? Take some time this week to analyze it.' She replied: 'It's in progress, starting tonight.'

events.name: Full day at the hospital, also attending to research reminders.
events.description: In the morning, she joined Director Zhang Lei on grand rounds. Director Zhang noticed a cerebral infarction patient's rehabilitation progress and asked the young doctors how they managed follow-up data. Yu Xiaowen felt a stir in her heart—this was exactly the significance of building the database. During the lunch break, she saved the database path to the cloud to ensure she could open it smoothly after work. Because she was so focused on work, she forgot to do the midday neck and shoulder exercises, and in the afternoon she felt her right shoulder was slightly tight.

events.name: Started SPSS univariate analysis after work
events.description: She got home at 6 p.m., quickly boiled a bowl of dumplings and ate, then opened her computer and SPSS promptly at 7. She started with descriptive statistics: calculated the mean ± standard deviation of continuous variables such as age, length of hospital stay, and BI index, and created frequency distribution tables. Then she performed univariate association analyses (t-tests, chi-square tests) on possible prognostic factors, identifying several factors with P < 0.1, including age, time to rehabilitation intervention, and number of comorbidities. She recorded every step in detail, planning to verify with regression the next day. After two consecutive hours on the computer, her neck and shoulder stiffness intensified, so she stood up and did a 5-minute stretch.

events.name: Additional evening shoulder and neck care and rest
events.description: The analysis came to a pause at 9:30 PM, with her neck noticeably stiff. She did a 15-minute shoulder and neck relaxation with Keep, then applied a hot compress to her right shoulder. After showering, she went to bed at 10:30, reviewed today's statistics, and felt a bit excited but restrained herself to sleep early.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yu Xiaowen participated in multidisciplinary discussions during the day and continued advancing the statistical analysis in the evening. The multivariate regression results gradually became clear.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin and recovery
events.description: Got up at 6:30 in the morning. The neck and shoulder discomfort from yesterday had eased after a night's rest. While doing Baduanjin on the balcony, she especially strengthened the shoulder movements and felt much more relaxed.

events.name: Morning multidisciplinary consultation participation
events.description: At 10 a.m., the rehabilitation, neurology, and traditional Chinese medicine departments held a joint consultation for a complex stroke patient. As the recorder, Yu Xiaowen listened to the experts' discussion on the rehabilitation plan, once again felt the value of interdisciplinary collaboration, and quietly jotted down the names of several rehabilitation assessment scales.

events.name: Afternoon work and exchanges with the supervising teacher.
events.description: In the afternoon, Li Wei asked about the progress of the database, and Yu Xiaowen showed yesterday's univariate results. Li Wei suggested, 'When doing logistic regression, first put in the meaningful univariate variables, then adjust step by step.' She humbly accepted. At noon she seriously did neck and shoulder relaxation exercises, and her shoulders were no longer noticeably uncomfortable.

events.name: Perform multivariate logistic regression in the evening.
events.description: After dinner, she sat at the computer and entered the variables selected by univariate analysis—age, time to rehabilitation intervention, admission BI score, and number of comorbidities—into a binary logistic regression model. She operated SPSS step by step and obtained the coefficients, P values, OR values, and 95% CI. The results showed that early rehabilitation intervention (OR=2.3, P<0.05) and a high BI score at admission were independent protective factors for a good prognosis. After repeatedly checking collinearity and goodness of fit, she worked until 10:30, and the satisfactory results almost made her jump for joy.

events.name: Report preliminary results to Li Wei
events.description: At 10:35, she couldn't help but send a screenshot of the core results to Li Wei via WeChat, with the note: 'Dr. Li, these are the preliminary regression results. Please review them.' Li Wei quickly replied with a thumbs-up: 'Not bad. Let's take a look together tomorrow if you have time.'

events.name: Simple stretching before bed and drifted off to sleep feeling excited.
events.description: Before bed, she did 5 minutes of leg stretches. Lying in bed, her mind was still sorting through the data, but the excitement gradually turned into fatigue, and she fell asleep at 11 o'clock.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen finished up the statistical analysis and created the presentation PPT. In the evening, she played badminton with Lin Wei to relieve stress, but staying up late to modify the PPT caused her to be slightly sleep-deprived.

events.name: Morning work and statistical wrap-up
events.description: At 8 am, she brought last night's results to the hospital. After the morning handover, she used the department computer to conduct a sensitivity analysis on the model. The results remained robust after substituting several variables, which put her at ease. Then she exported the main results table and started building the presentation framework with PowerPoint.

events.name: Created the analysis results PPT
events.description: She skipped her noon break and quickly completed the PPT in the doctors' office: cover, background, methods, univariate results (tables), multivariable forest plot (exported from SPSS), conclusions, and limitations. The overall layout was clean and professional. She sent a copy to Li Wei and agreed to give the formal presentation tomorrow morning.

events.name: Routine afternoon work
events.description: After dealing with the medical orders this afternoon, I felt my head throbbing and decided to play ball in the evening to clear my head. I texted Lin Wei on WeChat: 'Are you free to play ball tonight?' Lin Wei replied instantly: 'Wednesday, definitely! Usual place!'

events.name: Evening badminton to release stress.
events.description: At 7 p.m., she played badminton with Lin Wei for a full hour at the gym. Her swings were powerful and she made several smashes. Lin Wei joked, "You're really fierce today." Yu Xiaowen laughed and said, "A research warrior." After playing, they went to the night market and had cold skin noodles. They chatted about amusing stories of students in Lin Wei's class having early romantic relationships, and laughed until their stomachs hurt.

events.name: After returning home, revised the PPT until late at night
events.description: It was almost 9:30 when she got home. After showering, she checked the PPT and found two incomplete labels on charts, so she opened the computer again to fix them and added the sensitivity analysis results. She repeatedly adjusted the formatting until it was perfect. When she looked at the clock, it was almost 0:30. She quickly washed up and went to bed, feeling somewhat drowsy.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yu Xiaowen successfully reported the statistical analysis to her mentor Li Wei, receiving high recognition and a suggestion to submit to the youth forum. This small research milestone greatly boosted her professional confidence, and in the evening she went to the pottery studio to glaze-fire her works as a self-reward.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin dispels drowsiness
events.description: Got up at 6:30 a.m. and still felt sleepy because she had not had enough sleep the night before. She practiced Baduanjin carefully on the balcony, and after deep breathing her energy gradually recovered.

events.name: Formally report to Li Wei.
events.description: At 10 a.m., in the department office, Yu Xiaowen gave a 15-minute presentation to Li Wei using a projector. She clearly explained database construction, univariate screening, logistic regression results, and clinical significance. Li Wei nodded as he listened. After she finished, he commented: 'The approach is very clear, and the results have clinical value. I suggest writing it into a case series abstract and submitting it to the hospital's young physicians' forum; the deadline happens to be next month.' Yu Xiaowen excitedly noted the suggestion.

events.name: Sharing the joy with colleagues Wang Fang and Wu Min
events.description: At noon in the cafeteria, she couldn't help telling Wang Fang and head nurse Wu Min about the report. Wang Fang shouted 'Treat us!', and Wu Min also smiled and said, 'The women in our department are getting stronger and stronger.' The three of them agreed to order milk tea delivery together in the evening.

events.name: Handling patients in the afternoon and organizing submission requirements
events.description: In the afternoon, while shadowing the doctor during clinic, she found time to search the hospital OA system for the youth forum submission template and deadline, downloaded an abstract template, and planned to start writing over the weekend.

events.name: After work, applying glaze at the pottery studio.
events.description: At 6 p.m., she arrived at Zheng Guodong's pottery studio with the previously handmade zodiac pony and rabbit. With Su Ya's help, she carefully applied celadon glaze to the bisque pieces. Su Ya praised her for being 'gifted' and agreed to create a zodiac series together next time. Yu Xiaowen looked at the pieces being placed into the kiln, full of anticipation.

events.name: Evening exam preparation and diary writing.
events.description: After returning home, reviewed the endocrinology section of internal medicine and noted on her phone: "May 29, completed my first independent data analysis! Maybe I really am suited for a path that combines research and clinical practice." Before bed, meditated for 10 minutes and went to sleep at 11 p.m.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Friday, Yu Xiaowen swapped her shift for the Dragon Boat Festival and attended the attending physician sprint course. After work, she went shopping with her mother for zongzi ingredients, making full preparations for tomorrow's family reunion.

events.name: Swap shifts to ensure time off for the Dragon Boat Festival.
events.description: At 6:50 a.m., she went to the hospital early, coordinated with colleagues, and swapped her Dragon Boat Festival day (Saturday) shift to next Wednesday, so she could stay at home with her parents. She sent the good news to the family group chat, and her mother said in a voice message: 'Great, we'll make zongzi tomorrow.'

events.name: Took leave to attend an intensive preparation course for the attending physician exam.
events.description: At 9 a.m., she asked her instructor Li Wei for half a day's leave. At 1 p.m., she arrived at the hospital training classroom to attend the sprint class organized by the Medical Affairs Department. A senior chief physician lectured on the key points of rehabilitation medicine and neurology. Yu Xiaowen sat in the front row, filled three full pages of notes, and highlighted confusing points such as 'Rehabilitation Assessment for Traumatic Brain Injury' with a highlighter.

events.name: Exchanging exam preparation strategies with colleagues.
events.description: During the break, Yu Xiaowen exchanged notes with colleagues such as Wang Fang, and they found that both sides had omissions, so they supplemented each other's notes. Wang Fang said, ‘You've already finished your research, so the attending physician title should be no problem.’ Yu Xiaowen smiled wryly and said, ‘I'm still far from it.’

events.name: After work, buy zongzi ingredients with her mother
events.description: At 5 p.m., she got off work and drove directly to pick up her mother. The mother and daughter went to the farmers' market in Jinshui District and bought round glutinous rice, candied dates, red beans, fresh reed leaves, and cotton string. Her mother taught her how to choose broad, pliable reed leaves, and Yu Xiaowen noted it all down. They also bought some mugwort to hang on the door for the Dragon Boat Festival.

events.name: In the evening, went home and had a casual video chat with her older brother.
events.description: After dinner, her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng video-called to ask about their father's condition and Xiaowen's exam preparation. Xiaowen said Dad was recovering well and the whole family would make zongzi tomorrow. Xiaofeng said enviously, "I can't come back for Dragon Boat Festival, so send me lots of photos." After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen mentally rehearsed the zongzi-making process for the next day, then read a bit more of the later chapters of Better, and went to sleep at 11 p.m.

2025-05.daily_overview: During the Dragon Boat Festival, Yu Xiaowen first hung mugwort at her own home, then went to her parents' residence on Huayuan Road to make and cook zongzi together. The long-missed traditional ritual filled the kitchen. Her father's calm guidance and her mother's smile made the home once again radiate the taste of happiness.

events.name: Morning Baduanjin on the balcony and hanging mugwort at home.
events.description: Got up at 7 a.m. at home on Jingsan Road. First did 10 minutes of Baduanjin on the balcony and felt light. Then hung the mugwort I bought yesterday on my front door. After that, I went to my parents' place on Huayuan Road.

events.name: Go to parents' home to hang mugwort and prepare to wrap zongzi.
events.description: After arriving at my parents' home on Huayuan Road, I first helped hang mugwort at the door. My mother had already rinsed and soaked the glutinous rice, and the red dates were washed too. I made tea for my father; he sat in his wheelchair watching them busy, with a smile at the corner of his mouth.

events.name: The whole family pitched in to make zongzi
events.description: At 10 a.m., she laid out the bamboo leaves and glutinous rice on the tea table. When she tried to wrap the first sticky rice dumpling, the rice spilled all over the table. Her father couldn't bear to watch and told her to bring the leaves over: 'Watch me. First fold this corner, press the rice down firmly, and tie the string with a slipknot.' Although his hands were not very dexterous, he demonstrated slowly, and Yu Xiaowen learned seriously while her mother helped on the side. After several attempts, she finally made neatly shaped sticky rice dumplings with distinct corners. As the three chatted and laughed, they wrapped more than thirty in total, with fillings of candied dates and red beans.

events.name: Cooked zongzi; the whole room was filled with a fragrant smell.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Mother put the zongzi into a large pot, added water to cover them, brought to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat to simmer slowly. Yu Xiaowen and her father watched the Dragon Boat Festival gala in the living room for a while, and her father talked about interesting stories of spending Dragon Boat Festival in Luoyang when he was young. At 5 p.m., the fragrance of zongzi leaves wafted from the pot. Mother lifted the lid, and the steaming zongzi were all plump.

events.name: Enjoying zongzi and a heartwarming dinner
events.description: For dinner, the family sat together unwrapping zongzi and dipping them in sugar. Mother took a bite, her eyes curving into crescents: "This is the taste, just like in Luoyang." Father nodded too. Yu Xiaowen sent a video to her brother; Xiaofeng, eating frozen zongzi in Shenzhen, said enviously, "Home is still the best." After dinner, Yu Xiaowen and her mother cleared the table and packed the extra zongzi into portions for freezing.

events.name: Watching the sunset and reviewing together in the evening.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen pushed her father for a walk in the residential compound, while her mother followed beside them. The sunset was orange-red. Her father suddenly said, 'Wen, these days have been hard on you.' Yu Xiaowen's nose tingled. 'Dad, as long as you are well, it's not hard.' She reflected that from the day her father collapsed until now, the family had stumbled along but grown more and more united.

events.name: Back home, preparing for the exam before bed and planning the next day.
events.description: In the evening, returned home on Jingsan Road. Thinking that June would arrive in two days, I felt the new month deserved new plans. In my diary I wrote: 'June plans: 1. Complete the forum abstract; 2. Apply for the rehabilitation department rotation; 3. Bake once a week.' Then I meditated for 10 minutes, listened to a short piece of classical music, opened the question bank and worked through 20 attending physician questions, and went to bed at 0:15.

She confirmed the package was intact.

events.name: Browsed the printed version of the paper
events.description: Yu Xiaowen opened the sample issue package, flipped through the printed copy of her paper page by page, checked the figure and table layouts and the reference format, and confirmed that the content was printed correctly. A sense of academic confidence welled up inside her.

events.name: Sharing the good news of being published
events.description: Yu Xiaowen used her phone to photograph the cover of the sample issue and the first page of the paper, then sent the photos via WeChat to her supervising instructor Li Wei and her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, with a message thanking them for their guidance and support and sharing the joy of the paper being officially published.

events.name: Archive the sample journal and record the research cycle
events.description: Yu Xiaowen properly filed the sample journal in the reference folder on her desk, and recorded in her personal work log the completion of her first complete research cycle, from case collection and data analysis to the acceptance of the revised manuscript, noting the direction for next-step research improvement.

events.name: Selected as the young physician representative for the hospital anniversary celebration.
events.description: At the rehabilitation department morning meeting, department director Zhang Lei officially announced that, due to her outstanding performance in balancing family and career over the past year, Yu Xiaowen had been selected by the hospital as the young physician representative for the 65th anniversary celebration, and she needed to prepare a speech of about five minutes. She felt both surprised and responsible, accepted the task immediately, and began to think about the main thread of her speech.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, rested at home. In the afternoon, received the disappointing news that college classmate Zhou Haoran's fund application had failed. Offered support with content from 'Better' and sincere encouragement; a research friendship that grew from classmates into comrades who trust each other.

events.name: Received a dejected message from Zhou Haoran.
events.description: In the evening, while resting at her home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen received a WeChat message from her college classmate Zhou Haoran in Beijing, telling her that his application for the 2025 Young Scientists Fund of the National Natural Science Foundation of China had not been approved, and the message showed obvious disappointment. Yu Xiaowen immediately put down the pottery magazine in her hand and thought about how to comfort this old classmate who was far away.

events.name: Selected the encouraging chapter from Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen took "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance" from the bookshelf, turned to the last chapter, and reread page by page the content about persistence and growth, believing these words could precisely inspire Zhou Haoran. She used her phone camera to take clear photos of each page and decided to give it as a comforting gift.

events.name: Send an encouraging message and photos of books.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen sent the photos she had taken to Zhou Haoran one by one via WeChat, with a message: 'Progress lies not only in one successful bid, but in every choice to keep going.' She hoped this gesture would convey her belief in persisting together on the research path and let Zhou Haoran feel the support of a comrade from afar.

events.name: Received a reply from Zhou Haoran; the friendship deepened.
events.description: A few minutes later, Zhou Haoran replied on WeChat: "Thanks, you are mentally much stronger than last year." This simple reply made Yu Xiaowen feel gratified. The tacit understanding between them of supporting each other and growing together on the academic path deepened further, and their relationship evolved from ordinary classmates into trusted research comrades, and they agreed to collaborate in the future.

events.name: Organize winter clothes at home
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen used her free Sunday time to organize the wardrobe. She took out transitional autumn-winter clothes to air, put away thin garments, prepared for the upcoming low temperatures, and also sorted out some old clothes she no longer wore for donation.

events.name: Early morning jog along the river
events.description: Yu Xiaowen left home at 6:40 and did a 30-minute aerobic jog along the Jinshui River. Her pace was steady at 7 min/km. After running, she stretched and drank warm water. She recorded the running data and noticed that after her anemia improved, her endurance had increased and muscle soreness had eased.

events.name: Dietary assessment and adjustment during the lunch break
events.description: During her lunch break on November 3, Yu Xiaowen used her phone's memo app in the rest area of the hospital's rehabilitation department to conduct a two-week diet assessment. Comparing with the records from two weeks ago, she found that her energy levels were noticeably more stable and her nail color was healthier. Based on how she felt, she decided to change the pork liver in her lunch from daily to every other day, and to add more soy products and mushrooms to diversify her nutrient sources. That day, she still followed the new plan for breakfast and lunch and took iron supplements, and reminded herself to buy more iron supplements at the pharmacy on the weekend.

events.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen returned to the study at her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. She opened her laptop and logged in to the ACE official website, carefully browsed the details of the Health Coach Certification Course, confirmed the course fee (about 6,000 yuan) and exam requirements, and then completed online registration and paid the tuition. After successful registration, she immediately downloaded the course syllabus, electronic textbooks, and study guide. She also set up her course platform account and joined the student community, planning her weekly study time.

events.name: Evening dinner with parents.
events.description: After she finished registering, Yu Xiaowen had dinner with her parents. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had made her favorite sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and braised noodles. During the meal, they talked about her father's recent rehabilitation training. Yu Xiaowen mentioned that she had signed up for an exercise and health course, and her parents expressed their support.

events.description: On the morning of her rotating day off, Yu Xiaowen edited a Moments post at home, sharing photos from her speech and her personal reflections, thanking the hospital for the opportunity and her parents for their company. Many colleagues and friends (Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, Wang Fang, etc.) liked and commented, and she replied to each one, feeling happy.

events.name: Autumn City Walk along the Jinshui River
events.description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowen went for a walk alone along the Jinshui River trail. She enjoyed the autumn leaves and listened to classical music to relax. While walking, she reflected on her multiple recent goals and felt that life was fulfilling but stressful; after the walk, she felt much calmer.

events.name: Father suddenly expressed his intention to return to Luoyang.
events.description: On the evening of November 9, 2025, after doing rehabilitation exercises in the living room, her father Yu Jianguo suddenly told his daughter Yu Xiaowen and his wife that he wanted to return to his hometown in Luoyang to live, saying he was used to the environment and old friends in Luoyang. Her mother Li Xiuying also agreed, feeling that living in Luoyang was more comfortable. Yu Xiaowen was very alarmed, worrying inside that if her parents left, she would be living alone in Zhengzhou and could not balance work and exam preparation, and did not know how to respond for a moment.

events.name: Have an urgent video consultation with my brother.
events.description: That evening, Yu Xiaowen returned to her room and had a video call via WeChat with her brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was far away in Shenzhen. She explained in detail how her parents wanted to return to Luoyang, expressing her anxiety and her need for their help. Her brother Yu Xiaofeng said he understood that their parents were used to the living environment in their hometown, suggested respecting the elders' wishes, and also comforted his sister not to worry.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yu Xiaowen visited her parents in her hometown Luoyang in the early morning and led her father in Baduanjin exercises, simple and warm. In the morning, after guiding her father through stretching, they enjoyed a hearty lunch cooked by her mother. In the afternoon, on the way back to Zhengzhou, the car got a flat tire; fortunately, timely rescue meant she did not miss the evening concert. The Beethoven special performance deeply moved her, and she savored it late into the night.

events.name: Return to my hometown in Luoyang to visit my parents.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, drove off and arrived at the hometown home in Xigong District, Luoyang at 9:00. Her parents had already been staying in Luoyang for a few days to handle the follow-up matters of renting out the old house. Her father was practicing in the old house courtyard with a walker, and her mother was preparing a hearty lunch in the kitchen. Xiaowen hugged her parents and gave them Zhengzhou's specialty pork floss cakes.

events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowen laid out a yoga mat in the living room and led her father in a simplified version of Baduanjin. Her father could only follow the first half, but he was very interested in the breathing coordination. Xiaowen encouraged him to practice every day.

events.name: Guided father through stretching exercises.

After the meal, Xiaowen helped wash the dishes, and mother reminded her to take care of herself.

events.description: At 14:00 she started the return trip. Before entering the highway, the right rear tire pressure alarm went off. She pulled over and found a nail stuck in the tire. She contacted insurance roadside assistance and, after waiting 45 minutes, changed to the spare tire. She arrived home in Zhengzhou at 16:30. Grateful that there was still enough time, she took a shower and changed into a dress.

events.name: Enjoying a Beethoven special concert.
events.description: At 19:30 in the evening, in the concert hall of the Henan Art Center, she enjoyed the Zhengzhou Philharmonic Orchestra performing Beethoven's works. The Coriolan Overture and the Eroica Symphony stirred her emotions. During the slow movement, she thought of the patients working hard to recover, and her eyes became slightly moist. After the performance, she applauded for a long time, feeling her body and mind cleansed by the music.

events.name: Going home to savor and record.
events.description: I drove home at 10:00 p.m., and at 11:00 p.m. lay in bed still savoring it, wrote in the phone memo: Life itself is a hero, and posted it on Moments with photos.

events.name: Hospital follow-up for blood routine test and anemia correction.
events.description: At 13:00, she returned to Zhengzhou Central Hospital for a blood draw. At 15:00, her phone received the report: hemoglobin 120g/L. She consulted the doctor, who confirmed that the anemia had been corrected and that she could stop the iron supplements and continue with dietary management. Delighted, she sent a screenshot of the report to Zhang Jing and updated her health goal to 'maintenance phase'.

events.name: Integrating anemia improvement experience into patient education.
events.description: At 16:00, while the idea was fresh, I made a simple PPT titled "Anemia Diet Adjustment Tips" and planned to present it in the department next month. I tucked the blood test report into my notebook to motivate myself.

events.name: Massage chair delivery and installation (remote supervision)
events.description: At 17:00, the delivery was sent to the parents' home in Luoyang. Yu Xiaowen supervised the installation worker remotely via WeChat video, watching him unbox and assemble it. At 17:30 the installation was complete. Her mother was the first to sit and try it, and then her father experienced the waist and back heat therapy, repeatedly praising how comfortable it was. On her side of the screen, she smiled so much her eyes narrowed into slits.

events.name: Remotely accompany parents while they use the massage chair and have dinner.
events.description: At 19:00 in the evening, she video-called her parents. Her mother pointed the camera at her father, who was enjoying the massage, and her father hummed a Henan opera tune while her mother guided the buttons. Xiaowen watched while eating takeaway braised noodles and felt happier than if she were using it herself. She told her mother to have her father use it for 15 minutes every day to relax his muscles.

events.name: Monthly Summary and New Month Plan
events.description: At 21:00 in the evening, I opened the monthly review notebook at my desk and wrote down November's gains: anemia corrected, critical illness insurance arranged, massage chair to show filial piety, thesis started, training completed successfully. Then I listed December priorities: advance the thesis draft, prepare for the exam as planned, and complete the zodiac ceramic plate. I closed the notebook, full of expectation for December.

2025-01.daily_overview: During the New Year holiday, Yu Xiaowen had a New Year's Eve dinner with her best friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue that lasted until the early morning. After a short sleep, she got up to handle the rent and keep accounts. In the afternoon she went to the community cultural center to learn about a pottery interest class, taking the first step toward her New Year goals.

events.name: New Year's Eve dinner and New Year's goal sharing
events.description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowen's rental apartment on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, was full of lively atmosphere. She and her close friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue sat around the dining table, enjoying homemade spicy soup and braised noodles. As they clinked glasses, Xiaowen announced her goal for this year — systematically learning pottery, hoping to make decent works by the end of the year. Zhang Jing and Sun Yue applauded and agreed to come at year-end to see her achievement exhibition.

events.name: Pay rent and interact with the landlord
events.description: At 9 a.m., the first thing Yu Xiaowen did after getting up was to transfer 2,000 yuan to her landlord Song Yumei via WeChat, with the note “January rent”. Shortly after, Aunt Song replied with a smiley emoji and a voice message reminding her to keep warm in the cold weather. Yu Xiaowen typed back, “Thank you, Auntie, Happy New Year”.

events.name: Bookkeeping and budget review
events.description: After transferring the rent, she opened the Suishouji app on her phone and recorded this 2,000 yuan expense under the 'Housing' category, then checked the remaining budget for the month to confirm that other expenses such as food and transportation would not be affected.

events.name: Video call with parents to celebrate the New Year
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her parents and exchanged New Year greetings. Her mother, Li Xiuying, specially showed the Luoyang braised noodles she had just made, and her father, Yu Jianguo, asked about her plans for learning pottery and suggested that she record the learning process.

events.name: Visit to the pottery studio
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowen walked alone to the "Between the Clay" pottery studio on the first floor of the Jinshui District Community Cultural Center. Through the glass door, she saw student works displayed inside and felt drawn to them. The front-desk staff warmly introduced her to the beginner course: every Thursday at 7 p.m. and Saturday at 9 a.m., a total of four sessions, tuition 800 yuan including materials. She took a course schedule and returned satisfied.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first working day after the holiday, Yu Xiaowen quickly got into work mode and dealt with the backlog of medical records. Her colleague Wang Fang shared her engagement news and invited her to be a bridesmaid. In the evening, she went to the pottery studio, officially registered for the introductory class, and attended her first lesson. After returning home, she shared her joy with her best friend.

events.name: Post-holiday morning meeting and ward rounds
events.description: At 7:50 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the department early and changed into her white coat. At exactly 8 o'clock, all the medical staff held the morning handover meeting in the office, where the night-shift nurse reported in detail on the patients' condition changes during the holiday. After the meeting, she followed her mentor Li Wei on ward rounds, focusing on recording the vital signs and medication adjustments of several critically ill patients.

events.name: Wang Fang shares engagement news
events.description: After the morning ward rounds, everyone took a short break in the rest area. Wang Fang beamed as she took out her phone to show photos of the proposal scene her fiancé had carefully set up on New Year's Eve — on the table were candles, roses, and a diamond ring. She vividly described how she had gone from surprise to tears of emotion, and her colleagues gave her hugs and congratulations one after another. Yu Xiaowen also clapped and smiled.

events.name: Wang Fang privately asked her to be a bridesmaid
events.description: During the lunch break, Wang Fang pulled Yu Xiaowen to a quiet corner at the end of the corridor and mysteriously said that wedding preparations had started, the wedding date was initially set for October, the exact day was still being discussed, and she solemnly invited her to be a bridesmaid. Xiaowen first widened her eyes in surprise, then her eyes reddened slightly, and she nodded vigorously, saying "Of course I'm willing!" The two agreed to go try on dresses after the date was confirmed.

events.name: Catching up on medical records backlogged during the holiday
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk, opened the electronic medical record system, and completed the information for the two patients newly admitted during the New Year's Day holiday, including detailed admission records, the initial progress notes, and the related informed consent forms. She then handled three discharge summaries and was busy until 5:30.

events.name: Pottery course registration
events.description: After work, Yu Xiaowen drove directly to the 'Between Clay' studio. At the front desk, she filled out the registration form, paid 800 yuan in tuition via WeChat Pay, and received a basic tool kit (containing a wooden scraper, a sponge, clay-cutting wire, etc.). At that moment, a round-faced girl named Su Ya, who had also come to sign up, greeted her. They chatted for a while and realized they were both in the medical field (Su Ya is a pharmacist), so they agreed to meet at Thursday's class.

events.name: First pottery class: kneading clay and shaping a bowl
events.description: At 7 p.m., the class started on time. Teacher Zheng Guodong demonstrated the correct method for kneading clay—chrysanthemum kneading—and then had everyone try it. Yu Xiaowen placed the clay on the worktable. At first, she could not knead it evenly, but after the teacher personally corrected her, she gradually got better. In the second half of the class, everyone began shaping small bowls. Following the diagram, she pressed the clay ball into a bowl shape. Although the bottom was a bit thick, it still held its shape. At the end of class, she left her piece on the shelf to dry in the shade. Su Ya passed by, gave a thumbs up, and said, "Not bad!"

events.name: Had a video call with my best friend to share what I had seen and heard.
events.description: It was already 9:30 when she got home. After washing up briefly, Yu Xiaowen lay on the bed and answered Zhang Jing's WeChat video call. She propped her phone against the headboard and vividly described the news that Wang Fang had invited her to be a bridesmaid, then showed off her selfies covered in mud. Zhang Jing joked, 'Your life has suddenly become so colorful—first pottery, now being a bridesmaid.' The two chatted until their phones got hot before hanging up.
