events.name: Checked cross-region medical insurance reimbursement and organized the expense lists
events.description: On January 18, 2025, in her father Yu Jianguo's ward at Luoyang Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used her phone browser during breaks from caregiving to look up Henan Province's cross-region medical insurance reimbursement policy, while also organizing the daily cost statements issued by Luoyang Central Hospital since her father's admission. She categorized medication, examination, and treatment costs in the memo app on her phone, circled several items with uncertain self-payment ratios, and planned to consult the hospital's medical insurance office.

events.name: Called the hospital's medical insurance office for a consultation.
events.description: On January 18, 2025, after checking the policy, Yu Xiaowen contacted the medical insurance office of Luoyang Central Hospital by phone to ask about the specific procedure, required materials, and precautions for her father Yu Jianguo's out-of-town medical insurance reimbursement. The staff told her that she needed to prepare the complete set of originals and copies of the ID card, social security card, diagnosis certificate, expense invoices, and so on, and suggested printing the medical insurance settlement form at the window upon discharge. Yu Xiaowen wrote everything down and listed the materials in the small notebook at hand.

events.name: Completed the first reading notes and received the commemorative coin brought by my mother.
events.description: On January 18, 2025, while accompanying her father in the ward, Yu Xiaowen finished writing her first reading notes on Better, capturing her thoughts on the opening chapter and focusing on recording the framework of the five steps to becoming a better doctor, then reflecting on the dual pressure of patients and family she was currently facing. That same morning, her mother, Li Xiuying, brought from Luoyang the zodiac commemorative coin collection box that Yu Xiaowen had collected as a child. Xiaowen opened the box, saw the familiar coins, and recalled the warm childhood times of collecting and exchanging commemorative coins with her family, feeling warm inside. She took out the Year of the Ox coin for her own zodiac sign and placed it on her father's bedside table, hoping to bring him good luck.

events.name: Lower back discomfort worsened; tried stretching.
events.description: In the evening, after sitting for a long time, Yu Xiaowen's lower back soreness became increasingly noticeable. Taking advantage of her father's brief sleep, she did 10 minutes of lower back stretches and cat-cow poses on the yoga mat borrowed from the nurses' station in the corner of the ward, which slightly relieved the soreness. She realized she must pay attention to her body's signals and decided to make time for simple stretches every day.

start_state.location: On the caregiver bed in the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital
start_state.mood: A sense of responsibility drove away part of the fatigue.

end_state.location: On the caregiver chair in the hospital ward at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Felt warm and moved by childhood memories, but lower back discomfort persists.

state.daily_exercise: 10-minute lower back stretch

2025-01.daily_overview: From early Sunday morning, Yu Xiaowen anxiously waited for her brother to arrive. He finally arrived in the morning, and the family gathered together in the ward. In the evening, she returned home with her mother to rest, finally getting a bit of breathing room, but her heart was still with the hospital. After getting home, she insisted on doing stretching, and her lower back recovered a little.

events.name: Pay the hospitalization advance deposit via online banking.
events.description: Early on the morning of January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen used the mobile banking app on her phone to transfer 5,000 yuan from her own savings account to pay the hospitalization deposit for her father Yu Jianguo at Luoyang Central Hospital. She deliberately paid a bit extra to ensure that treatment costs for the next few days would not be interrupted, and recorded the expense in the family WeChat group.

events.name: Organizing reimbursement receipts with her mother
events.description: After breakfast on January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying sorted out all the expense receipts, diagnosis certificates, ID cards, social security cards, and other documents from her father Yu Jianguo's hospitalization in the ward. They categorized and bagged them according to the requirements of the medical insurance office. Yu Xiaowen checked the completeness and amounts of the receipts, while her mother folded photocopies of the documents. The two worked in close coordination.

events.name: Stayed by father's side from the early hours of the morning to late morning, waiting for older brother to arrive
events.description: From the early morning to the late morning of January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaowen stayed by her hospitalized father Yu Jianguo's bedside in the ward of Luoyang Central Hospital. Her mother Li Xiuying was also there. The three talked intermittently; her father was conscious but could not speak much. Yu Xiaowen kept checking her phone, anxiously waiting for news from her brother Yu Xiaofeng. She both wished her brother would come soon to share the burden and worried about him making the trip.

events.name: Brother Yu Xiaofeng urgently returned to Luoyang.
events.description: On the morning of January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaofeng took the earliest flight from Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport to Luoyang Beijiao Airport, then took a taxi to Luoyang Central Hospital. Because heavy snow in Zhengzhou had delayed the high-speed rail in the previous days, he changed to a flight at short notice and, after a grueling journey, finally made it to the ward.

events.name: The siblings clasped hands tightly, reunited as a family.
events.description: At about 10 am on January 19, 2025, Yu Xiaofeng arrived at the ward of Luoyang Central Hospital, travel-worn. When he saw his father, Yu Jianguo, weak but conscious, his eyes immediately reddened. He and his younger sister Yu Xiaowen held each other's hands tightly, and their mother Li Xiuying also quickly came over. The family of four had a brief reunion and talked. Yu Xiaowen briefly explained to her brother what had happened over the past few days and the doctor's treatment plan. The three of them agreed that her brother would take the night shift, so Xiaowen and her mother could go home and rest.

events.name: Returned home with her mother in the evening to rest and stretch
events.description: On the evening of January 19, 2025, her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng asked Yu Xiaowen to go home and rest, while he stayed overnight to accompany their father. Yu Xiaowen left the ward with her mother Li Xiuying, repeatedly reminding her brother to keep an eye on their father's nighttime IV drip and blood pressure measurement times. Then she and her mother took the bus back to her parents' home in Luoyang (No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District). After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen quickly cooked some noodles, ate with her mother, then took out a yoga mat and did 15 minutes of waist, neck, and shoulder stretches in the living room, feeling much more relaxed. Afterward, she packed up the luggage she had brought from Zhengzhou.

start_state.location: On the caregiver bed in the ward at Luoyang Central Hospital
start_state.mood: Anxious waiting; exhausted but afraid to close one's eyes

end_state.location: In her own bedroom at her parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Felt relieved by my brother's arrival, but still concerned about the hospital.

state.daily_exercise: 15-minute stretching

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Yu Xiaowen remotely added Spring Festival decorations to the old house in Luoyang, and received care from her pottery teacher, took the initiative to take on family financial responsibilities, and prepared for home rehabilitation. At noon, she video-called her close friend Zhang Jing and vented her feelings, which soothed her emotions.

events.name: Bought Spring Festival decorations online and asked Aunt Zhao to receive the package for her.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen, while taking care of her father, browsed and ordered traditional Spring Festival decorations such as Spring Festival couplets, lucky character posters, and red lanterns on Taobao via her phone. The delivery address was set to her hometown in Luoyang (42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province). After placing the order, she immediately called Aunt Zhao Xiulan, her mother's close friend who lived nearby, and explained that she had bought Spring Festival decorations for her hometown and the package would arrive in 2-3 days, asking Aunt Zhao to help receive the package and, after receiving it, to help put them up on the front door and in the living room of the old house to create a festive atmosphere. Aunt Zhao readily agreed and comforted Xiaowen to take good care of her father.

events.name: Check the receipts and explain the reimbursement steps
events.description: On the afternoon of January 20, 2025, Yu Xiaowen rechecked the sorted receipts and documents list, and after confirming nothing was missing, put them in a transparent document bag for safekeeping. She took out the reimbursement flow chart she had written and explained in detail to her mother the steps and schedule for the subsequent formal reimbursement: first complete the discharge settlement, get the medical insurance settlement statement, and then submit the materials to the Luoyang Social Security Center. Her mother visibly sighed with relief and repeatedly praised her daughter for being capable.

events.name: Received a caring message from pottery teacher Zheng Guodong.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen received a WeChat message from Zheng Guodong, her pottery class teacher. Having heard that Xiaowen had family matters to attend to, Master Zheng sent his regards, telling her to focus on taking care of her father, and promised she could make up the class after returning to Zhengzhou. He also sent a few photos of recent student works to cheer her up. Yu Xiaowen was moved, replied with gratitude, and said she would resume the class as soon as possible. The teacher-student relationship gained a touch of human warmth from this concern.

events.name: Video call with best friend Zhang Jing to pour out her feelings.
events.description: During the short break after lunch, Yu Xiaowen made a video call to her best friend Zhang Jing. Zhang Jing was at her home in Zhengzhou, munching on an apple while listening to Xiaowen talk about her father's illness and the pressure of these past few days. Zhang Jing shared some amusing anecdotes from outside the hospital, which made Xiaowen smile for the first time in days, and suggested she set aside at least ten minutes each day to decompress. After hanging up, Xiaowen felt much lighter.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Energy has recovered somewhat, driven by a sense of responsibility.

end_state.location: On the caregiver chair in the hospital ward at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Calm and fulfilled, feeling supported from many sides.

state.daily_exercise: No significant exercise.

2025-01.daily_overview: Father is getting better day by day. Yu Xiaowen divided the work and cooperated with her brother. She used the rotating rest time to continue reading and began recording clinical thoughts, gradually turning anxiety into motivation for learning. Waist stretching became a daily habit, and her symptoms were alleviated.

events.name: Together with her brother, she learned about the treatment plan from the doctor.
events.description: On the morning of January 21, 2025, Yu Xiaowen and her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng went to the attending physician's office together to learn in detail about their father's next treatment plan and rehabilitation precautions. The doctor said their father's nervous system was recovering well and he was expected to be discharged after a few more days of observation, but he needed to adhere to secondary prevention medication and early rehabilitation training. Yu Xiaowen carefully wrote down the method for taking antiplatelet drugs and the basic movements of rehabilitation training.

events.name: Reading in the ward and reflecting on clinical comparisons.
events.description: In the afternoon, her older brother volunteered to stay and look after their father, so Yu Xiaowen went home to rest. But she only went back to take a shower and then returned to the hospital. While her brother was accompanying their father, she sat on a chair in the corner of the ward and continued reading Chapter 3, 'Empathy in Diagnosis and Treatment,' of Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance. When she read the case in the book, she thought of how the doctor had communicated with her father today and used her phone's memo app to record her comparative reflections: how to balance honesty and hope when conveying a diagnosis.

events.name: Softly reminiscing about the past with her father.
events.description: In the evening, her father was in relatively good spirits. Yu Xiaowen sat by the bed and softly talked with him about the amusing story of falling down while learning to ride a bicycle as a child. Her father listened attentively, a faint smile appearing at the corners of his mouth. The brief exchange made the air in the ward softer. Yu Xiaowen felt that although her father was ill, the things deep in his memory were still a bridge connecting them.

events.name: Keep doing waist stretches.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen did another 15 minutes of lower back stretching and bird-dog exercises before bed, including side waist stretches and bridges. Since her father fell ill, she had been neglecting her own body; after sticking with it for these two days, the soreness in her lower back had noticeably eased, and she decided to keep this habit.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: A little relieved, but still tense.

end_state.location: On the caregiver chair in the hospital ward at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Gain strength through communication and reading.

state.daily_exercise: Walk about 3,000 steps inside the hospital; 15 minutes of stretching

2025-01.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen finalized the makeup lesson with her pottery teacher after the holiday, and began learning to make nutritious liquid food to prepare for her father's home rehabilitation diet. The waist recovery plan continued, and she felt her physical condition gradually returning to normal.

events.name: Arranged a make-up lesson with pottery teacher Zheng Guodong.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen further communicated with her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong via WeChat. Teacher Zheng learned about her schedule in detail, suggested adding a one-on-one make-up class every Saturday morning after the holiday, and assigned her the preparation task of watching three clay modeling instructional videos. Yu Xiaowen happily agreed and thanked the teacher for the flexible arrangement. She saved the teaching videos to her phone, planning to watch one in the evening to relieve stress.

events.name: Learning to make nutritious liquid food with her mother
events.description: Back home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying prepared her father's liquid food in the kitchen. Her mother taught her to steam yam, lean meat, and carrots, put them into a food processor to make a paste, and add a little protein powder for extra nutrition. Yu Xiaowen carefully noted the proportions and also used her phone to search for dietary precautions for cerebral infarction patients, writing a reminder on the kitchen blackboard to avoid high-fat and high-salt foods. The mother and daughter worked together at the stove in a warm and efficient way.

events.name: Balcony stretching and meditation
events.description: After tidying up the kitchen, Yu Xiaowen laid out her yoga mat on the balcony and did 20 minutes of full-body stretching, including neck, shoulders, waist, and legs. Afterward, she sat cross-legged in silence for 5 minutes, listening to the occasional sound of vehicles outside the window, and her thoughts gradually calmed. This was a little recovery time she carved out for herself.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Feeling reassured by stability

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Gained confidence in home rehabilitation

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute stretch

2025-01.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yu Xiaowen, amid busy caregiving, kept in touch with her work circle and actively searched for rehabilitation literature, integrating her duty as a doctor into family care. Her lower back pain flared up again, so she increased heat compresses and stretching.

events.name: Communicated with colleague Wang Fang on WeChat about recent developments in the department.
events.description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowen received a WeChat message from her close colleague Wang Fang, who asked about her father's recovery and shared the department's fun moments and personnel changes over the past week. Wang Fang also passed on greetings from supervising teacher Li Wei. Yu Xiaowen replied with thanks and briefly exchanged updates. She learned that the beds she was responsible for were currently being managed by Liu Qiang on her behalf, which made her feel a bit apologetic but also touched by her colleagues' consideration.

events.name: Search for literature on rehabilitation after cerebral infarction
events.description: During a break in the afternoon caregiving, Yu Xiaowen got permission from the nurses' station, used the hospital's public computer to log into the medical database, searched recent literature using the keywords 'early rehabilitation of ischemic stroke' and 'home-based rehabilitation training', and selected three high-quality guidelines and reviews. She copied the abstracts into her phone's memo, planning to read them carefully in the evening and draft a home rehabilitation plan based on her father's condition.

events.name: Recurrent lower back pain; increased heat application and stretching.
events.description: Having sat for a long time today, Yu Xiaowen's lower back soreness worsened again. She borrowed a hot water bottle from the nurse station, applied heat to her lumbosacral area on the companion chair for 20 minutes, and then did a set of lower back stretches. She recorded the pain level in her phone notes and decided that starting tomorrow she would shorten continuous sitting time and get up to move around every 40 minutes.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Fulfilling and regular.

end_state.location: On the caregiver chair in the hospital ward at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Feeling assured by professional contributions, but with lower back discomfort

state.daily_exercise: Hot compress and stretching several times; no dedicated exercise.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Friday, Yu Xiaowen learned rehabilitation training techniques, helped her father with bedside activities, and in the evening also sorted clothes with her mother. By incorporating stretching and activity into daily life, her lower back condition improved.

events.name: Learned and assisted father with bedside rehabilitation exercises
events.description: In the morning, a rehabilitation therapist came to the ward to guide her father through his first bedside training. Yu Xiaowen watched closely and learned passive range-of-motion techniques. Under the therapist's guidance, she helped her father perform flexion, extension, and rotation of the upper limbs and ankles, 15 repetitions for each movement. Her father was somewhat resistant at first, but gradually cooperated with his daughter's encouragement. When it was finished, a fine sweat appeared on his forehead. Yu Xiaowen used her phone to record the training time and movements, planning to make a simple rehabilitation log.

events.name: Sorted out a change of clothes with my mother.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen and her mother, Li Xiuying, returned home and together sorted out the clothes her father would need to change into while in the hospital. From the wardrobe, they picked out a few loose, soft cotton pajamas, and found her father's usual towels and slippers, packing them to take to the hospital the next day. As they sorted, her mother chattered about her father's daily habits; Yu Xiaowen listened quietly and gained a better understanding of her parents' everyday life.

events.name: Intermittent activities and stretching.
events.description: Following yesterday's decision, Yu Xiaowen got up and moved for 5 minutes after every 40 minutes of sitting in the ward during the day, walking slowly in the corridor or doing a few side bends. After returning home in the evening, she persisted in completing 20 minutes of lower back stretching and core exercises, and she felt that the strength in her lower back was slowly recovering.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Positive because of learning a new skill

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Feeling gratified by her father's cooperation

state.daily_exercise: Helped father walk about 50 meters, with intermittent activity and 20 minutes of stretching.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, with assistance, her father took his first steps walking down the corridor, and Xiaowen was greatly encouraged. She purchased rehabilitation aids for her father. In the evening, she walked with her brother in the community and discussed follow-up arrangements, feeling physically and mentally relaxed outdoors.

events.name: Accompanied father in walking exercise in the ward corridor
events.description: Early in the morning, after the nurse's assessment, Yu Xiaowen helped her father try walking a short distance in the ward corridor. With his right hand holding the handrail along the wall and his left hand supported alternately by Xiaowen and her brother, he slowly moved about 50 meters. Although his steps were small, his father did not report dizziness during the entire walk, which made Yu Xiaowen feel encouraged. She took a photo of his back with her phone and sent it to the family WeChat group; her mother quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji.

events.name: Purchase rehabilitation aids for father
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen used her phone to compare several brands of non-slip slippers, grab bars, and adjustable training bed rails on an e-commerce platform. She focused on anti-slip performance, materials, and user reviews, and finally ordered a pair of non-slip rehabilitation slippers and a simple bedside grab bar, spending about 300 yuan. She requested expedited shipping, hoping that her father could use them as soon as he was discharged from the hospital.

events.name: Evening walk around the neighborhood with my brother.
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng went for a walk in the neighborhood near Kaixuan Road where their parents live. They walked around the neighborhood twice and talked about the division of responsibilities for their father's follow-up rehabilitation and her own career plans. Yu Xiaowen mentioned her interest in rehabilitation medicine, and her brother encouraged her to try it boldly. After about 40 minutes of walking, Xiaowen felt that her lower back was actually more comfortable with the light activity.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Looking forward to progress

end_state.location: On the caregiver chair in the hospital ward at Luoyang Central Hospital.
end_state.mood: Encouraged by father's positive response

state.daily_exercise: Assisted walking training for about 800 steps, and a 40-minute stroll.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yu Xiaowen booked post-discharge community rehabilitation guidance for her father and started preparing his discharge belongings. She continued her daily stretching and walking, and the day passed peacefully and with anticipation.

events.name: Make an appointment for her father's community home rehabilitation guidance
events.description: On the morning of January 26, 2025, Yu Xiaowen contacted a rehabilitation consultant at the community health service center in Xigong District, Luoyang, through a university classmate. She described her father's condition and current functional level in detail and successfully booked an in-home rehabilitation assessment and guidance service for 9 a.m. on January 30, the second day of the Chinese New Year. The community health center also promised to include her father in the chronic disease management registry and conduct regular follow-ups. Yu Xiaowen forwarded the booking information to her mother and older brother to make sure the whole family knew.

events.name: Organize the list of items to pack for discharge.
events.description: In the afternoon, her father was told that he could be discharged the next day. Yu Xiaowen began making a discharge packing list with her brother, including her father's personal clothes from admission, toiletries, the take-home medications issued by the hospital, and the fruits and nutritional supplements accumulated over these days. She deliberately placed the folder of ID documents and receipts in the outermost layer of her backpack so it would be easy to access when handling procedures early the next morning.

events.name: Routine stretching and slow walking.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Yu Xiaowen first did 15 minutes of waist stretching, then walked alone for 20 minutes in the small garden downstairs, breathing the cool air. She looked back over the past ten days and felt that although she was tired, she had gained a lot, especially seeing her father improve day by day, and her own thinking about rehabilitation gradually became clearer.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: Excitement of preparing for discharge from the hospital.

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Full of anticipation, with a hint of nervousness

state.daily_exercise: Stretch for 15 minutes, walk for 20 minutes

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, her father was successfully discharged from the hospital and returned home. Yu Xiaowen and her brother divided the work and handled the ward affairs in an orderly manner. Looking at the newly pasted Spring Festival couplets at the door and her father's smile, the family finally stepped out of the hospital's confinement, and the flavor of the New Year began to appear. Although she was very tired, she insisted on doing stretching and relaxation.

events.name: Notification that her father was approved for discharge from the hospital.
events.description: On the morning of January 27, 2025, after ward rounds, the attending physician for her father, Yu Jianguo, at Luoyang Central Hospital conducted a comprehensive assessment of his vital signs and rehabilitation indicators, confirming that his condition was stable and that he met the discharge criteria. The doctor informed Yu Xiaowen and her elder brother, Yu Xiaofeng, that they could complete the discharge procedures, and personally explained the post-discharge home care and medication precautions, emphasizing the continued use of aspirin and statins as well as the gradual progression of daily functional training. Yu Xiaowen recorded the key points of the doctor's orders one by one as voice memos.

events.name: Complete discharge procedures and tidy the ward.
events.description: At around 10:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowen and her elder brother went to the inpatient billing counter of the hospital, used her debit card to settle the hospitalization bill, and got back the deposit. Then the two went to the pharmacy to pick up the discharge medications prescribed by the doctor, including aspirin, atorvastatin, and two bottles of nerve-recovery medication. After that was done, they returned to the ward and helped their father pack up personal items such as clothes and toiletries. Yu Xiaofeng was responsible for carrying the items, while Yu Xiaowen carefully checked the discharge summary and medical order sheet to make sure nothing was left in the ward.

events.name: Escorted my father home by car.
events.description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen and Yu Xiaofeng used a wheelchair provided by the hospital to push their father Yu Jianguo to the hospital entrance, and booked a spacious ride through a ride-hailing platform. The two carefully helped their father into the back seat. Yu Xiaowen carried emergency medicine and an oxygen bag and sat beside her father, taking attentive care of him along the way and frequently asking if he felt any discomfort. About an hour later, the vehicle arrived at the old house at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang. The siblings helped their father out of the car together and used the wheelchair borrowed from the hospital to safely bring him into the first-floor room.

events.name: Settled my father in and noticed the Spring Festival couplet decorations.
events.description: After arriving at the old house in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen and Yu Xiaofeng first helped their father lie down on the bed in the bedroom to rest. Their mother, Li Xiuying, had already prepared clean bedding. Yu Xiaowen noticed that Aunt Zhao Xiulan had, as promised, helped put up brand-new Spring Festival couplets and a “Fu” character on the front door, with gold characters on a red background, very festive. She helped her father walk slowly to the door to take a look. Seeing the festive couplets, her father showed the first smile since being admitted to the hospital. Yu Xiaowen quickly used her phone to photograph her father's smile and the couplets, shared them in the family WeChat group, and added the caption, “Dad's smile is the best New Year gift.”

events.name: Placed zodiac commemorative coins to decorate the bedroom.
events.description: After settling her father in, Yu Xiaowen returned to her bedroom, opened her suitcase, and took out the childhood zodiac commemorative coin collection box, placing it neatly on the windowsill. She deliberately placed the Ox, her father's zodiac sign, and the Sheep, her mother's zodiac sign, at the front. Using these time-worn keepsakes, she prayed for blessings for the new year and added a unique Lunar New Year flavor and memories to her room. Then she stood quietly for a moment, feeling the long-missed sense of security of home. Finally, she did 10 minutes of pre-bed stretching before resting peacefully.

start_state.location: At my parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, I got up and prepared to go to the hospital.
start_state.mood: Excitement mixed with nervousness.

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Steady, warm, and relieved of a burden.

state.daily_exercise: Frequently moved around and carried items; accumulated about 6,000 steps; stretched for 10 minutes before bed.

2025-01.daily_overview: On New Year's Eve, the family of four worked together to prepare the reunion dinner, while also accommodating my father's rehabilitation diet. The simple reunion dinner, the Spring Festival Gala, and staying up late to usher in the New Year brought this family, which had been through difficult times, back together. Despite being busy, Yu Xiaowen still remembered to stretch and accompany her father in indoor activities. Her weight increased slightly due to the holiday diet.

events.name: The whole family worked together to prepare the New Year's Eve dinner.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen, her mother Li Xiuying, and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng prepared ingredients for the New Year's Eve dinner in advance at their home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang. Yu Xiaowen was in charge of cooking yam and lean pork porridge for her father, and personally making her favorite huimian noodles. Following her mother's method from memory, she kneaded the dough, let it rest, and pulled it into noodles. Though her technique was a bit awkward, it was full of sincerity. Her mother and brother were responsible for washing vegetables, chopping, and stewing other dishes, including a pot of pork rib and lotus root soup and several Henan-style stir-fried dishes. The kitchen was steaming hot, and her father sat on the living room sofa watching everyone busy through the half-open door.

events.name: A family of four eating the New Year's Eve dinner
events.description: At around 6 p.m., Yu Xiaowen, her parents, and her older brother gathered around the dining table in the living room to enjoy the New Year's Eve dinner she had prepared herself. On the table were yam porridge, braised noodles, pork rib soup, sweet and sour pork fillet (specially made with less sugar and oil by Xiaowen for her father), stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fruit salad (Xiaowen's multi-nutrient combination). Although her father could only eat liquid and soft food, he sat at the table drinking porridge with a satisfied expression throughout. During the meal, the family chatted about daily life. Xiaowen shared amusing stories from the department last year, her brother talked about his experiences in Shenzhen, and her mother recalled how Xiaowen had loved to indulge in sweet and sour pork fillet during the New Year as a child. The atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Watch the CCTV Spring Festival Gala
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen sat on the living room sofa with her parents and older brother, and switched the TV to China Central Television. Everyone watched the Spring Festival Gala while cracking sunflower seeds and eating citrus. Her father grew a bit tired midway, so Xiaowen helped him recline on the sofa and covered him with a blanket. During the show, a sketch about medical staff made Xiaowen's eyes red; she immediately thought of her days in the hospital. Her mother handed her a tissue and patted her hand.

events.name: Staying up to greet the New Year at midnight and exchanging blessings.
events.description: When the midnight bell rang, Yu Xiaowen stayed up with her parents and older brother to see in the Lunar New Year. Outside the window there were sparse firecracker sounds. Xiaowen helped her father stand up and move around a bit, and then the family exchanged wishes of "Happy New Year" and "Health and safety." She used her phone to take a group selfie of the four of them squeezed on the sofa and sent it to the WeChat family group and the childhood-friends group. Afterward, her brother helped their father back to his room to rest. Yu Xiaowen and her mother cleaned up the table, and she did 10 minutes of stretching before returning to her room, ending this simple but memorable Lunar New Year's Eve.

start_state.mood: Holiday Joy and Gratitude

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Satisfied and full of hope

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the Lunar New Year, after paying New Year visits remotely, Yu Xiaowen made a two-day review plan and gladly accepted Wang Fang's invitation to be a bridesmaid. She started her New Year study mode amid the festive atmosphere. In the morning, she accompanied her father for a walk in the hospital garden, and continued her stretching routine.

events.name: Made a review plan and organized the materials.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen spent the morning at her home in Luoyang making a detailed two-day (30–31) review plan, covering the respiratory and cardiovascular systems of internal medicine for the attending physician exam. She pulled out the review notes and textbooks she had brought to Luoyang from her suitcase, then took out the book "The Doctor's Advancement" and a reading notebook and arranged them neatly on her desk. She talked with her brother Yu Xiaofeng, asking him to take the main responsibility for taking care of their father while she studied, ensuring she could have two full hours of uninterrupted study time during the day. Her brother readily agreed.

events.name: Send New Year greetings to elders via video call
events.description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen used the video call feature on WeChat to first connect with her parents, who were resting in the living room, and formally paid New Year's greetings to them, wishing her father a speedy recovery and her mother good health. Then she called her cousin Li Yaqin (in Hangzhou) and several other elder relatives one by one via video call to send them Spring Festival wishes. During the calls, she briefly told them about her father's condition (he had been discharged) and passed on her parents' thanks. Her cousin advised her to rest well and said she would return to Luoyang to visit her uncle when the weather warmed up.

events.name: Spring Festival interaction in the besties group
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen sent New Year greetings and a just-taken family photo in the WeChat group named 'Childhood Friends Circle', and proactively greeted her three best friends in the group: Wang Lina, Zhang Jing, and Sun Yue. Soon, Wang Lina, who was in Shenzhen, and Zhang Jing and Sun Yue, who were in Zhengzhou, all sent New Year red envelopes and voice greetings, enthusiastically sharing the lively scenes of celebrating the New Year in their hometowns. Yu Xiaowen replied to each of them with blessings and thanks.

events.name: New Year greetings in the department group
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen sent New Year greetings and a set of penguin New Year greeting stickers in the department work WeChat group of Zhengzhou Central Hospital to express festive wishes to her colleagues. Later, her supervising teacher Li Wei, colleague Liu Qiang, department director Zhang Lei, head nurse Wu Min, and others also replied with blessings in the group one after another. Li Wei also sent a private message asking, "How is your father recovering?" Yu Xiaowen replied, "He is recovering steadily at home, thank you, teacher," and felt a warm surge in her heart.

events.name: Wang Fang sent her engagement photos and officially confirmed me as a bridesmaid
events.description: In the evening, her close friend and colleague Wang Fang sent photos of her engagement ceremony through a private WeChat chat, and formally invited Yu Xiaowen again to be the maid of honor at her wedding this autumn. In the photos, Wang Fang was smiling radiantly. Yu Xiaowen was genuinely happy for her, immediately replied, "Of course! Congratulations, dear!" and gladly accepted the invitation, then asked about the wedding preparation progress. Wang Fang thanked her for her support, revealed that the wedding date was roughly set for October, with the exact day to be finalized by the elders of both families, and they agreed to find time after the holiday to look at dresses together.

events.name: Walked and stretched with her father in the garden.
events.description: Before making the morning plan, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her father for a slow walk around the community garden, about 15 minutes. Her father walked with a walking frame while Xiaowen guarded beside him. After the walk, she did 15 minutes of full-body stretching on the balcony, focusing on the lower back, and felt her body gradually returning to its former lightness.

start_state.location: Woke up at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
start_state.mood: New year, new atmosphere; relaxed and pleasant.

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of the lunar month, the community rehabilitation consultant came to the house as scheduled and developed a personalized training plan for her father. Yu Xiaowen continued reviewing for exams as planned, and in the evening had a heart-to-heart late-night talk with her brother. Their sibling relationship was strengthened as they worked through the hard times together. Stretching and walking remained her daily routine.

events.name: Home assessment and guidance from a community rehabilitation consultant.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Dr. Wang, a rehabilitation consultant from the Community Health Service Center of Xigong District, Luoyang City, arrived on time. Yu Xiaowen and her mother helped her father to a chair in the living room. Dr. Wang assessed her father's muscle strength, balance, and activities of daily living on the spot, and designed a tailored home rehabilitation plan, including sitting balance training, bridging exercises in bed, and unsupported standing twice a day for 10 minutes each time. Dr. Wang also personally taught Xiaowen and her mother how to correctly use the newly purchased walking frame for assisted walking. The assessment lasted about one hour, and before leaving, Dr. Wang left a well-illustrated training instruction manual.

events.name: In the morning, reviewed the respiratory system chapter for the attending physician exam.
events.description: After the community advisor left, Yu Xiaowen focused on reviewing the respiratory system chapter of internal medicine for the attending physician exam during the quiet morning period at her home in Luoyang, as planned. She mainly tackled the differential diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and bronchial asthma, used her notes and textbooks to create a mind map, and also completed the corresponding chapter's question bank exercises, with an accuracy rate of about 75%. When organizing the wrong answers, she specifically marked the weak point of 'interpretation of pulmonary function test indicators'. Throughout the morning, her brother was responsible for accompanying her father in training and basically did not disturb her.

events.name: In the afternoon, continued reading "Better" and took notes.
events.description: In the afternoon, her father was taking a nap and her mother was watching TV in the living room. Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk in her bedroom and continued reading the last two chapters of Better. She focused on the content about doctor-patient communication and teamwork, connecting it to the way the doctors had communicated during her father's recent hospitalization. As she read, she noted her insights and clinical case associations in her notebook.

events.name: Siblings had a late-night talk about career and family.
events.description: At around 10 p.m., her father was already sound asleep and her mother had also gone to her room to rest. Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng sat in the living room, brewed a pot of jasmine tea, and began a rare late-night heart-to-heart talk. Her brother admitted that although he earned a high salary in Shenzhen, the competitive pressure was enormous. He envied his sister's career stability but also worried that reality would dull her edge. Xiaowen shared her dissatisfaction with and reflections on her work, as well as a vague idea of transferring to the rehabilitation department. The two encouraged each other and agreed to have an in-depth video call at least once a month from then on.

events.name: Morning and evening stretching and afternoon walk.
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Yu Xiaowen did 20 minutes of lower back stretching and core exercises following the moves taught by the rehabilitation consultant. During an afternoon study break, she went downstairs alone for a 20-minute walk to get some fresh air, and after coming back, she did another set of shoulder and neck relaxation. Her lower back no longer felt obviously sore today, and she felt her core strength was recovering.

start_state.mood: Motivated by the arrival of the rehabilitation consultant

end_state.location: Sofa in the living room at my parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang (returned to my room after a late-night talk with my brother).
end_state.mood: After deep communication, felt relieved and more determined.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the third day of the Lunar New Year, Yu Xiaowen focused on sprinting through her review of the cardiovascular system and completed a full set of mock exam questions, building knowledge reserves for returning to work after the holiday. She practiced the new rehabilitation plan with her family, accompanied them on evening walks, and her stretching habit became fully internalized. Her weight dropped to 49.5kg. Although she still felt somewhat tired, her condition was stabilizing.

events.name: Morning focused review of the cardiovascular system chapter
events.description: At her home in Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen spent the morning focusing on reviewing the cardiovascular system chapter of internal medicine. She first quickly reviewed frameworks such as hypertension grading and coronary heart disease classification, then consolidated core knowledge with practice questions, and did targeted exercises specifically on ECG interpretation of arrhythmias. She used a mobile app to do 50 multiple-choice questions and immediately checked the explanations for the questions she got wrong. Her older brother still took on most of the daytime caregiving, allowing her to study continuously until 11:30.

events.name: In the afternoon, finished notes on 'Better' and did practice questions.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen first spent an hour organizing the remaining notes on Better and wrote an 800-character reflection on the whole book, posting it to her private blog. Then she launched the exam question bank on her phone and completed two mock exam papers for the attending physician examination, scoring 68% on one and 72% on the other. She entered all the wrong questions into her mistake notebook by system category, and found that the choice of heart failure treatment drugs and cardiovascular disease risk stratification were her two biggest areas of lost points. She decided to strengthen them by making flashcards starting next week.

events.name: In the evening, she accompanied her father during his training and guided him on using the rehabilitation manual.
events.description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen and her mother, following the rehabilitation consultant's instruction manual, helped her father do standing balance training in the living room. Her father held the sturdy handrail frame with both hands and stood for 3 minutes under the protection of the three of them. Yu Xiaowen gently encouraged him while using her phone as a timer. After the training, she took out the manual again and, pointing to the diagrams, explained the training goals for the next few days to her father.

events.name: Evening stretching and family walk
events.description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen first spent 15 minutes doing neck, shoulder, and lower back stretches to relieve the fatigue of a day of studying. Then she accompanied her father and mother on a slow 20-minute walk around the residential community; her father held onto a walking frame, and the family chatted as they walked. Yu Xiaowen felt that her lower back was basically fine, but she still felt a slight pulling sensation when squatting down to tie her shoelaces, so she planned to continue her rehabilitation training. After the walk, she went home, washed up, and then sat on the bed doing 5 minutes of mindful breathing, bringing a calm end to the day.

start_state.mood: Start the new day with a plan.

end_state.location: Parents' home, own bedroom, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City
end_state.mood: Satisfied with the steady progress of home rehabilitation and pleased with the exam preparation progress

2025-04.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yu Xiaowen completed her routine morning stretching and Baduanjin before work and summarized the effects of her persistence. During the day she was busy at the hospital. After work she contacted a rehabilitation center to book physical therapy for her father, while her mother took over the housework. In the evening, as planned, she resumed studying the statistics course and participated in an online book club discussion, starting off a busy April.

events.name: Contacted the rehabilitation center to schedule physical therapy for her father.
events.description: From her home at No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen contacted a community rehabilitation center by phone to inquire about the daily physical therapy service plan, costs, and schedule for sequelae of cerebral infarction. She made a reservation for her father Yu Jianguo for daily sessions starting April 5, and completed the registration and online payment procedures.

events.name: The mother took on household chores, and the family adapted to the new division of labor.
events.description: Starting April 1, her mother, Li Xiuying, formally took on daily household chores in the new rented home on Huayuan Road, including preparing three meals, cleaning, and buying daily necessities, so that Yu Xiaowen could focus more on work and taking care of her father. The family gradually adapted to the new division of household responsibilities.

events.name: Participated in an online shared-reading discussion on the Fan Deng Reading app.
events.description: At 8 PM on April 1, 2025, Yu Xiaowen promptly joined the online discussion in the Fan Deng Reading app's co-reading community from her home study. This week she read a book about female leadership, shared her understanding of a 'gentle yet firm' leadership style in the group, had an in-depth conversation with a member working in management, and noted the book's practical advice.

events.name: Resume the online statistics course and create a catch-up plan
events.description: On April 1, Yu Xiaowen officially restarted the online statistics course that had been interrupted in March by family matters. At home, she checked the course syllabus and progress on the course platform and, based on her fragmented time (her father's naps, her night shifts, etc.), made a catch-up plan from April 1 to April 20, specifying core content to master, including the t-test and chi-square test.

events.name: Recorded morning exercise reflections to prepare for April habit consolidation.
events.description: On the morning of April 1, after completing 10 minutes of stretching and Baduanjin, Yu Xiaowen took time to record in her phone memo her insights from maintaining perfect attendance this month: shoulder and neck soreness had significantly eased, sleep quality had improved, and her sense of balance between housework and work had strengthened. She summarized her adjustment experience during the move and mentally prepared herself to continue consolidating the habit in April.

events.name: Handling routine clinical work at the hospital
events.description: During the day at the inpatient department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen attended the department's morning meeting, followed her supervising teacher Li Wei on ward rounds, handled inpatient orders and medical records, and in the afternoon guided interns and organized patient files. The work was busy but orderly.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yu Xiaowen used her lunch break to successfully activate the electronic medical insurance credentials for herself and her mother, and also linked a family account for her father. Her mother showed interest in the new technology. She was busy at the hospital during the day, and after work she played badminton with her regular partner Lin Wei to relax. In the evening, she persisted in studying the data description section of her statistics course. The day was fulfilling, spent between work and personal relaxation.

events.name: Activate my medical insurance electronic voucher.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen opened the Alipay app at her home on Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and following the promotional guide from the Zhengzhou Healthcare Security Bureau, completed facial recognition and identity verification, successfully activated her electronic medical insurance certificate, and saved a screenshot for future medical visits.

events.name: Guide mother to activate and use the electronic medical insurance voucher
events.description: Yu Xiaowen demonstrated on her own phone how to open Alipay and display the electronic medical insurance voucher, then guided her mother Li Xiuying through completing activation and first use on her own phone, patiently explaining how to show the QR code for scenarios such as registration and buying medicine. Her mother was curious about the new feature and marveled at how much more convenient it was than carrying a physical card. Xiaowen also encouraged her mother to try more smartphone functions.

events.name: Linked father to the medical insurance family account
events.description: Yu Xiaowen entered her father Yu Jianguo's identity information through Alipay's Family Account feature and, via a WeChat video call, guided her father to complete facial recognition and authorization confirmation at his home in Zhengzhou. She successfully bound her father's account, making it easier in the future to pick up medications on his behalf or look up information when seeking medical treatment and buying medicine in another city.

events.name: Play doubles with Lin Wei at the badminton hall
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen had about an hour of doubles badminton practice with her badminton partner Lin Wei at the badminton hall in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou. During the game, she felt her stamina had recovered significantly compared with the previous two weeks. The two also talked about recent work stress and felt refreshed after exercising.

events.name: Study the data description module of the statistics course online.
events.description: After finishing the ball game and returning home for a brief rest, Yu Xiaowen opened the online statistics course and studied the descriptive statistics section. She watched the instructional videos to understand concepts such as the mean, median, and standard deviation, and wrote down the key formulas in her notebook. After the lesson, she completed 5 accompanying multiple-choice questions to strengthen her understanding.

events.name: Hospital work: ward rounds and medical record organization
events.description: During the day at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen followed the attending physician on ward rounds, recording changes in patients' conditions. In the afternoon, she organized medical records and assisted Teacher Li Wei with preparations for a difficult case discussion.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the eve of Qingming Festival, after work, Yu Xiaowen lit a self-made pottery lamp on the balcony of her apartment, offering a distant memorial to her grandparents and praying for her father's recovery, expressing her longing. During the day, she had asked her department to reduce night shifts and began buying meals at the hospital or community canteen to save time. Amid her busyness, she also found an interesting book club on Douban and signed up. That evening, the warmth of the ritual slightly relieved the pressure of the past few days.

events.name: Apply to the department director for a night shift adjustment
events.description: While working at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen used her break time to submit a written request to the department director, Zhang Lei, explaining that her father needed nighttime family care after surgery and requesting that her night shift frequency be reduced from twice a week to once, and that day shifts be arranged as much as possible. Director Zhang Lei understood the situation, agreed to the adjustment, and notified the scheduling colleague to implement it in subsequent shift rosters.

events.name: Change her eating pattern to save time
events.description: To save time and energy on cooking so she could better balance work and family, Yu Xiaowen changed her previous habit of cooking at home starting April 3. She began eating her three meals mainly at the hospital cafeteria or community cafeteria, and also bought some ready-to-eat food as backup. This change gave her about 1 to 2 extra hours each day to spend accompanying her father in rehabilitation and resting.

events.name: Discovered and signed up for a book club activity on Douban
events.description: During a work break, Yu Xiaowen browsed local offline activities in Zhengzhou through the Douban Same City app on her phone. She found a notice for a medical humanities discussion on "Being Mortal" posted by the "Under the Wutong Tree Book Club." The theme was highly relevant to her career as a doctor. The activity was scheduled for Sunday, April 13, at 2 p.m. She immediately clicked the registration button on the page, submitted her application, and successfully registered.

events.name: Prepare items for remote ancestor worship.
events.description: On the evening of April 3, Yu Xiaowen prepared the items needed for a remote memorial in the living room of her rented apartment: she added vegetable oil and a wick to the small clay lamp she had made earlier, took out a piece of white paper and wrote down a wish for her father's recovery, and prepared a lighter and a small tray to place the clay lamp on the balcony.

events.name: On the balcony, paid remote respects to grandparents and made a wish.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen carried a tray (with a lit small pottery lamp on it) to the south-facing balcony of her rented apartment and faced the direction of Luoyang. She put the pottery lamp on the balcony railing. In the flickering light, she closed her eyes, silently remembered her late grandparents, and whispered a prayer for her father, who was recovering at home, to get well soon. The whole process lasted about 15 minutes and was filled with ritual and emotional significance.

events.name: Cleaned and stored the ceramic lamp.
events.description: After the distant memorial ceremony, Yu Xiaowen waited for the clay lamp to burn out naturally, brought the tray and the cooled clay lamp back inside, cleaned the ashes and oil stains on the balcony, properly kept the clay lamp as a memento, and then washed up and rested.

events.name: Daily hospital work
events.description: During the day at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen completed routine ward rounds and medical record writing, and during the lunch break discussed Qingming holiday scheduling with colleagues.

events.name: Brief statistics review in the evening
events.description: After the remote memorial ceremony, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk and spent 15 minutes reviewing the key formulas in the data description section of her statistics course, maintaining continuity in her studies.

start_state.mood: Slightly heavy, because Qingming Festival is approaching.

2025-04.daily_overview: During the Qingming Festival, Yu Xiaowen was off duty, but the lingering mood of the previous night's remote memorial ceremony remained. During the day she stayed at home with her parents and made traditional red date cake with her mother; after a nap at noon, she conserved energy for the night shift. In the evening, she studied statistics while on duty in the hospital duty room, exchanged learning progress with her colleague Wang Fang, and practiced emergency procedures in the demonstration room whenever she had time. It was fulfilling and peaceful.

events.name: Making Qingming Festival date cakes at home with my mother.
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying were in the kitchen making jujube cake, a traditional Henan food for Qingming Festival. While kneading the dough and steaming, the mother and daughter talked about past Qingming memories in Luoyang, expressing their longing for their ancestors in a warm atmosphere. Her father sat in the living room listening to them chat and occasionally chimed in.

events.name: Afternoon nap to prepare for the night shift
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen returned to the bedroom to take a two-hour nap to store up energy for the night shift that evening. Before going to sleep, she set an alarm and checked the items she needed to bring for her duty.

events.name: Night shift duty and studying statistics
events.description: During a break in her night shift at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen studied the probability distribution module of basic statistics in the duty room. She watched teaching videos about the binomial distribution and normal distribution. After finishing the duty medical records, she took a quiz with a mobile app, focusing on remembering the characteristics of the normal distribution and the standard score formula. She also briefly shared her learning progress with her colleague Wang Fang.

events.name: Practiced cardiopulmonary resuscitation with Wang Fang in the demonstration room.
events.description: Around midnight, taking advantage of the relatively quiet ward, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the demonstration room to practice the two-person CPR procedure according to competition requirements. They repeated it twice, corrected each other's movement details, and prepared for the upcoming emergency competition.

events.name: Urged her father to do home rehabilitation exercises.
events.description: Before dinner, Yu Xiaowen reminded and assisted her father in completing the day's home rehabilitation exercises, including arm raises and ankle pump exercises, and recorded how they went.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Saturday, while tidying the study at her parents' home, Yu Xiaowen found many dusty books and decided to get a Kindle for digital reading. She placed an order for an entry-level Kindle on her phone in the living room. In the afternoon, she accompanied her father from her parents' home to the rehabilitation center for his first physical therapy session and carefully learned the assistance methods. In the evening, she received the Kindle delivered by JD.com at her parents' home, and that night she used it while accompanying her father, starting a new way of fragmented reading. The day was spent balancing family care and adapting to modern technology.

events.name: Tidied up the study and decided to buy a Kindle.
events.description: On the morning of April 5, Yu Xiaowen was organizing the bookshelves in the study of her parents' home in Zhengzhou when she found several half-finished books covered in dust due to moving and accompanying her father. Recalling that her close friend Wang Lina had once recommended the Kindle for its portability, she decided to buy an e-reader to solve her reading problem.

events.name: Placed an online order for the entry-level Kindle
events.description: In the living room of her parents' home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen searched on the JD app on her phone and placed an order for the entry-level Kindle, chose same-day delivery, and waited for delivery after paying.

events.name: Accompanied my father to complete his first physical therapy session.
events.description: According to the appointment made the previous day, Yu Xiaowen set out from her parents' home and accompanied her father Yu Jianguo to the community rehabilitation center in Zhengzhou, where he completed his first full session of physical therapy. The therapist developed a personalized plan based on her father's physical condition. The treatment lasted about one hour, and Yu Xiaowen observed and learned the precautions so she could assist later.

events.name: Received the Kindle and downloaded e-books
events.description: On the afternoon of April 5, at her parents' home in Zhengzhou, Yu Xiaowen received the Kindle delivered by JD Express. After unboxing it, she immediately connected to Wi-Fi, logged into her Amazon account, and downloaded the e-book version of "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance" and several rehabilitation medicine reference books, preparing her reading material for that night's caregiving shift.

events.name: Used Kindle to read while accompanying father
events.description: On the evening of April 5, Yu Xiaowen took her newly purchased Kindle to her father Yu Jianguo's room to accompany him while he recovered. She sat by the bed quietly reading "Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance." Seeing this, her father chuckled, "This is much nicer than holding a thick book." Yu Xiaowen told her father about the Kindle's portability and lightness, then continued reading attentively, beginning a fragmented e-reading mode.

In the morning, Yu Xiaowen rode her electric bike from her residence on Jingsan Road to her parents' new home, and then suggested the whole family go for a walk in Dongfengqu Riverside Park. With her mother's help, her father walked slowly, and the family identified nearby facilities to become familiar with the new community. Her father was full of praise for the community environment, and the family atmosphere was relaxed. Her mother recorded the walking route. In the evening, she bought books for the reading club online and systematically reviewed the principles of hypothesis testing. It was a day full of sunshine and hope.

events.name: Family walk at Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park
events.description: On the morning of April 6, Yu Xiaowen rode her e-bike (about 15 minutes) from her residence at No. 89 Jingsan Road to her parents' new home on Huayuan Road. Seeing that her father was in good spirits, she suggested the whole family take a walk in Dongfengqu Riverside Park near the new home. After arriving, her mother helped her father walk slowly while Yu Xiaowen pushed the wheelchair as a backup. The three walked along the path, identifying the nearby supermarket, pharmacy, and bus stops to familiarize themselves with the surroundings. Midway through the walk, the family rested on a bench, and her father remarked on the peaceful environment of the new home, sharing his feelings about arriving in the new environment with her mother and Xiaowen. The atmosphere was relaxed and warm.

events.name: Mother recorded the walking route.

Yu Xiaowen expressed her support. The family gained an initial understanding of life around the new home and felt more confident about living in the new community.

events.description: In order to participate better in the book club discussion, Yu Xiaowen ordered Atul Gawande's 'Being Mortal' on Dangdang.com, chose home delivery, and prepared for the subsequent reading.

2025-04.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Yu Xiaowen received the book Being Mortal during a break in her busy clinical work, and couldn't wait to read the introduction during her lunch break. At noon, in the cafeteria, she discussed the training schedule for the emergency competition with colleagues Wang Fang and Liu Qiang, and agreed to practice again on Wednesday. In the evening, after her father fell asleep, she put on earphones and listened to Mozart symphonies on the balcony, letting classical music wash away the day's fatigue, and decided to make two evenings a week a regular music time.

events.name: Go to work and handle clinical matters
events.description: On Monday morning, Yu Xiaowen attended the department shift handover on time. In the morning, she followed the chief physician on the major ward round, carefully recorded changes in the condition of several key patients, and assisted Dr. Li Wei in adjusting treatment plans. In the afternoon, she wrote progress notes and saw newly admitted patients.

events.name: Received the package and started reading 'Being Mortal'.
events.description: At noon, after receiving the delivery of Being Mortal, Yu Xiaowen used the lunch break in the duty room to read the book's preface and first chapter, learning about the author's background and core issues to accumulate material for the upcoming book club discussion.

events.name: Discussed competition training with colleagues during lunch in the cafeteria.
events.description: At noon in the cafeteria, Yu Xiaowen sat with Wang Fang and Liu Qiang for lunch. The three exchanged views on the training frequency and key items for the first-aid skills competition. Liu Qiang suggested improving the speed of endotracheal intubation, and Wang Fang proposed practicing once more on Wednesday morning.

events.name: Listen to classical music to relax in the evening
events.description: After her father fell asleep that evening, Yu Xiaowen took out her wireless earphones, opened the music app on her phone, selected and played the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G minor. She sat alone on the balcony of her home, put on the earphones, and listened attentively in the night. The familiar melody briefly made her forget the dual pressure brought by recent family matters and hospital work, and her mind gradually became calm. 2025-04.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yu Xiaowen had a compensatory day off. In the morning she rode her e-bike from her residence on Jingsan Road to her parents' home, met up with her mother, accompanied her to the pharmacy to pick up medicine for her father, and taught her mother how to use QR code payment. Her father's negative attitude toward rehabilitation training caused her mother to complain, and the family atmosphere became tense. In the evening she confided in her best friend Zhang Jing and, comforted by her friend, her mood gradually eased. It was a day full of friction and tears.

events.description: On the afternoon of April 10, 2025, Yu Xiaowen walked with her mother Li Xiuying to the designated pharmacy Kangjian Pharmacy in Jinshui District, about 800 meters from home, explaining on the way how to use the family account. Inside the pharmacy, Yu Xiaowen opened the National Healthcare Security Platform app on her phone and showed the family account QR code to pay for her father's rehabilitation medications (including antihypertensive drugs and traditional Chinese patent medicines for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis). Her mother Li Xiuying, beside her, tried using her own Alipay scan-code payment to buy medicine for the first time. Yu Xiaowen patiently guided her through the steps, and after the successful payment, her mother looked curious and delighted. After completing the purchase, Yu Xiaowen checked the medicines and the invoice.

Her mother was still enthusiastically talking about the new experience of QR code payment.

events.description: That afternoon, her father, Yu Jianguo, performed the prescribed physical therapy rehabilitation exercises at home in Zhengzhou, but because the movements were not up to standard and his attitude was passive, the treatment effect was poor. In the evening in the living room, her mother, Li Xiuying, complained to the family about this with a displeased tone. Her father remained silent, and the family atmosphere was heavy. Seeing this, Yu Xiaowen tried to mediate between them, hoping her mother would understand the difficulty of her father's rehabilitation while encouraging her father to face it positively, but the mediation did not work well, and she felt emotionally and physically drained herself.

events.description: After failing to mediate, Yu Xiaowen returned to her bedroom, closed the door, and poured out her inner depression and exhaustion to her friend Zhang Jing via WeChat voice messages, saying, “Sometimes I feel like the filling in a sandwich cookie—I have to soothe both sides, but who soothes me?” She also described in detail the course of her parents' quarrel and her own sense of helplessness. Within minutes of receiving the voice messages, Zhang Jing replied with a string of hugging emojis and comforting words, providing immediate emotional support, expressing understanding and encouraging her to relax a little. Seeing the reply, Xiaowen felt her loneliness ease and gradually calmed down.

events.description: After calming down, Yu Xiaowen sat on the bed and tried a 5-minute breathing relaxation exercise using a meditation app on her phone. Although she could not concentrate fully, she felt a hint of calm.

On the spring night, her father finally said what was on his mind about fearing he would drag the family down. She firmly encouraged him, and the father and daughter became closer. After returning home, she studied the practical applications of the one-sample t-test, adding fuel to her research. That day, family love healed the gloom of the previous day.

While walking slowly, Yu Xiaowen gently asked her father how he felt about the physical therapy. After a silence, her father finally said what was in his heart: 'I don't want to be a burden to you.' Yu Xiaowen held her father's hand and firmly comforted him: 'Dad, you have never been a burden. We'll work hard together.' The father and daughter talked heart to heart, her father's eyes became moist, and their bond grew closer. After the walk, the father and daughter returned home with warm feelings.

Instructor Zheng Guodong helped remove the exhibition labels and lighting equipment, and returned them. The three briefly discussed how to store the unsold works. Yu Xiaowen decided to give a few pieces to friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue, who had come to support her, as keepsakes, and transport the rest back to her home in Jinshui District for proper storage. The exhibition dismantling ended at around 8 p.m., and Yu Xiaowen drove back to her residence.

events.name: After returning home, she washed up, tidied, and relaxed with tea.
events.description: After the exhibition teardown, arrived home around 9 p.m. After washing up, brewed a small amount of ripe Pu'er tea in a white porcelain cup, leaned back on the sofa to rest while listening to light music, and turned off the lights to sleep around 23:00.

2025-12.daily_overview: I resumed my morning run at dawn, did routine work in the rehabilitation department during the day, sorted nursing home activity materials in the afternoon, played the weekly badminton session with my partner Lin Wei in the evening, and relaxed with tea and reading at night — a day of physical and mental balance.

events.name: Morning run along the Jinshui River.
events.description: Got up at 6:50 in the morning, did a brief warm-up, and jogged 3 km along the Jinshui River. Heart rate range 130-150 bpm, pace about 7 min 30 sec/km. The winter morning breeze was crisp, and few pedestrians were on the trail. After the run, she stretched fully.

events.name: Rehabilitation Department daily work and organizing materials for the nursing home
events.description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the hospital at 7:40 in the morning. In the morning she completed routine treatment assistance in the rehabilitation department, helping a patient with frozen shoulder perform joint mobilization training. In the afternoon, during work breaks, she made preliminary notes on her notebook of the photos and the elderly residents' feedback from the pottery activity at the nursing home last Sunday, accumulating material for future reports.

events.name: Meet badminton friend Lin Wei for a game
events.description: After work in the evening, Yu Xiaowen went directly to Yuyue Badminton Hall to meet Lin Wei for their regular Wednesday doubles practice. The two teamed up against another pair of players, and Yu Xiaowen's backhand drive had improved compared with last month, earning praise from Lin Wei. After about an hour, they stopped. She took a quick shower and changed in the locker room, and made an appointment with Lin Wei to play again next Wednesday.

events.name: Evening tea and reading
events.description: After arriving home at 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowen boiled water and brewed ripe Pu'er tea in a white porcelain gaiwan, placing the tea set on the living room coffee table. While drinking tea, she flipped through the chapter on glaze color mixing in "Pottery: From Beginner to Advanced" and conceived the color palette for her next creation. Around 11 p.m., she turned off the lights and went to rest.

2025-12.daily_overview: After the day shift, I organized my finances to prepare for long-term planning, received a handmade quilt and hometown snacks from my mother, had a long video call with her, and felt deep family warmth in the winter.

events.name: Baduanjin and neck-shoulder exercises
events.description: Got up at 6:45 a.m., first did a set of Baduanjin, then performed 10 minutes of neck and shoulder resistance band training to ease the slight muscle soreness from yesterday's badminton.

events.name: Rehabilitation department daily routine and case records
events.description: In the morning, Yu Xiaowen joined the head of the rehabilitation department, Wang Jianguo, on the major ward round and recorded rehabilitation assessment data for multiple patients. After the ward round, she independently completed two rehabilitation treatment records and assisted head nurse Wu Min in checking the use of a brace by a patient with hemiplegia.

events.name: Organized finances to prepare for planning.
events.description: After work, she returned home around 6 p.m. Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop and banking app in the study, listed her demand deposits, monthly fund investment portfolio, monthly income and expense details, and total savings one by one, calculated the amount of funds available for long-term planning, and sketched an initial capital allocation framework in her notebook, preparing for discussing her father's rehabilitation expenses with her parents and for the meeting with the financial advisor on the 20th.

events.name: Received and unboxed the package my mother sent.
events.description: In the evening, after finishing her financial sorting, Yu Xiaowen went downstairs and picked up a large package from the community parcel locker, sent by her mother Li Xiuying from Zhengzhou. She struggled to carry it home and opened it, finding a hand-sewn floral cotton quilt made by her mother, along with several large packs of hometown food items such as hulatang soup mix and sweet-and-sour pork seasoning. Warmth immediately filled her heart.

events.name: Laying out a new cotton quilt and sharing it with mother over video.
events.description: Yu Xiaowen spread the new quilt on the big bed in her bedroom, and the whole room was instantly filled with sunlight and the warmth of home. She took a photo of the quilt on the bed and sent it to her mother. Soon her mother, Li Xiuying, made a WeChat video call from home in Zhengzhou. The mother and daughter chatted for nearly two hours over video. Her mother urged her to keep warm in the cold Zhengzhou winter and not to work too hard. Yu Xiaowen shared her recent work progress and the pottery exhibition. They talked late into the night, and Yu Xiaowen felt that although she lived alone, she was surrounded by deep family love. After hanging up, she washed up briefly and went to bed.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Full of gratitude and warmth.
